title: fix: propagate sketch classification in buildModelFromStories
description:
## Goal / Problem

The artifact pipeline (PRD/DDD/ARCHITECTURE generation) fails for every interactive session that uses domain story files and a confirmed context map. `buildModelFromStories` in `artifact_generation_handler.go:212` constructs a `DomainBoundedContext` from each `BoundedContextSketch` but passes `nil` for the classification parameter, silently discarding the classification that was already decided during boundary detection. `DomainModel.Finalize()` then calls `checkContextClassifications()` at `domain_model.go:269`, which rejects every context whose `Classification()` returns `nil`, producing `"bounded context 'X' has no classification: invariant violation"`. The entire artifact pipeline is dead on arrival for any multi-story session that reached boundary detection.

The fix is a one-line change: capture `sketch.Classification()` into a local variable and pass its address as the fourth argument to `vo.NewDomainBoundedContext`. A companion test must be added to cover the `contextMap != nil` branch, which currently has zero test coverage.

Discovered during E2E simulation alty-cli-3k3 (round 3).

## Background / Context

- `runArtifactPipeline()` at `cli_discovery_adapter.go:246` calls `artifactGen.GenerateFromStories(ctx, storyReader, storyRefs, contextMap, docsDir, projectDir)`. When boundary detection ran, `contextMap` is non-nil and contains `BoundedContextSketch` objects that carry their classifications.
- `buildModelFromStories()` at `artifact_generation_handler.go:200-275` is the private function that consumes the context map. The loop at line 211-216 iterates over `contextMap.Contexts()`, which returns `[]BoundedContextSketch` (defensive copy, `context_map.go:47-50`). Each sketch's `Classification()` method at `bounded_context_sketch.go:102` returns `vo.SubdomainClassification` (value, not pointer). Passing `nil` instead of `&cls` at line 212 drops the classification entirely.
- `DomainModel.checkContextClassifications()` at `domain_model.go:269-276` is an invariant check inside `Finalize()`. It iterates all bounded contexts and returns an error if any has `Classification() == nil`.
- The `NewDomainBoundedContext` constructor signature at `domain_values.go:131-146` is `NewDomainBoundedContext(name, responsibility string, keyDomainObjects []string, classification *SubdomainClassification, classificationRationale string) DomainBoundedContext`. The fourth parameter is a pointer.
- `BoundedContextSketch` has no `Rationale()` method (`bounded_context_sketch.go:98-140`), so `classificationRationale` must be passed as `""`. This is valid — the field is optional.
- The default-context fallback at `artifact_generation_handler.go:225-229` correctly passes `&generic` for classification. Only the sketch-sourced path at line 212 is broken.
- All existing `GenerateFromStories` tests pass `nil` for the `contextMap` argument. The `contextMap != nil` branch has zero test coverage.
- Composition root at `composition/app.go:225` wires `ArtifactGenerationHandler` with no changes needed — the fix is internal to the handler.

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | `discovery` — application-layer handler within the Discovery bounded context |
| Ubiquitous Language | `BoundedContextSketch`, `SubdomainClassification`, `DomainBoundedContext`, `DomainModel`, `Finalize`, `ContextMap` — all defined in docs/DDD.md |
| Layer | Application (`internal/discovery/application/`) — no domain or infrastructure layer changes required |

## Design

### Fix — Exact Code Change

In `internal/discovery/application/artifact_generation_handler.go`, lines 211-215:

Before:
```go
for _, sketch := range contextMap.Contexts() {
    bc := vo.NewDomainBoundedContext(sketch.Name(), "Manages "+sketch.Name()+" domain", nil, nil, "")
    if err := model.AddBoundedContext(bc); err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("add bounded context %q: %w", sketch.Name(), err)
    }
}
```

After:
```go
for _, sketch := range contextMap.Contexts() {
    cls := sketch.Classification()
    bc := vo.NewDomainBoundedContext(sketch.Name(), "Manages "+sketch.Name()+" domain", nil, &cls, "")
    if err := model.AddBoundedContext(bc); err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("add bounded context %q: %w", sketch.Name(), err)
    }
}
```

No other files require modification.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| S | `buildModelFromStories` must faithfully propagate all fields from sketch, including classification |
| O | No new extension points; fix completes existing translation |
| L | DomainBoundedContext from this path must honor same invariants as Q&A path |
| I | No interface changes |
| D | No new dependencies |

## TDD Workflow

### RED
Add `TestArtifactGenerationHandler_GenerateFromStories_ContextMapClassificationPropagated` to `artifact_generation_handler_test.go`:
- subtest: "context map with core classification is propagated to model" — build ContextMap with SubdomainCore sketch, call GenerateFromStories, assert `*bc.Classification() == vo.SubdomainCore`
- subtest: "context map with mixed classifications all propagate" — two sketches (SubdomainSupporting, SubdomainGeneric), assert both survive with correct values

### GREEN
Insert `cls := sketch.Classification()` and change fourth arg from `nil` to `&cls` at line 212.

### REFACTOR
Run `go test ./internal/discovery/... -race` — verify no regressions.

## Steps

1. Write failing tests (RED)
2. Apply the one-line fix (GREEN)
3. Run full quality gate sequence

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] New test passes: Core classification propagated through GenerateFromStories
- [ ] New test passes: Mixed classifications (Supporting + Generic) both propagate
- [ ] All existing GenerateFromStories tests pass without modification
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` passes with zero failures
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` reports zero issues
- [ ] Diff confined to `artifact_generation_handler.go` + test file

## Edge Cases

| Case | Expected |
|------|----------|
| contextMap is nil | Falls through to single General context path (existing, tested) |
| All-Generic classification | Finalize() passes with warning, no error |
| Core without aggregate | Finalize() fails at checkCoreAggregates — separate invariant, not in scope (see Risks) |
| Empty context map (zero sketches) | Loop doesn't execute, falls through to General context fallback |

## Quality Gates

- [ ] `go build ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `go vet ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` — all pass
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` — zero issues

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [x] Bug location confirmed: `artifact_generation_handler.go:212` — fourth arg is `nil`
- [x] Constructor signature confirmed: `domain_values.go:131-146` — fourth param is `*SubdomainClassification`
- [x] Classification return type confirmed: `bounded_context_sketch.go:102` — returns value type, needs `&cls`
- [x] Invariant trigger confirmed: `domain_model.go:269-276` — rejects nil classification
- [x] No existing test covers the broken path — all pass nil for contextMap
- [x] Fix does not disturb Q&A path (extractContexts/extractClassifications)
- [x] No composition root changes required
- [x] BoundedContextSketch has no Rationale() — pass "" for classificationRationale

## Risks / Dependencies

- **No blocking dependencies.** Single local variable addition in one private function.
- **checkCoreAggregates interaction (KNOWN FOLLOW-UP):** Once classification propagates correctly, any sketch classified as SubdomainCore will hit `checkCoreAggregates()` during `Finalize()` at `domain_model.go:295-314`. Since `buildModelFromStories` does not populate aggregates from stories, Core-classified sketches will produce `"core subdomain 'X' has no aggregate design: invariant violation"`. This is a separate invariant that exists by design — the immediate fix correctly propagates classification, and a follow-up ticket should address aggregate population from stories if needed. Tests should use SubdomainSupporting/SubdomainGeneric to avoid triggering this separate invariant.
- **classificationRationale data loss (OPTIONAL FOLLOW-UP):** BoundedContextSketch carries no rationale getter, so `""` is passed. This means rationale from boundary detection is lost during the sketch-to-DomainBoundedContext conversion. Not blocking — rationale is optional — but worth tracking as a data fidelity improvement.
- **Related:** alty-cli-3k3 (E2E kura simulation round 3) — this bug was discovered during that simulation.

title: Epic: Domain Storytelling Discovery Redesign
description:
## Goal / Problem

alto's discovery flow is a rigid 10-question survey that fails users in two ways: (1) users with vague ideas hit a wall because questions assume domain knowledge, and (2) users with expertise feel interrogated rather than guided. The README promises "20 minutes of questions saves you 20 hours of rewrites" but the experience does not deliver.

This epic replaces the fixed question flow with a Domain Storytelling-based conversational discovery, inspired by gstack's consultant interaction patterns. The core shift: alto becomes a domain consultant that proposes stories and invites refinement, instead of a form wizard that asks blank questions.

Thesis: gstack owns "what to build" (scope, product vision). alto owns "how to structure it" (DDD, bounded contexts, tickets).

## DDD Alignment

| Bounded Context | Impact |
|----------------|--------|
| Discovery | Major rewrite: new domain model (DomainStory, StorySentence, BoundedContextSketch VOs), new flow strategy, new ports (DomainResearcher, StoryProposer, BoundaryDetector, StoryExporter), updated Prompter port for consultant pattern |
| Shared Kernel | New shared VOs: TrustLevel, UbiquitousLanguageEntry |
| Bootstrap | Updated to pass gstack CEO plan output into discovery (optional upstream) |
| Ticket Pipeline | Consumes new story-based artifacts instead of Q/A transcript (downstream, separate epic) |

Reference: docs/DDD.md (Story 1 steps 6-11 must be rewritten), docs/research/20260323_gstack_ux_and_domain_storytelling.md

## Success Metrics

- Discovery produces structured domain stories (.alto/stories/*.story.yaml) not Q/A transcripts
- Minimum 3 coarse-grained stories captured in RAPID mode (~15 min)
- Bounded context boundaries proposed with evidence (boundary signals, confidence scores)
- Ubiquitous language glossary built incrementally during storytelling
- Every element tagged with trust level (USER_STATED / USER_CONFIRMED / AI_RESEARCHED / AI_INFERRED)
- Users with vague ideas can complete discovery via AI domain research phase
- Generated DDD.md quality: bounded contexts with rationale, glossary, invariants, context map
- Existing CLI entry points (alto guide, alto guide --continue, alto guide --agent) continue to work with new flow

## Scope

**In scope**

Domain model:
- DomainStory, StorySentence, WorkObject, StoryActor, Annotation VOs
- BoundedContextSketch, BoundarySignal VOs
- UbiquitousLanguageEntry VO (shared kernel)
- TrustLevel enum and propagation (shared kernel)
- ConversationNarrative, ConversationTurn VOs (turn-by-turn record with synthesis)
- Updated DiscoverySession aggregate (stories + narrative instead of flat answers)

Flow:
- StorytellingFlow strategy (replaces FixedQuestionFlow as default)
- Context seed phase (auto-infer from README, optional gstack CEO plan)
- Mode selection (RAPID / THOROUGH / EXISTING)
- Moderator question patterns: "What happens next?", "Who does that?", "What do they use?"
- One-decision-per-interaction with re-grounding, recommendation, lettered options (gstack AskUserQuestion pattern)
- Synthesis checkpoints between phases (not mechanical every-3-answers playback)
- Coherence validation between stories

Boundary detection:
- Boundary signal analysis engine (one-way flow, language differences, different triggers, org boundaries)
- BoundedContextSketch proposal from accumulated stories
- Subdomain classification (Khononov decision tree + story complexity signals)

AI domain research:
- DomainResearcher port + web search adapter
- Research-then-propose flow for users lacking domain knowledge
- Trust level tagging on all AI-researched elements

Persistence and export:
- .story.yaml format definition and persistence
- .alto/glossary.yaml format
- .alto/context-map.yaml format
- Discovery report generation (.alto/discovery-report.md)
- PlantUML DST export (MIT-licensed DomainStory-PlantUML)
- Egon .egn JSON export

Infrastructure:
- Prompter port redesign for consultant pattern (propose-confirm instead of ask-record)
- CLIDiscoveryAdapter rewrite for story-driven flow
- HuhPrompter updates for new interaction pattern
- StdinPrompter updates for accessibility/CI
- AgentDiscoveryAdapter + JSONSessionRenderer updates for --agent mode
- FileSystemSessionRepository updates for story-based session format
- Session resume (--continue) working with new format

CLI:
- guide.go command updated for new flow
- --continue flag works with story-based sessions
- --agent flag works with new JSONL format

Documentation:
- docs/DDD.md updated: Story 1 steps 6-11 rewritten, glossary terms updated
- docs/DDD.md new terms: DomainStory, StorySentence, StoryActor, WorkObject, Annotation, BoundarySignal, BoundedContextSketch, TrustLevel, ConversationTurn, DomainResearcher, StoryProposer, BoundaryDetector

**Out of scope**

- gstack modifications (gstack is upstream, we consume its output)
- Artifact generation (DDD.md, PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md from stories) -- separate epic, consumes story output
- Ticket pipeline changes -- separate epic, consumes new artifacts
- MCP server discovery tool updates (alty-0m9.4 already closed, new epic needed)
- Fine-grained stories and business rules extraction (THOROUGH mode Phases 8-9) -- future work
- LLM integration for story proposal (StoryProposer initial implementation uses README parsing + template matching; LLM adapter is future work)

## Migration Strategy

The discovery bounded context has significant existing code. Strategy:

1. **Keep FixedQuestionFlow and ConversationalFlow** as legacy options (--legacy flag)
2. **StorytellingFlow becomes the new default**
3. **Question catalog (question.go)** kept but demoted -- moderator questions are dynamic, catalog serves as fallback structure
4. **Existing tests** adapted incrementally (not all-at-once rewrite)
5. **Prompter port** extended (new methods added), not replaced -- old methods marked deprecated
6. **Session format** versioned -- FileSystemSessionRepository detects v1 (Q/A) vs v2 (stories) and migrates on load

Files affected:
- internal/discovery/domain/: question.go, discovery_session.go, discovery_values.go, discovery_flow.go, fixed_question_flow.go, conversational_flow.go + new files
- internal/discovery/application/: discovery_handler.go + new ports
- internal/discovery/infrastructure/: cli_discovery_adapter.go, huh_prompter.go, stdin_prompter.go, agent_discovery_adapter.go, json_session_renderer.go, filesystem_session_repository.go, markdown_artifact_renderer.go + new adapters
- cmd/alto/commands/guide.go
- internal/composition/ (DI wiring for new ports)
- docs/DDD.md (Story 1, glossary)

## Phases / Milestones

### Phase 1: Domain Model Foundation
New VOs (DomainStory, StorySentence, StoryActor, WorkObject, Annotation, TrustLevel, BoundarySignal, BoundedContextSketch, UbiquitousLanguageEntry, ConversationTurn, ConversationNarrative). Updated DiscoverySession aggregate to hold stories. .story.yaml format definition and parser. RED/GREEN/REFACTOR for each VO.

### Phase 2: Story-Driven Flow
StorytellingFlow strategy. Moderator question patterns. Context seed with README inference. Mode selection (RAPID/THOROUGH/EXISTING). Prompter port extension for consultant pattern. CLIDiscoveryAdapter rewrite. Synthesis checkpoints. guide.go command updates.

### Phase 3: Boundary Detection and Classification
Boundary signal analysis engine. BoundedContextSketch proposal. Subdomain classification. Context map generation. Coherence validation between stories.

### Phase 4: AI Domain Research
DomainResearcher port + web search adapter. Research-then-propose flow. Trust level tagging on researched elements.

### Phase 5: Export and Persistence
.story.yaml persistence via FileSystemSessionRepository. .alto/glossary.yaml export. .alto/context-map.yaml export. Discovery report generation. PlantUML DST export. Egon .egn JSON export.

### Phase 6: Compatibility and Polish
Agent mode (--agent) updates for story-based JSONL. Session resume (--continue) with story format. StdinPrompter updates. Legacy --legacy flag for old flow. DDD.md updates. Integration tests.

## Child Tasks (planned)

To be created as individual tickets under this epic. All labeled "storytelling".

## Dependencies

- Spike alty-cli-jcf (CLOSED) -- research complete, informs all design decisions
- gstack installed at .claude/skills/gstack/ -- reference implementation for interaction patterns
- docs/research/20260323_gstack_ux_and_domain_storytelling.md -- consolidated design spec
- docs/research/20260323_domain_storytelling_methodology.md -- DST notation, DDD mapping, boundary heuristics
- docs/research/20260323_domain_storytelling_2025_2026_developments.md -- 2026 findings (Junker pipeline, tooling)

## Risks / Unknowns

Each risk has a blocking spike that must close before the epic's implementation phases begin.

| Risk | Spike | Blocks Phase |
|------|-------|-------------|
| DST in CLI is unprecedented + template matching quality unknown | alty-cli-gox (CLI DST moderator prototype) | Phase 2: Story-Driven Flow |
| Boundary detection heuristics may false-positive | alty-cli-uuw (Boundary detection heuristics validation) | Phase 3: Boundary Detection |
| .story.yaml format may not serve downstream consumers | alty-cli-1i3 (.story.yaml format and export validation) | Phase 1: Domain Model Foundation |
| AI domain research may fail for obscure domains | alty-cli-dh8 (AI domain research quality) | Phase 4: AI Domain Research |
| Existing tests need significant rework | No spike needed -- migration strategy covers this |
| Session format migration (v1 -> v2) could break saved sessions | Covered by alty-cli-1i3 (includes v1 -> v2 migration prototype) |

## Acceptance Criteria

### Domain Model
- [ ] DomainStory VO captures: title, type (coarse/fine), trigger, actors, work objects, sentences, annotations, variations
- [ ] StorySentence VO captures: sequence number, subject (actor), activity (verb), object (work object), optional preposition + indirect object
- [ ] Each story element (actor, work object, sentence, annotation) has a TrustLevel tag
- [ ] BoundedContextSketch captures: name, actors, work objects, sentence refs, boundary signals, classification, confidence score
- [ ] UbiquitousLanguageEntry captures: term, definition, owning context, trust source, story references
- [ ] ConversationTurn captures: consultant action, user response, synthesis, confirmation status

### Flow
- [ ] RAPID mode completes with 3 coarse-grained stories producing: actor list, work object inventory, glossary, bounded context sketches
- [ ] THOROUGH mode supports 5+ stories with fine-grained follow-ups for core subdomains
- [ ] EXISTING mode infers domain from codebase (README + code structure)
- [ ] AI moderator proposes stories (consultant pattern), user refines (not blank questions)
- [ ] One decision per interaction with re-grounding, plain-English explanation, recommendation, lettered options
- [ ] Synthesis checkpoints between phases (not mechanical every-3-answers)
- [ ] Coherence validation flags contradictions between stories (same term different meaning, missing actors, etc.)

### AI Domain Research
- [ ] Domain research phase bootstraps AI domain knowledge via web search when user opts in
- [ ] Researched elements tagged AI_RESEARCHED with source attribution
- [ ] Research is optional -- discovery works without it (graceful degradation)

### Boundary Detection
- [ ] Boundary detection proposes contexts from stories with evidence (boundary signals cited by story reference)
- [ ] Supports 4 signal types: one-way flow, language differences, different triggers, org boundaries
- [ ] Subdomain classification uses Khononov decision tree + story complexity signals
- [ ] Glossary built incrementally from story sentences, terms linked to bounded contexts

### Persistence and Export
- [ ] Stories persisted to .alto/stories/*.story.yaml in machine-readable format
- [ ] Glossary persisted to .alto/glossary.yaml
- [ ] Context map persisted to .alto/context-map.yaml
- [ ] Discovery report generated with trust distribution, boundary decision rationale, and story summary
- [ ] PlantUML DST export generates valid DomainStory-PlantUML syntax (MIT-licensed)
- [ ] Egon .egn JSON export generates valid Egon.io import format

### Compatibility
- [ ] alto guide works with new story-driven flow (default)
- [ ] alto guide --continue resumes story-based sessions
- [ ] alto guide --agent outputs story-based JSONL for non-interactive AI consumption
- [ ] alto guide --legacy falls back to old 10-question flow
- [ ] FileSystemSessionRepository detects and handles both v1 (Q/A) and v2 (story) session formats

### Documentation
- [ ] docs/DDD.md Story 1 steps 6-11 rewritten to reflect Domain Storytelling flow
- [ ] docs/DDD.md glossary updated with new terms (DomainStory, StorySentence, TrustLevel, BoundarySignal, etc.)

### Quality Gates
- [ ] For all code changes, quality gates pass before each task close:
  - [ ] go build ./...
  - [ ] go vet ./...
  - [ ] golangci-lint run ./...
  - [ ] go test ./... -race (>= 80% coverage for new code)
- [ ] Integration tests cover: full RAPID discovery flow end-to-end, boundary detection with multiple stories, session resume, agent mode
- [ ] QA done for each child task: happy path, edge cases (empty README, no actors found, conflicting stories), error handling, no regressions

See docs/research/20260323_cli_domain_storytelling_prototype.md Section 5.

title: Spike: DiscoverySession refactoring for conversational flow
description:
## Research Question

How should the DiscoverySession aggregate be refactored to support conversational (LLM-driven) discovery alongside the existing 10-question flow?

Key questions:
1. Should `ConversationState` replace or extend `DiscoverySession`?
2. How do we preserve the existing phase ordering, playback, and MVP invariants?
3. Can the aggregate support both fixed-question and adaptive-question modes via strategy pattern?
4. What is the minimal domain model change that enables conversational flow without breaking existing tests?

## Timebox

**Timebox:** 3 hours

## Background / Context

- Grooming of alty-cli-f0g.4 revealed this is a major refactor, not a feature addition
- `DiscoverySession` has a rich state machine: StatusCreated -> StatusPersonaDetected -> StatusAnswering -> StatusPlaybackPending -> StatusCompleted
- It enforces phase ordering (`enforcePhaseOrder`), playback every 3 answers, MVP question checks
- The existing aggregate is tightly coupled to 10 fixed questions (`questionPhases`, `answers`, `playbackInterval`)
- "GapAnalysis" term already exists in Rescue context — using it in Discovery would create ambiguity
- The `CLIDiscoveryAdapter` tightly couples question asking with answer processing (lines 73-129)

## Investigation Approach

1. Read `internal/discovery/domain/discovery_session.go` — map all invariants and state transitions
2. Read `internal/discovery/domain/question.go` — understand question catalog structure
3. Evaluate strategy pattern: `FixedQuestionStrategy` vs `ConversationalStrategy` implementing a common interface
4. Evaluate whether playback invariant makes sense for conversational flow
5. Draft the refactored aggregate interface
6. Assess test impact (how many existing tests break?)

## Expected Deliverables

- [ ] DiscoverySession invariant map (which invariants apply to which mode)
- [ ] Proposed refactoring approach (strategy pattern, mode flag, or separate aggregate)
- [ ] Interface draft for the conversational path
- [ ] Test impact assessment (number of tests, expected breakage)
- [ ] Follow-up ticket updates for f0g.4

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Research questions answered
- [ ] Refactoring approach documented with trade-offs
- [ ] f0g.4 updated with correct scope and design
- [ ] Timebox respected
notes:
## Grooming Notes (2026-03-14, Project Manager)

### Codebase Investigation Results

#### 1. State Machine (discovery_session.go)

10 states total:
- StatusCreated -> StatusPersonaDetected (via DetectPersona)
- StatusPersonaDetected -> StatusAnswering (via AnswerQuestion)
- StatusAnswering -> StatusPlaybackPending (auto, every 3 answers)
- StatusPlaybackPending -> StatusAnswering (via ConfirmPlayback)
- StatusAnswering -> StatusCompleted (EXPRESS: via Complete, requires MVP questions)
- StatusAnswering -> StatusRound1Complete (DEEP: via Complete)
- StatusRound1Complete -> StatusChallenging (DEEP: via StartChallenge)
- StatusChallenging -> StatusRound2Complete (via CompleteChallenge)
- StatusRound2Complete -> StatusSimulating (DEEP: via StartSimulate)
- StatusSimulating -> StatusCompleted (via CompleteSimulation)
- StatusCancelled (terminal, no transition to it currently)

Two paths through the state machine:
- EXPRESS: Created -> PersonaDetected -> Answering <-> PlaybackPending -> Completed
- DEEP: Created -> PersonaDetected -> Answering <-> PlaybackPending -> Round1Complete -> Challenging -> Round2Complete -> Simulating -> Completed

#### 2. Invariants Enumerated (discovery_session.go)

| # | Invariant | Lines | Applies to Conversational? |
|---|-----------|-------|---------------------------|
| I1 | Cannot answer before persona detection | L239-241 | YES - persona still needed |
| I2 | Phase order enforced (Actors->Story->Events->Boundaries) | L260-269, L440-471 | NO - adaptive ordering needed |
| I3 | Playback after every 3 answers | L275-277, const L43 | MAYBE - different cadence |
| I4 | Cannot answer/skip during PlaybackPending | L242-244, L283-285 | MAYBE - depends on design |
| I5 | Skip requires non-empty reason | L293-295 | YES - still valid |
| I6 | Duplicate answer rejected | L253-257 | YES - still valid |
| I7 | Empty answer rejected | L248-249 | YES - still valid |
| I8 | Complete requires MVP questions (Q1,Q3,Q4,Q9,Q10) | L320-335 | RETHINK - different MVP for conversational |
| I9 | Mode set-once in CREATED state | L209-218 | YES - still valid |
| I10 | TechStack only in CREATED/PERSONA_DETECTED | L199-206 | YES - still valid |
| I11 | ClassifyBoundedContext only in COMPLETED/ROUND_1_COMPLETE | L407-411 | YES - still valid |
| I12 | Event emitted only at terminal COMPLETED | L347,398 | YES - still valid |

#### 3. Question Catalog (question.go)

- 10 fixed questions: Q1-Q10
- 4 phases: Actors(Q1,Q2), Story(Q3,Q4,Q5), Events(Q6,Q7,Q8), Boundaries(Q9,Q10)
- 5 MVP questions: Q1, Q3, Q4, Q9, Q10
- Dual-register phrasing (technical/non-technical) per question
- Each question declares what domain artifacts it "produces"
- questionCatalog is a package-level singleton slice

#### 4. Test Count and Impact Assessment

Total tests in discovery context: 291 across 19 test files

Directly impacted by DiscoverySession refactor:
- discovery_session_test.go: 98 tests (MOST will need updating)
- discovery_handler_test.go: 9 tests (depend on session API)
- cli_discovery_adapter_test.go: 13 tests (depend on session + catalog)
- tools_discovery_test.go (MCP): 31 tests (depend on session API)
- cross_context_test.go: 5 tests (1-2 reference DiscoverySession)
- ports_test.go: compile-time checks

Estimated direct impact: ~156 tests across 6 files
Indirectly impacted (question catalog changes): question_test.go (11), classification_question_test.go (14)

#### 5. Files the Researcher MUST Read

| File | Lines | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| internal/discovery/domain/discovery_session.go | ALL (793 lines) | Aggregate root, all invariants, state machine, snapshot serialization |
| internal/discovery/domain/question.go | ALL (117 lines) | Fixed catalog, MVP set, phase ordering |
| internal/discovery/domain/discovery_values.go | ALL (242 lines) | All VOs: Answer, Playback, QuestionPhase, DiscoveryMode, DiscoveryRound |
| internal/discovery/domain/classification_question.go | ALL (145 lines) | Classification decision tree, question types |
| internal/discovery/application/ports.go | ALL (82 lines) | Discovery port interface (must evolve) |
| internal/discovery/application/discovery_handler.go | ALL (123 lines) | Handler orchestration |
| internal/discovery/infrastructure/cli_discovery_adapter.go | ALL (160 lines) | CLI adapter (hardcoded 10-question loop L72-129) |
| internal/mcp/tools_discovery.go | Skim | MCP tool wrappers (depend on handler API) |

#### 6. Coupling Hotspots

1. **questionPhases var** (discovery_session.go L30): Hardcoded phase ordering used by enforcePhaseOrder. Conversational mode must bypass this.
2. **QuestionCatalog() singleton** (question.go L89): CLI adapter iterates this directly (cli_discovery_adapter.go L72). Conversational mode needs dynamic question generation.
3. **playbackInterval const** (discovery_session.go L43): Hardcoded to 3. Conversational flow may want different cadence or no fixed interval.
4. **MVPQuestionIDs** (question.go L105): Hardcoded Q1,Q3,Q4,Q9,Q10. Conversational mode needs equivalent concept but not tied to fixed IDs.
5. **Discovery port interface** (ports.go L16-34): Methods assume fixed-question flow (AnswerQuestion with questionID). Conversational flow needs different API.

#### 7. Corrections to Investigation Approach

The ticket's investigation approach is good but should add:
- Step 3b: Evaluate the MCP layer impact (tools_discovery.go has 31 tests using the current API)

title: Spike: Doc Import bounded context placement
description:
## Research Question

Where should the "doc import" capability live in alty's DDD architecture? Parsing existing markdown docs into a domain model is NOT "Guided Discovery" (which owns the conversational Q&A flow). Options:

1. New "DocImport" bounded context
2. Extend "Domain Model" context to accept multiple input sources
3. Anti-corruption layer between docs and `*ddd.DomainModel`
4. Extend Guided Discovery with a non-conversational input path

## Timebox

**Timebox:** 2 hours

## Background / Context

- Grooming of alty-cli-623.2 (alty import) revealed the BC is wrong
- DDD.md defines Guided Discovery as: "Owns the conversational DDD question flow"
- Parsing existing docs is a fundamentally different input path
- The existing `ArtifactGenerationHandler` takes `DiscoveryCompletedEvent` as input — import cannot produce this event because there was no discovery session
- `TicketGenerationHandler.BuildPreview()` and `FitnessGenerationHandler` take `*ddd.DomainModel` directly — this is the natural integration point
- Existing parser code: `internal/fitness/infrastructure/bounded_context_map_parser.go`

## Investigation Approach

1. Map the existing domain model creation paths (Discovery -> Event -> buildModel -> DomainModel)
2. Identify the minimal interface needed for doc import (what does it produce?)
3. Evaluate each BC placement option against DDD principles (cohesion, coupling, bounded context autonomy)
4. Check if any existing context already owns "external model ingestion"
5. Draft the port interface and adapter placement

## Expected Deliverables

- [ ] Decision on bounded context placement with rationale
- [ ] Port interface draft (DocImporter or equivalent)
- [ ] Adapter placement (which infrastructure/ directory)
- [ ] Impact on existing contexts documented
- [ ] Follow-up ticket updates for 623.2 and 623.3

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Research question answered with architectural justification
- [ ] Decision documented (can be in ticket notes, no separate report needed)
- [ ] 623.2 and 623.3 updated with correct BC
- [ ] Timebox respected
notes:
## Grooming Notes (2026-03-14, Project Manager)

### Codebase Investigation Findings

**1. Domain Model creation path confirmed:**
- `ArtifactGenerationHandler.BuildPreview()` takes `discoverydomain.DiscoveryCompletedEvent` (line 63-66, internal/discovery/application/artifact_generation_handler.go)
- Internally calls `buildModel(event)` which constructs `*ddd.DomainModel` from discovery answers (line 195-231)
- The `buildModel` function is tightly coupled to discovery Q&A answers (Q1-Q10 extraction functions)
- Doc import CANNOT produce a `DiscoveryCompletedEvent` because there was no conversational session

**2. `*ddd.DomainModel` is the universal integration point:**
- `TicketGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model *ddd.DomainModel, profile vo.StackProfile)` — takes DomainModel directly (internal/ticket/application/ticket_generation_handler.go:39-42)
- `FitnessGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model *ddd.DomainModel, ...)` — takes DomainModel directly (internal/fitness/application/fitness_generation_handler.go:51-56)
- Both downstream consumers are DomainModel-in, artifacts-out. They do NOT need a DiscoveryCompletedEvent.

**3. No separate "Domain Model" bounded context directory exists:**
- `internal/` contains: bootstrap, challenge, composition, discovery, dochealth, fitness, integration, knowledge, mcp, rescue, research, shared, ticket, tooltranslation
- `DomainModel` aggregate and `UbiquitousLanguage` entity live in `internal/shared/domain/ddd/` (shared kernel)
- The DDD.md defines "Domain Model" as a separate bounded context, but the code puts it in shared kernel, not its own context directory
- This is a deliberate design: DomainModel is a shared type consumed by multiple contexts

**4. Existing doc parser precedent:**
- `internal/fitness/infrastructure/bounded_context_map_parser.go` — parses `bounded_context_map.yaml` into `domain.BoundedContextMap`
- This parser reads YAML, not markdown. Doc import needs a MARKDOWN parser for DDD.md
- The fitness parser is a good structural example for port/adapter pattern

**5. Event flow confirmation:**
- `DomainModelGenerated` event triggers fitness, ticket, and config generation (internal/composition/event_subscribers.go:148-149)
- Doc import could either: (a) construct a DomainModel and emit DomainModelGenerated, or (b) construct a DomainModel and pass directly to handlers
- Option (b) is simpler since `BuildPreview` methods already accept `*ddd.DomainModel` directly

### Investigation Approach Corrections

The ticket's investigation approach is sound. Add these specific file reads for the researcher:

**Must-read files:**
- `internal/shared/domain/ddd/domain_model.go` — DomainModel aggregate (the type doc import must produce)
- `internal/shared/domain/ddd/ubiquitous_language.go` — UbiquitousLanguage entity inside DomainModel
- `internal/shared/domain/valueobjects/` — DomainBoundedContext, DomainStory, AggregateDesign, ContextRelationship VOs
- `internal/discovery/application/artifact_generation_handler.go` — the only current DomainModel factory (buildModel function, lines 195-231)
- `internal/fitness/application/fitness_generation_handler.go` — consumer example (takes *ddd.DomainModel)
- `internal/ticket/application/ticket_generation_handler.go` — consumer example (takes *ddd.DomainModel)
- `internal/fitness/infrastructure/bounded_context_map_parser.go` — existing parser adapter pattern
- `internal/composition/app.go` — wiring/DI to understand how handlers connect
- `internal/composition/event_subscribers.go` — event routing for DomainModelGenerated

**Key design tension to resolve:**
- DDD.md defines "Domain Model" as a bounded context with its own aggregate, but the code puts DomainModel in `internal/shared/domain/ddd/` (shared kernel)
- The question is whether doc import should: (a) live in a new DocImport context that produces `*ddd.DomainModel`, (b) extend shared kernel with a new factory, or (c) live in an existing context
- The researcher should evaluate this against the DDD rule that `*ddd.DomainModel` is already shared kernel — adding a new factory there vs adding a new BC that depends on shared kernel

### Template Compliance Notes

- Missing: "Research Guidelines for AI Agents" section (from spike template)
- Missing: Findings template reference (research report should go to docs/research/20260314_doc_import_bc_placement.md)
- The "Expected Deliverables" section says "can be in ticket notes, no separate report needed" — this contradicts the spike template which expects docs/research/ output. Recommend keeping lightweight: decision in notes is acceptable for a 2-hour spike, but findings should still be structured.

title: Add --from-docs flag to all generate commands
description:
## Goal / Problem

`alty generate tickets|fitness|configs` are stubs that print "run alty guide first". Add `--from-docs` flag so these commands can read `docs/DDD.md` via `DocImportHandler` and use the parsed `DomainModel` directly, bypassing discovery.

## Background / Context

- 623.2 delivered `DocImportHandler.Import(ctx, docDir) → *ImportResult` with `.Model() → *ddd.DomainModel`
- All three handlers accept `*ddd.DomainModel`:
  - `TicketGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model, profile)`
  - `FitnessGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model, projectName, profile, opts)`
  - `ConfigGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model, tools, profile)`
- `ArtifactGenerationHandler` is EXCLUDED — it requires `DiscoveryCompletedEvent`, not a bare model. Doc-based artifact generation is a different flow.
- `StackProfile` needed by all three — use `stack.DetectProfile("")`
- Generate commands are currently stubs at `cmd/alty/commands/generate.go:29-79`

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | CLI layer (commands) — orchestrates cross-BC calls |
| Ubiquitous Language | DocImport, DomainModel, BuildPreview |
| Layer | CLI (flag handling) → Application (handler calls) |

## Design

### Flag Behavior

```bash
# Import from docs and generate tickets
alty generate tickets --from-docs
# Reads docs/DDD.md → parses model → BuildPreview → displays preview

# Custom docs directory  
alty generate tickets --from-docs --docs-dir path/to/docs

# Without flag — still shows "run alty guide first" (unchanged)
alty generate tickets
```

### Scope

| Command | --from-docs | Why |
|---------|-------------|-----|
| `generate tickets` | YES | Accepts `*ddd.DomainModel` |
| `generate fitness` | YES | Accepts `*ddd.DomainModel` |
| `generate configs` | YES | Accepts `*ddd.DomainModel` |
| `generate artifacts` | NO | Requires `DiscoveryCompletedEvent` — different data path |

### Implementation Pattern (same for all 3)

```go
func newGenerateTicketsCmd(app *composition.App) *cobra.Command {
    var fromDocs bool
    var docsDir string
    
    cmd := &cobra.Command{
        Use:   "tickets",
        Short: "Generate dependency-ordered beads tickets from DDD",
        RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
            if !fromDocs {
                return fmt.Errorf("requires a domain model. Use --from-docs or run \"alty guide\" first")
            }
            // 1. Import model from docs
            result, err := app.DocImportHandler.Import(cmd.Context(), docsDir)
            if err != nil { return err }
            model := result.Model()
            
            // 2. Detect stack profile
            profile := stack.DetectProfile("")
            
            // 3. BuildPreview
            preview, err := app.TicketGenerationHandler.BuildPreview(model, profile)
            if err != nil { return err }
            
            // 4. Display preview summary
            w := cmd.OutOrStdout()
            fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s\n", preview.Summary())
            return nil
        },
    }
    cmd.Flags().BoolVar(&fromDocs, "from-docs", false, "Import model from docs/DDD.md instead of discovery")
    cmd.Flags().StringVar(&docsDir, "docs-dir", "docs", "Directory containing DDD.md")
    return cmd
}
```

### Preview-Only for Now

This ticket implements **preview display only** (BuildPreview + print summary). The approve-and-write flow (interactive confirmation → file output) is a follow-up. Reason: the stubs currently do nothing — getting to preview is the valuable step.

### Key Files

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `cmd/alty/commands/generate.go` | Replace stubs with --from-docs handler calls for tickets/fitness/configs |
| No new files needed | Reuses existing DocImportHandler + handlers |

### Handler Signatures (verified)

```go
// TicketGenerationHandler
BuildPreview(model *ddd.DomainModel, profile vo.StackProfile) (*TicketPreview, error)

// FitnessGenerationHandler  
BuildPreview(model *ddd.DomainModel, projectName string, profile vo.StackProfile, opts *BuildPreviewOptions) (*FitnessPreview, error)

// ConfigGenerationHandler
BuildPreview(model *ddd.DomainModel, tools []ttdomain.SupportedTool, profile vo.StackProfile) (*ConfigPreview, error)
```

### Config-Specific: Tools List

`ConfigGenerationHandler.BuildPreview` needs `[]ttdomain.SupportedTool`. Use tool detection: `app.DetectionHandler.Detect(".")` returns detected tools, which can be mapped to `SupportedTool` values. Or use a default set. Check what `SupportedTool` values exist.

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

```go
// Test with real docs in temp dir
TestGenerateTicketsFromDocs_WhenValidDDD_PrintsPreviewSummary
TestGenerateTicketsFromDocs_WhenMissingDDD_ReturnsError
TestGenerateFitnessFromDocs_WhenValidDDD_PrintsPreviewSummary
TestGenerateConfigsFromDocs_WhenValidDDD_PrintsPreviewSummary
TestGenerateTickets_WhenNoFlag_ReturnsError
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Add `--from-docs` and `--docs-dir` flags to tickets/fitness/configs commands
2. Wire DocImportHandler.Import → model extraction → BuildPreview → print summary
3. Keep artifacts command unchanged (stub)

### REFACTOR Phase

- Extract shared `importModelFromDocs(app, ctx, docsDir)` helper if pattern duplicates

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Enforcement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **S** | Each command handles its own flag + handler call |
| **O** | --from-docs adds new path without modifying discovery flow |
| **L** | All handlers accept same `*ddd.DomainModel` type |
| **I** | DocImportHandler port stays focused on import |
| **D** | Commands depend on handler interfaces via App struct |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `alty generate tickets --from-docs` imports DDD.md and prints ticket preview
- [ ] `alty generate fitness --from-docs` imports DDD.md and prints fitness preview
- [ ] `alty generate configs --from-docs` imports DDD.md and prints config preview
- [ ] `--docs-dir` flag customizes docs directory (default: "docs")
- [ ] Missing DDD.md produces clear error
- [ ] Without --from-docs, commands return error with guidance message
- [ ] `generate artifacts` unchanged (still shows stub message)

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| No DDD.md | --from-docs with empty dir | Error: "reading DDD.md: ..." |
| Empty DDD.md | --from-docs with empty file | Error: "no bounded contexts found" |
| Valid DDD.md | --from-docs with contexts | Preview summary printed |
| No flag | Plain command | Error: "requires a domain model. Use --from-docs..." |
| Custom dir | --docs-dir /tmp/foo | Reads /tmp/foo/DDD.md |

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] Read `cmd/alty/commands/generate.go` — current stubs
- [ ] Read ticket/fitness/config handler BuildPreview signatures
- [ ] Read `stack.DetectProfile` — how to get StackProfile
- [ ] Check what `ttdomain.SupportedTool` values exist
- [ ] Verify `DocImportHandler.Import` returns model compatible with handlers

## QA Before Close

- [ ] `go build ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `go vet ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` — zero issues
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` — all pass

## Risks / Dependencies

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Model from import may be less complete than discovery model | Preview shows what was parsed — user can inspect |
| ConfigGenerationHandler needs tools list | Use detection or empty list |
| FitnessGenerationHandler needs projectName | Use `filepath.Base(cwd)` |
close_reason: Phase 3 complete. All gates pass. Code reviewed, zero findings.

title: Implement alty import command to parse existing docs
description:

title: Implement answer ingestion from file or pipe for agent mode
description:
## Goal / Problem

After `alty guide --agent` emits questions as JSONL, an AI tool collects answers. This ticket implements the ingest side: reading answers from a file or stdin and driving the discovery session to completion.

## Background / Context

- 4hk.2 delivered: `AgentDiscoveryAdapter` emits 13-line JSONL with envelope `{"type":"...","data":...}`
- Session persisted to `.alty/discovery_session.json` via `FileSystemSessionRepository`
- `JSONSessionRenderer` has parse methods: `ParseAnswerInput`, `ParsePersonaResponse`, `ParsePlaybackResponse`
- `DiscoveryHandler` has: `LoadOrGetSession`, `DetectPersona`, `AnswerQuestion`, `SkipQuestion`, `ConfirmPlayback`, `Complete`
- Playback triggers every 3 ANSWERS (skips don't increment counter) — `playbackInterval = 3` at `discovery_session.go:43`
- `Complete()` requires `StatusAnswering` + all MVP questions answered (Q1, Q3, Q4, Q9, Q10)
- **Pattern reference:** `cmd/alty/commands/guide.go:83-90` (existing `runGuideAgent` emit function)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | AnswerIngestion, AgentMode, SessionReplay |
| Layer | CLI (guide.go — flag handling + ingestion orchestration) |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| `envelope` | Infrastructure struct | JSONL wrapper `{"type":"...","data":...}` — reuse from `agent_discovery_adapter.go:40-43` |
| `AnswerInput` | Domain VO | Agent answer — `agent_schema.go:18-24` |
| `PersonaResponse` | Domain VO | Persona selection — `agent_schema.go:35-38` |
| `PlaybackResponse` | Domain VO | Playback confirmation — `agent_schema.go:48-51` |

No new domain types needed. All types already exist.

### Sequence / Flow

```
CLI (guide.go)          SessionRepo         DiscoveryHandler       Domain Session
    |                       |                      |                      |
    |-- Load(ctx,"") ------>|                      |                      |
    |<-- session -----------|                      |                      |
    |-- LoadOrGetSession ---|--------------------->|                      |
    |                       |                      |-- cache in memory -->|
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | [for each JSONL line:]|                      |                      |
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | persona_response:     |                      |                      |
    |-- DetectPersona ------|--------------------->|-- DetectPersona ---->|
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | answer (not skipped): |                      |                      |
    |-- AnswerQuestion -----|--------------------->|-- AnswerQuestion --->|
    |                       |                      |<-- persist ---------|
    |<-- session (check status)                    |                      |
    | [if StatusPlaybackPending: auto-confirm]     |                      |
    |-- ConfirmPlayback ----|--------------------->|-- ConfirmPlayback ->|
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | answer (skipped):     |                      |                      |
    |-- SkipQuestion -------|--------------------->|-- SkipQuestion ---->|
    |                       |                      |<-- persist ---------|
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | [after all lines:]    |                      |                      |
    | [if StatusAnswering + all MVP answered:]     |                      |
    |-- Complete ---------->|--------------------->|-- Complete -------->|
    |                       |                      |<-- events published-|
    |                       |                      |                      |
    | [emit final status JSON to stdout]           |                      |
```

### Input Format (JSONL envelope)

```jsonl
{"type":"persona_response","data":{"session_id":"abc","choice":"1"}}
{"type":"answer","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q1","answer":"developers and API clients"}}
{"type":"answer","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q2","answer":"orders, products, users"}}
{"type":"answer","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q3","answer":"user places an order"}}
{"type":"answer","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q4","skipped":true,"skip_reason":"not sure yet"}}
...
```

Playback_response lines are OPTIONAL — agent auto-confirms when StatusPlaybackPending.

### CLI Integration

Add `--ingest` string flag to guide command:

```
cmd.Flags().String("ingest", "", "Ingest answers from file (or \"-\" for stdin)")
```

Branching in `runGuide`:
- `--agent && --ingest != ""` -> `runGuideAgentIngest(ctx, app, ingestPath, cmd.OutOrStdout())`
- `--agent` (no ingest) -> `runGuideAgent(ctx, app)` (existing emit)
- `--ingest` without `--agent` -> error

### Session Loading Strategy

`FileSystemSessionRepository.Load(ctx, "")` ignores the sessionID parameter (loads the single session file at `.alty/discovery_session.json`). Use this to load the session, then `LoadOrGetSession(session.SessionID())` to register it in the handler's in-memory map.

This is the SAME pattern used by `runGuideContinue` at `guide.go:75-96`.

### Auto-Confirm Playback

After each `AnswerQuestion` call, check returned session status:
```go
session, err := handler.AnswerQuestion(sessionID, qID, answer)
if session.Status() == domain.StatusPlaybackPending {
    session, err = handler.ConfirmPlayback(sessionID, true)
}
```

This eliminates playback_response from the agent protocol entirely. Agents just send persona + answers.

### Complete Strategy

After processing all lines:
1. Check `session.Status() == domain.StatusAnswering` (not PlaybackPending, not Created)
2. Check all MVP questions answered (can call `Complete` and handle the error gracefully)
3. If complete succeeds -> emit final status
4. If complete fails (partial answers) -> emit status showing partial state, no error

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S** | `runGuideAgentIngest` has one job: read JSONL, dispatch to handler |
| **O** | Adds new code path without modifying emit or interactive flows |
| **L** | Uses same DiscoveryHandler interface as all other modes |
| **I** | Reuses existing JSONSessionRenderer parse methods (no new interface) |
| **D** | Depends on handler (application), not session storage (infrastructure) |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

```go
// cmd/alty/commands/guide_test.go (or guide_agent_test.go)
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenPersonaAndAllAnswers_CompletesSession
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenSkippedAnswer_CallsSkipQuestion
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenPlaybackPending_AutoConfirms
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenMismatchedSessionID_ReturnsError
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenNoSessionFile_ReturnsError
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenStdinDash_ReadsStdin
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenInvalidJSON_ReturnsErrorWithLineNumber
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenPartialAnswers_SavesPartialState
TestGuideAgentIngest_WhenUnknownEnvelopeType_ReturnsError
```

Run: `go test ./cmd/alty/commands/... -run TestGuideAgentIngest -race` -> should FAIL

### GREEN Phase

1. Add `--ingest` flag to guide command in `NewGuideCmd`
2. Parse flag in RunE, pass to `runGuide`
3. Branch: `if agentMode && ingest != ""` -> `runGuideAgentIngest`
4. Implement `runGuideAgentIngest(ctx, app, ingestPath, writer)`:
   a. Load session from FileSystemSessionRepository
   b. Register in handler via LoadOrGetSession
   c. Open file or stdin
   d. Scan lines, parse envelope, dispatch by type
   e. Auto-confirm playback after each answer
   f. Attempt Complete after all lines
   g. Emit final status JSON

Run: `go test ./cmd/alty/commands/... -run TestGuideAgentIngest -race` -> should PASS

### REFACTOR Phase

- Ensure all output goes to `io.Writer` (cmd.OutOrStdout), not fmt.Println
- Extract dispatch logic if switch is > 30 lines
- Verify error messages include line numbers for debugging

## Steps

1. Add `--ingest` string flag to `NewGuideCmd` in `cmd/alty/commands/guide.go`
2. Update `runGuide` signature or read flag inside RunE — branch to `runGuideAgentIngest`
3. Implement `runGuideAgentIngest(ctx context.Context, app *composition.App, ingestPath string, w io.Writer) error`
4. Import `envelope` type from `agent_discovery_adapter.go` (it's unexported — need to either export it or duplicate the struct)
5. Implement line-by-line JSONL parsing with `bufio.Scanner`
6. Dispatch by envelope type: persona_response, answer, playback_response (optional)
7. After each AnswerQuestion: check StatusPlaybackPending -> auto ConfirmPlayback
8. After all lines: attempt Complete (catch MVP-not-answered gracefully)
9. Render final session status via JSONSessionRenderer.RenderSessionStatus
10. Write tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `alty guide --agent --ingest answers.jsonl` processes answer file
- [ ] `cat answers.jsonl | alty guide --agent --ingest -` reads from stdin
- [ ] Persona response processed correctly
- [ ] Answers drive AnswerQuestion on handler
- [ ] Skipped answers drive SkipQuestion on handler
- [ ] Playback auto-confirmed (agents don't need playback_response lines)
- [ ] Session ID validated against loaded session
- [ ] No existing session returns clear error
- [ ] Final session status emitted as JSON envelope to stdout
- [ ] Invalid JSON lines return error with line number
- [ ] Partial answers leave session in partial state (no forced Complete)

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected Output |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| No session file | --ingest without prior --agent | Error: "no session found" |
| Wrong session_id | Mismatched ID in answers | Error: "session ID mismatch: expected X, got Y" |
| Empty file | 0 lines | Session unchanged, emit current status |
| Missing persona | Answers before persona_response | Error from domain: "cannot answer before persona detected" |
| Invalid JSON line | Malformed line | Error: "line N: invalid JSON: ..." |
| Partial answers | Only 5 of 10 answered | Session saved partial, status emitted, exit 0 |
| All MVP answered | Q1,Q3,Q4,Q9,Q10 + others | Session completed, final status emitted |
| Duplicate question | Q1 answered twice | Error from domain: "already answered" |
| Unknown envelope type | `{"type":"foo",...}` | Error: "line N: unknown response type \"foo\"" |
| --ingest without --agent | Missing --agent flag | Error: "--ingest requires --agent" |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race
```

- [ ] All gates pass
- [ ] Edge cases have test coverage

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [x] `agent_discovery_adapter.go:40-43` — envelope struct is unexported. Must export or duplicate. Recommendation: export as `AgentEnvelope` or duplicate a `responseEnvelope` in guide.go (simpler, avoids changing existing file).
- [x] `json_session_renderer.go:117-142` — ParseAnswerInput([]byte) -> (*AnswerInput, error), ParsePersonaResponse([]byte) -> (*PersonaResponse, error), ParsePlaybackResponse([]byte) -> (*PlaybackResponse, error). All confirmed.
- [x] `discovery_handler.go:52-118` — DetectPersona, AnswerQuestion, SkipQuestion, ConfirmPlayback, Complete all return (*DiscoverySession, error). LoadOrGetSession at line 123.
- [x] `discovery_session.go:275-277` — Playback triggers at `answersSinceLastPlayback >= 3`. SkipQuestion does NOT increment counter (only AnswerQuestion does at line 272).
- [x] `discovery_session.go:329` — Complete requires StatusAnswering. MVP check at lines 334-349.
- [x] `filesystem_session_repository.go:52-53` — Load ignores sessionID, reads single file. Same pattern as guide.go:85.
- [x] `guide.go:75-96` — runGuideContinue loads session same way. Precedent for this pattern.

## QA Before Close

- [ ] Happy path: persona + 10 answers -> session complete
- [ ] Partial path: persona + 5 answers -> session saved partial
- [ ] Skip path: persona + answers with some skipped -> correct handling
- [ ] Playback auto-confirm verified (no playback_response needed in input)
- [ ] Error paths: no session, wrong ID, bad JSON, unknown type
- [ ] No regressions in existing guide --agent emit functionality
- [ ] Domain layer has no new external dependencies (no changes to domain)

## Risks / Dependencies

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| envelope struct is unexported | Duplicate struct in guide.go (3 lines, no export change) |
| Domain enforces phase order | Agents must send answers in Q1-Q10 order; error message is clear |
| SkipQuestion doesn't count toward playback | Documented; auto-confirm only fires after AnswerQuestion |
| Complete may fail on partial answers | Catch error gracefully, emit partial status |

title: Implement --agent flag for guide command with JSON output
description:
## Goal / Problem

`alty guide --agent` emits the full discovery session as structured JSONL to stdout. AI coding tools read each line, process it, and pipe answers back (4hk.3). This is the emit-only half — no stdin reading.

## Background / Context

- Issue 3 from .notes/issues.md
- 4hk.1 delivered: 6 schema types in `discovery/domain/agent_schema.go`, `JSONSessionRenderer` adapter with render/parse methods
- Session persistence exists via `FileSystemSessionRepository` + `WithSessionRepository` option
- `CLIDiscoveryAdapter` orchestrates the interactive flow — agent mode needs a parallel non-interactive adapter

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | AgentMode, JSONSessionRenderer, QuestionOutput, SessionStatusOutput |
| Layer | Infrastructure (agent adapter) + CLI (--agent flag) |

## Design

### Output Protocol (JSONL)

Each line is a self-contained JSON object with a `type` field for dispatch:

```jsonl
{"type":"session_status","data":{"session_id":"abc","status":"created","questions_total":10,"answered":0,"skipped":0,"next_action":"persona_detection"}}
{"type":"persona_prompt","data":{"session_id":"abc","prompt":"Which best describes you?","choices":["Developer (technical background)","Product Owner (defines what to build)","Domain Expert (business knowledge)","Mixed / Other"]}}
{"type":"question","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q1","question_text":"Who are the actors...","question_type":"open","phase":"actors","required":true,"skip_allowed":true}}
{"type":"question","data":{"session_id":"abc","question_id":"Q2",...}}
...
{"type":"session_status","data":{"session_id":"abc","status":"created","questions_total":10,"answered":0,"skipped":0,"next_action":"persona_detection"}}
```

The agent emits ALL questions at once (no stdin wait). The AI tool collects answers and pipes them back via 4hk.3.

### Architecture

New `AgentDiscoveryAdapter` in `discovery/infrastructure/`:
- Takes: `*DiscoveryHandler`, `io.Writer` (for testability, defaults to `os.Stdout`)
- `Run(ctx) error` method:
  1. Read README.md from projectDir
  2. Start session via handler
  3. Emit session status (next_action: persona_detection)
  4. Emit persona prompt
  5. Emit all 10 questions (using `JSONSessionRenderer.RenderQuestion`)
  6. Emit final session status (next_action: persona_detection — still needs persona before answering)
  7. Persist session via `SessionRepository`
  8. Return nil (exit 0)

### Key Files

| File | Change | Owner |
|------|--------|-------|
| `cmd/alty/commands/guide.go` | Add `--agent` flag, branch to `runGuideAgent()` | this ticket |
| `internal/discovery/infrastructure/agent_discovery_adapter.go` | NEW — emit-only adapter | this ticket |
| `internal/discovery/infrastructure/agent_discovery_adapter_test.go` | NEW — tests | this ticket |

### No Shared File Conflicts

- `guide.go` is only modified by this ticket
- New files in `discovery/infrastructure/` — no overlap with other tickets
- Does NOT modify `discovery_handler.go` or `agent_schema.go`

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

```go
// Adapter tests
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_EmitsSessionStatus
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_EmitsPersonaPrompt
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_EmitsAllQuestions
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_EmitsFinalStatus
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_EachLineIsValidJSON
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenReadmeExists_SessionPersisted
TestAgentDiscoveryAdapter_Run_WhenNoReadme_ReturnsError

// CLI integration
TestGuideCmd_WhenAgentFlag_OutputsJSONL
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Create `AgentDiscoveryAdapter` struct with `Run(ctx) error`
2. Use `JSONSessionRenderer` for all rendering
3. Write each rendered JSON as a line with envelope `{"type":"...","data":...}`
4. Add `--agent` flag to guide.go, branch in `runGuide()`

### REFACTOR Phase

- Extract JSONL line writer if envelope logic is repeated
- Verify all output goes to `io.Writer` (never `fmt.Println`)

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Enforcement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **S** | `AgentDiscoveryAdapter` has one job: emit session as JSONL |
| **O** | New adapter alongside `CLIDiscoveryAdapter` — no modification to existing |
| **L** | Both adapters use same `DiscoveryHandler` interface |
| **I** | Adapter depends on `DiscoveryHandler` + `JSONSessionRenderer` — focused deps |
| **D** | Output goes to `io.Writer` interface, not concrete `os.Stdout` |

## Steps

1. Create `AgentDiscoveryAdapter` in `discovery/infrastructure/agent_discovery_adapter.go`
2. Implement `Run(ctx)`: start session → emit status → emit persona → emit questions → emit status → persist
3. Write envelope helper for `{"type":"...","data":...}` JSONL lines
4. Add `--agent` flag to `cmd/alty/commands/guide.go`
5. Add `runGuideAgent()` that creates adapter and calls `Run()`
6. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `alty guide --agent` outputs JSONL to stdout
- [ ] First line is session_status with next_action=persona_detection
- [ ] Second line is persona_prompt with 4 choices
- [ ] Lines 3-12 are question outputs for Q1-Q10
- [ ] Last line is session_status summary
- [ ] Each line is valid JSON parseable by `json.Unmarshal`
- [ ] Each line has `type` and `data` envelope fields
- [ ] Session persisted to `.alty/discovery_session.json`
- [ ] Command exits 0 after output (no stdin blocking)
- [ ] Works with pipes: `alty guide --agent | jq .type`
- [ ] `--agent` and `--continue` are mutually exclusive (error if both)

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected Output |
|------|-------|-----------------|
| No README.md | Empty dir | Error: "create a README.md..." |
| --agent + --continue | Both flags | Error: "--agent and --continue are mutually exclusive" |
| --agent + --no-tui | Both flags | --agent takes precedence (--no-tui irrelevant) |
| Large README | 10KB file | Normal output, README not included in JSONL |
| Existing session | .alty/discovery_session.json exists | Overwritten with new session |

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] Read `discovery/infrastructure/json_session_renderer.go` — verify RenderQuestion/RenderPersonaPrompt/RenderSessionStatus signatures
- [ ] Read `discovery/infrastructure/cli_discovery_adapter.go` — understand Run() flow to mirror
- [ ] Read `discovery/application/discovery_handler.go` — verify StartSession returns session with all needed data
- [ ] Read `discovery/domain/question.go` — verify QuestionCatalog() returns 10 questions
- [ ] Confirm `--agent` flag does NOT conflict with existing `--no-tui` and `--continue` flags

## QA Before Close

- [ ] `go build ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `go vet ./...` — zero errors
- [ ] `golangci-lint run ./...` — zero issues
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` — all pass
- [ ] Manual: `go run ./cmd/alty guide --agent` in test dir with README.md → JSONL output
- [ ] Manual: `go run ./cmd/alty guide --agent | jq .type` → prints types

## Risks / Dependencies

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Envelope format not standardized | Use simple `{"type":"...","data":...}` — matches JSONL conventions |
| 4hk.3 answer ingestion needs matching format | Envelope `type` field enables dispatch; 4hk.3 reads same types |
| Persona not detected in emit-only mode | Emit persona prompt — 4hk.3 handles response; session starts in StatusCreated |
close_reason: AgentDiscoveryAdapter emits 13-line JSONL (status + persona + 10 questions + final status). Envelope protocol with type/data. --agent flag wired, mutually exclusive with --continue. 7 tests. All gates pass.

title: Design JSON schema for agent-mode questions and answers
description:
## Goal / Problem

Define JSON schema for machine-readable question/answer format that AI coding tools can process. Schema must support all 10 current questions plus future conversational questions.

## Background / Context

- Issue 3 from .notes/issues.md
- Claude Code, Cursor, etc. need structured format to drive discovery

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery + ToolTranslation |
| Ubiquitous Language | QuestionSchema, AnswerSchema, AgentSession |
| Layer | Domain (schema definition) |

## Design

### Question Schema

```json
{
  "session_id": "uuid",
  "question_number": 1,
  "question_text": "Who are the actors...",
  "question_type": "open" | "choice" | "multi-select",
  "required": false,
  "skip_allowed": true,
  "context": {
    "detected_docs": ["README.md", "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md"],
    "inferred_answer": "Based on your README, I see...",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  "choices": ["Option A", "Option B"]  // if choice type
}
```

### Answer Schema

```json
{
  "session_id": "uuid",
  "question_number": 1,
  "answer": "developers and AI coding tools",
  "skipped": false,
  "skip_reason": null,
  "confirmed_inference": true  // if user accepted inferred_answer
}
```

## Steps

1. Define Question and Answer JSON schemas
2. Document in docs/schemas/ or similar
3. Create Go types matching schemas
4. Add JSON marshaling/unmarshaling tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Question schema supports all current question types
- [ ] Answer schema supports text, skip, and confirmation
- [ ] Schema documented with examples
- [ ] Go types with json tags created
- [ ] Round-trip marshal/unmarshal tested

## Quality Gates

```bash
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race
```
notes:
## Grooming Review (2026-03-15) — MAJOR REWRITE NEEDED

### BC Correction: Discovery, NOT ToolTranslation
- Ticket claims BC is "Discovery + ToolTranslation" — WRONG
- JSON I/O for agent mode is a Discovery infrastructure concern (output format)
- ToolTranslation BC is about generating AI tool configs (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules)
- Agent-mode questions/answers are the SAME domain objects as CLI questions/answers
- The schema is a serialization format, not a domain concept

### Schema Issues
- `session_id`, `question_number`, `question_text` — these already exist as `DiscoverySession` fields
- `context.detected_docs`, `context.inferred_answer`, `context.confidence` — these are f0g.3 concerns (LLM inference), not schema concerns
- `confirmed_inference` in answer schema — premature, depends on f0g.3
- **Strip speculative fields.** Schema should match current DiscoverySession capabilities.

### What the Schema Actually Needs
Question output:
- session_id, question_id (not question_number — sessions use Q1-Q10 IDs)
- question_text, question_type (open/choice)
- required, skip_allowed
- persona (if detected)
- playback_summary (at playback phase)

Answer input:
- session_id, question_id
- answer OR skipped+skip_reason
- playback_confirmed (boolean, at playback phase)

### Persona & Playback
- Ticket ignores persona detection phase (first interaction in discovery)
- Ticket ignores playback confirmation loop (I3 invariant)
- Both must be representable in the JSON schema

### Where This Lives
- Schema Go types: `internal/discovery/domain/` (they ARE domain types with json tags)
- JSON marshaling adapter: `internal/discovery/infrastructure/json_session_renderer.go`
- Cobra flag wiring: `cmd/alty/commands/guide.go`

### Missing Template Sections
- [ ] GREEN Phase
- [ ] REFACTOR Phase
- [ ] SOLID Mapping
- [ ] Pre-Implementation Validation

title: Implement conversational discovery flow
description:
## Goal / Problem

Replace rigid 10-question Q&A with an adaptive conversational discovery flow. LLM fills gaps from docs, asks targeted follow-ups based on what's missing, and adapts question style to project maturity.

## Background / Context

- P2 spike delivered `DiscoveryFlow` interface design in `docs/research/20260314_discovery_session_refactoring.md`
- `DiscoveryFlow` interface is DESIGNED but NOT yet implemented as Go code
- f0g.3 delivers `DocInferenceHandler` + `LLMDocReader` for LLM-based doc reading
- Existing `DiscoverySession` hardcodes: phase ordering, playback interval=3, MVP question IDs
- Strategy pattern extracts these into `FixedQuestionFlow` (current behavior) + `ConversationalFlow` (new)
- **This ticket is LARGE** — consider splitting into 2 sub-tickets:
  - f0g.4a: Extract `DiscoveryFlow` interface + `FixedQuestionFlow` (pure refactor, zero behavior change)
  - f0g.4b: Implement `ConversationalFlow` with LLM integration

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | DiscoveryFlow, ConversationalFlow, FixedQuestionFlow, ModelGap, ModelCompleteness, AdaptiveQuestion |
| Layer | Domain (flow strategies, model gaps) + Application (conversational handler) + Infrastructure (LLM adapter) |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Location | Purpose |
|-------|------|----------|---------|
| `DiscoveryFlow` | Interface | `discovery/domain/discovery_flow.go` | Strategy for question ordering, playback, completeness |
| `FixedQuestionFlow` | Domain struct | `discovery/domain/fixed_question_flow.go` | Extracts current hardcoded behavior — zero change |
| `ConversationalFlow` | Domain struct | `discovery/domain/conversational_flow.go` | Adaptive ordering, configurable playback, semantic completeness |
| `QuestionRef` | Value Object | `discovery/domain/discovery_flow.go` | Reference to a question (ID + phase) for validation |
| `ModelGap` | Value Object | `discovery/domain/model_gap.go` | Identifies missing domain element (actors, events, contexts) |
| `ModelCompleteness` | Value Object | `discovery/domain/model_completeness.go` | Overall completeness score + list of gaps |

### DiscoveryFlow Interface (from spike)

```
type DiscoveryFlow interface {
    ValidateQuestionOrder(ref QuestionRef, answered []Answer, skipped map[string]bool) error
    IsPlaybackDue(answersSinceLastPlayback int) bool
    PlaybackInterval() int
    CheckCompleteness(answered []Answer, skipped map[string]bool) ModelCompleteness
}
```

### DiscoverySession Changes

- Add `flow DiscoveryFlow` field (defaults to `FixedQuestionFlow{}`)
- `AnswerQuestion()` calls `s.flow.ValidateQuestionOrder()` instead of `s.enforcePhaseOrder()`
- `AnswerQuestion()` uses `s.flow.IsPlaybackDue()` instead of `>= playbackInterval`
- `Complete()` calls `s.flow.CheckCompleteness()` instead of hardcoded MVP check
- `SetMode()` sets flow strategy: Express/Deep -> `FixedQuestionFlow`, Conversational -> `ConversationalFlow`

### ConversationalFlow Behavior

- `ValidateQuestionOrder`: always returns nil (any order allowed)
- `IsPlaybackDue`: configurable interval (default 5, not 3)
- `CheckCompleteness`: semantic check — requires at least 1 actor, 1 entity, 1 bounded context, 1 domain story. Does NOT require specific question IDs.

### CLI Integration

`alty guide --mode conversational` (or `--deep` for deep mode):
- Starts session with `ModeConversational`
- Uses LLM (from f0g.3) to suggest questions based on model gaps
- Adaptive question style based on project state

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S** | Each flow strategy has one job: define ordering/playback/completeness rules |
| **O** | New flows added as implementations, not modifications to session |
| **L** | `ConversationalFlow` satisfies same `DiscoveryFlow` interface |
| **I** | `DiscoveryFlow` is focused (4 methods). `ConversationalDiscovery` is separate port for LLM-powered methods |
| **D** | `DiscoverySession` depends on `DiscoveryFlow` interface, not concrete strategies |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase (f0g.4a — Strategy extraction)

```
TestFixedQuestionFlow_ValidateQuestionOrder_EnforcesPhaseOrder
TestFixedQuestionFlow_IsPlaybackDue_ReturnsTrue_AtInterval3
TestFixedQuestionFlow_CheckCompleteness_RequiresMVPQuestions
TestDiscoverySession_WithFixedFlow_AllExistingTests_StillPass
```

### RED Phase (f0g.4b — Conversational flow)

```
TestConversationalFlow_ValidateQuestionOrder_AllowsAnyOrder
TestConversationalFlow_IsPlaybackDue_ReturnsTrue_AtInterval5
TestConversationalFlow_CheckCompleteness_SemanticCheck
TestDiscoverySession_WithConversationalFlow_AcceptsOutOfOrderAnswers
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Create `DiscoveryFlow` interface + `QuestionRef` VO
2. Extract `FixedQuestionFlow` from existing hardcoded logic (pure refactor)
3. Add `flow` field to `DiscoverySession`, default to `FixedQuestionFlow`
4. Verify all existing tests still pass (zero breakage)
5. Create `ConversationalFlow` with relaxed rules
6. Create `ModelGap` + `ModelCompleteness` VOs
7. Wire `--mode conversational` flag
8. Integrate LLM for adaptive question generation

### REFACTOR Phase

- Move `questionPhases` and `playbackInterval` constants into `FixedQuestionFlow`
- Verify snapshot serialization/deserialization handles flow strategy

## Steps

1. Create `DiscoveryFlow` interface in `discovery/domain/discovery_flow.go`
2. Extract `FixedQuestionFlow` — move phase ordering, playback=3, MVP check into it
3. Add `flow DiscoveryFlow` field to `DiscoverySession` with default
4. Delegate: `enforcePhaseOrder` -> `flow.ValidateQuestionOrder`, playback check -> `flow.IsPlaybackDue`, MVP -> `flow.CheckCompleteness`
5. Run all existing tests — must pass with zero changes (pure refactor)
6. Create `ConversationalFlow` with relaxed ordering, playback=5, semantic completeness
7. Create `ModelGap`/`ModelCompleteness` VOs
8. Add `ModeConversational` to `DiscoveryMode` enum
9. Wire in CLI as `--mode conversational`
10. Integrate with f0g.3 LLMDocReader for adaptive question generation

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `DiscoveryFlow` interface exists with 4 methods
- [ ] `FixedQuestionFlow` passes all ~105 existing session tests (zero breakage)
- [ ] `ConversationalFlow` allows out-of-order answers
- [ ] `ConversationalFlow` playback interval is 5 (configurable)
- [ ] `ConversationalFlow` completeness check is semantic (actors, entities, contexts)
- [ ] `DiscoverySession` delegates to flow strategy
- [ ] `alty guide --mode conversational` uses ConversationalFlow
- [ ] Snapshot serialization handles flow strategy
- [ ] Existing `--no-tui`, `--continue`, `--agent` flags unaffected

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Default mode | No --mode flag | FixedQuestionFlow (backward compatible) |
| Conversational + skip | Skip Q3 before Q1 | Allowed (no phase ordering) |
| Conversational complete | 1 actor + 1 entity + 1 context + 1 story | Complete (semantic check passes) |
| Fixed complete | Q1,Q3,Q4,Q9,Q10 answered | Complete (MVP check passes) |
| Snapshot round-trip | Save conversational session | Restored with ConversationalFlow |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race
```

- [ ] All gates pass
- [ ] Zero breakage in existing tests after Strategy extraction

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] Read `docs/research/20260314_discovery_session_refactoring.md` — full spike report
- [ ] Read `discovery/domain/discovery_session.go` — current enforcePhaseOrder, playbackInterval, MVPQuestionIDs
- [ ] Read `discovery/domain/question.go` — QuestionCatalog, questionPhases
- [ ] Count existing discovery/domain tests — must all pass after refactor
- [ ] Verify snapshot format can encode flow strategy (ToSnapshot/FromSnapshot)

## QA Before Close

- [ ] All ~105 existing session tests pass unchanged
- [ ] Conversational flow tests cover out-of-order, playback, completeness
- [ ] Strategy extraction is pure refactor (git diff shows only structural moves)
- [ ] No regressions in CLI commands (guide, agent, continue)

## Risks / Dependencies

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Large ticket — Strategy extraction + conversational flow | Split into f0g.4a (refactor) + f0g.4b (new flow) |
| Snapshot serialization may break | Add flow type to snapshot, default to FixedQuestionFlow on load |
| ~105 existing tests at risk during refactor | Pure extraction — zero behavior change, run after every step |
| SDK may be needed for tool_use | Evaluate anthropic-sdk-go; fallback to system-prompt JSON hack |

## Scope Assessment

| Metric | Count | Threshold | Status |
|--------|-------|-----------|--------|
| New files | 6-8 | >5 | SPLIT RECOMMENDED |
| New functions | ~25 | >20 | SPLIT RECOMMENDED |
| BCs touched | 1 | <=2 | OK |

**RECOMMENDATION: Split into f0g.4a (pure Strategy extraction) and f0g.4b (ConversationalFlow + LLM integration).** The extraction is a prerequisite refactor that should be verified independently before adding new behavior.
notes:
## Spike Findings (f0g.1) — SDK Revisit Point

### anthropic-sdk-go Evaluation
- f0g.1 spike recommends SKIPPING anthropic-sdk-go for now
- Revisit HERE (f0g.4) when tool use / function calling is needed for conversational flow
- SDK adds: typed tool_use structs, auto-retry with backoff
- Current HTTP client lacks: streaming, tool use, rich error types

### If SDK Needed
- anthropic-sdk-go v1.26.0, MIT, pure Go, 33 imports
- Would replace `AnthropicClient` in `internal/shared/infrastructure/llm/`
- Factory.Create switch case stays the same — just swap the concrete client

### Strategy Pattern Ready
- P2 spike (DiscoverySession refactoring) already delivered `DiscoveryFlow` interface
- `ConversationalFlow` implementation goes here
- Use `FixedQuestionFlow` as reference for the interface contract

### Full spike report: `docs/research/20260314_llm_integration.md`
