- cmd/alto/commands/guide.go:140-173 — runGuideAgent: wire DomainResearcher into adapter or handle research inline

description:

- StorytellingHandler.RunStory: application/storytelling_handler.go:40-45
- StorytellingFlow: domain/storytelling_flow.go:33-49 (ModeRapid/ModeThorough only)
- DiscoverySession: discovery_session.go (StoryCount, BoundariesConfirmed, Mode, Status accessors)

- Settled: "--continue uses legacy flow + warning" — this ticket upgrades it

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | DiscoverySession, ResumeCheckpoint, StorytellingFlow, StorytellingHandler, storyRefs, confirmedSketches |
| Layer | Domain (ResumeCheckpoint method on DiscoverySession) + Infrastructure (CLIDiscoveryAdapter.Resume) + CLI (guide.go wiring) |

## Design

### ResumeCheckpoint — Method on DiscoverySession (domain)

Per TL review: must be a method on DiscoverySession (needs access to private state like mode, flow type).

Location: internal/discovery/domain/session_resume.go (new file)

ResumeCheckpoint VO:
- StoryIndex int (next story to narrate, 1-based: StoryCount + 1)
- BoundariesDone bool (true if BoundariesConfirmed)

Method on DiscoverySession:
- ComputeResumeCheckpoint() (ResumeCheckpoint, error)
- Returns ErrInvariantViolation if session mode is not ModeRapid or ModeThorough
- Returns ErrInvariantViolation if mode is nil (pre-mode legacy sessions)
- Caller checks Status == StatusCompleted before calling (guard at top of Resume, not in VO)

### CLIDiscoveryAdapter.Resume (infrastructure)

New method on existing adapter. Mirrors Run but skips steps 1-4 (README, StartSession, SelectMode, DetectPersona).

Resume(ctx, session) sequence:
1. ComputeResumeCheckpoint(session) -> checkpoint
2. NewStorytellingFlow(session.Mode()) -> flow
3. storyIndex := checkpoint.StoryIndex
4. Story loop from storyIndex (RunStory, increment, check CheckStoryCompleteness)
5. If !checkpoint.BoundariesDone: run boundary detection
6. If checkpoint.BoundariesDone: skip boundaries entirely (do NOT call ConfirmBoundaries again)
7. handler.Complete(sessionID)

### runGuideContinue Replacement (CLI)

Replace cmd/alto/commands/guide.go:128-243 entirely:
1. Load session from FileSystemSessionRepository(".alto")
2. Guard: Status == StatusCompleted -> error "session already complete"
3. Call session.ComputeResumeCheckpoint() -> handle ErrInvariantViolation
4. displayStoryResumeSummary(session) — print storyRefs list

title: [Phase 6] Agent mode (--agent) story-based JSONL output
description:
## Goal / Problem

alto guide --agent currently runs the legacy 10-question question-based discovery flow via AgentDiscoveryAdapter. It emits session_status, persona_prompt, question JSONL envelopes — none of which carry Domain Storytelling content (actors, work objects, sentences, annotations, boundary sketches).

This ticket replaces the AgentDiscoveryAdapter flow with a story-based JSONL protocol that drives StorytellingFlow non-interactively: narrates stories from README.md content, emits each story as a JSONL story envelope, emits boundary sketches as boundary_proposals, and terminates with a discovery_complete envelope. AI coding tools can consume this structured output to bootstrap domain understanding.

## Background / Context

- Existing --agent wiring: cmd/alto/commands/guide.go:119-126 (runGuideAgent creates AgentDiscoveryAdapter)
- AgentDiscoveryAdapter.Run: infrastructure/agent_discovery_adapter.go:46-100 (legacy question flow)
- StorytellingHandler.RunStory: application/storytelling_handler.go:40-45 (story-driven flow orchestrator)
- StorytellingPrompter port: application/ports.go:151-178 (9 methods)
- CLIDiscoveryAdapter: infrastructure/cli_discovery_adapter.go:57-162 (TUI flow — reference pattern)
- NewStorytellingFlow: domain/storytelling_flow.go:33-49 (ModeRapid/ModeThorough only)
- DomainStory: domain/domain_story.go:15-332 (aggregate root)
- StorytellingHandler construction in guide.go: cmd/alto/commands/guide.go:92-93
- writeEnvelope: agent_discovery_adapter.go:102-116 (package-private, reusable)
- envelope struct: agent_discovery_adapter.go:40-43
- Existing agent DTOs: domain/agent_schema.go:1-63 (legacy — to be migrated in sub-ticket)
- flow.CanRunBoundaryDetection: storytelling_flow.go:99-101 (requires storyCount >= 2)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | DomainStory, StoryActor, WorkObject, StorySentence, Annotation, BoundedContextSketch, StorytellingFlow, ModeRapid, StorytellingPrompter |
| Layer | Infrastructure (AgentStorytellingPrompter, AgentStorytellingAdapter, DTO structs) + CLI (guide.go wiring) |

Note: All JSON DTO structs live in infrastructure (not domain) per settled decision: "Struct VOs have NO MarshalYAML/json tags. Serialization is infrastructure."

## Design

### JSON DTO Structs (infrastructure layer)

New file: internal/discovery/infrastructure/agent_story_dto.go

All DTOs are output-only with json struct tags. NewStoryOutput mapper also lives here (serialization concern).

StoryOutput: session_id, story_index, title, story_type, time_type, purity_type, trigger, actors []ActorOutput, work_objects []WorkObjectOutput, sentences []SentenceOutput, annotations []AnnotationOutput (omitempty), variations []string (omitempty)
ActorOutput: name, type, trust, source (omitempty)
WorkObjectOutput: name, type, trust, source (omitempty)
SentenceOutput: step, subject, activity, object, preposition (omitempty), indirect_object (omitempty), trust, source (omitempty)
AnnotationOutput: text, type, sentence_ref *int (omitempty), trust, source (omitempty)
BoundaryProposalOutput: name, classification, confidence, actors, work_objects, stories
DiscoveryCompleteOutput: session_id, story_count, sketch_count, mode

NewStoryOutput(sessionID string, storyIndex int, story *DomainStory) StoryOutput — pure mapping, no error path.

### AgentStorytellingPrompter (infrastructure)

Implements application.StorytellingPrompter with deterministic, non-interactive responses:
- SelectMode: returns pre-configured ModeRapid
- AskNarration: returns next narration line (sequential); empty string when exhausted (signals end of narration phase)
- ConfirmSentence: auto-accepts (sentence, true, nil)
- AskChoice: returns "1" (first option — Developer persona)
- AskAnnotation: returns ("", 0, nil) — no annotations in agent mode
- SynthesisCheckpoint: returns (true, nil)
- DisplayStory: no-op
- ProposeStory: returns proposed unchanged

Compile-time check: var _ application.StorytellingPrompter = (*AgentStorytellingPrompter)(nil)

### AgentStorytellingAdapter (infrastructure)

Orchestrates story-driven flow and emits JSONL:

Run(ctx) sequence:
1. os.ReadFile(README.md)
2. extractNarrationLines(readme) -> []string
3. Validate minimum lines from StorytellingFlow (derive from domain, not hardcoded)
4. handler.StartSession(readme) -> session
5. session.SetMode(ModeRapid)
6. handler.DetectPersona(sessionID, "1")
7. NewStorytellingFlow(ModeRapid) -> flow
8. Story loop: storytellingHandler.RunStory -> DomainStory -> NewStoryOutput -> writeEnvelope("story", ...)
9. If flow.CanRunBoundaryDetection(storyCount): detect boundaries, emit "boundary_proposals"
10. handler.Complete(sessionID)
11. writeEnvelope("discovery_complete", ...)

extractNarrationLines: splits README into non-empty, non-heading lines. Infrastructure-private.
Minimum line count: derived from StorytellingFlow domain invariants for ModeRapid, not hardcoded.

### CLI Wiring Change

cmd/alto/commands/guide.go:runGuideAgent — replace AgentDiscoveryAdapter with AgentStorytellingAdapter.
Existing AgentDiscoveryAdapter preserved for --agent --ingest path.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| SRP | Prompter answers prompts. Adapter orchestrates flow + emits JSONL. DTOs handle serialization. |
| OCP | StorytellingHandler unchanged. New behavior via new adapter/prompter. |
| LSP | AgentStorytellingPrompter fully satisfies StorytellingPrompter — compile-time check. |
| ISP | Consumes only StorytellingPrompter port. Does not implement Prompter, BoundaryPrompter. |
| DIP | Adapter depends on application handlers + port interfaces, never concrete types. |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

infrastructure/agent_storytelling_prompter_test.go (10 tests):
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_SelectMode_ReturnsPreconfiguredMode
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_AskNarration_ReturnsLinesSequentially
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_AskNarration_ReturnsEmptyWhenExhausted
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_ConfirmSentence_AutoAccepts
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_AskChoice_ReturnsFirstChoice
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_AskAnnotation_ReturnsEmpty
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_SynthesisCheckpoint_ReturnsTrue
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_DisplayStory_IsNoop
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_ProposeStory_ReturnsUnchanged
- TestAgentStorytellingPrompter_ProposeStory_NilReturnsError

infrastructure/agent_storytelling_adapter_test.go (7 tests):
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_EmitsStoryEnvelopes
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_EachLineIsValidJSON
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_EmitsDiscoveryComplete
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_StoryEnvelopeHasExpectedFields
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_NoReadme_ReturnsError
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_ReadmeTooShort_ReturnsError
- TestAgentStorytellingAdapter_Run_BoundaryDetectionEligible_EmitsBoundaryProposals

infrastructure/agent_story_dto_test.go (5 tests):
- TestNewStoryOutput_MapsAllFields
- TestNewStoryOutput_EmptyAnnotations_OmittedFromJSON
- TestStoryOutput_JSONRoundTrip
- TestDiscoveryCompleteOutput_JSONRoundTrip
- TestBoundaryProposalOutput_JSONRoundTrip

### GREEN Phase
1. Create agent_story_dto.go — DTO structs + NewStoryOutput
2. Create agent_storytelling_prompter.go — all 9 StorytellingPrompter methods
3. Create agent_storytelling_adapter.go — Run + extractNarrationLines
4. Update guide.go:runGuideAgent to use AgentStorytellingAdapter

### REFACTOR Phase
- Reuse writeEnvelope from agent_discovery_adapter.go (same package)
- Verify extractNarrationLines handles \r\n line endings
- golangci-lint -> 0 issues

## Steps

1. Write 5 DTO tests, implement DTO structs + NewStoryOutput in agent_story_dto.go
2. Write 10 prompter tests, implement AgentStorytellingPrompter
3. Write 7 adapter tests, implement AgentStorytellingAdapter + extractNarrationLines
4. Update guide.go:runGuideAgent to wire AgentStorytellingAdapter
5. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] alto guide --agent emits story JSONL envelopes with type/data structure
- [ ] Each story envelope contains: session_id, story_index, title, actors, work_objects, sentences
- [ ] boundary_proposals emitted when flow.CanRunBoundaryDetection returns true
- [ ] discovery_complete emitted as last line with session_id, story_count, sketch_count, mode
- [ ] Every output line is valid JSON
- [ ] alto guide --agent --ingest still works (legacy path preserved)
- [ ] AgentStorytellingPrompter compile-time check passes
- [ ] All DTO structs in infrastructure (not domain) — no json tags in domain layer
- [ ] NewStoryOutput in infrastructure (serialization mapper)
- [ ] Minimum narration line count derived from domain, not hardcoded
- [ ] ModeRapid hardcoded for agent mode (documented design decision)
- [ ] Agent mode not concurrent-safe (documented — not needed)
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass, coverage >= 80% on new files

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| README too short | Fewer lines than domain minimum for RAPID | Error before emitting JSONL |
| README empty (headings only) | Only # lines and blanks | Error: extracted lines = 0 |
| README missing | No README.md | Error: reading README.md |
| Narration exhausted mid-story | Prompter returns "" | RunStory exits narration, story may have fewer sentences |
| Single story (boundary ineligible) | README with minimal lines | No boundary_proposals, sketch_count=0 |
| Context cancelled | ctx cancelled during RunStory | Returns context.Canceled |
| --agent --ingest | With valid JSONL file | Unchanged legacy path |
| --agent --continue | Mutually exclusive flags | Error at guide.go:64-66 |
| BoundaryDetector nil | No LLM credentials | Skip boundary detection gracefully (ADR-013) |

## Quality Gates

go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race -count=1

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] AskNarration loop: storytelling_handler.go:115-127 (empty return breaks loop)
- [ ] NewStorytellingFlow: storytelling_flow.go:33-49 (ModeRapid/ModeThorough only)
- [ ] flow.CanRunBoundaryDetection: storytelling_flow.go:99-101
- [ ] writeEnvelope: agent_discovery_adapter.go:102-116
- [ ] envelope struct: agent_discovery_adapter.go:40-43
- [ ] app.BoundaryDetector field: composition/app.go:63
- [ ] runGuideAgent: guide.go:119-126
- [ ] Verify session.SetMode exists on DiscoverySession

## Risks / Dependencies

- session.SetMode may not exist as a public method — verify before implementation (CLIDiscoveryAdapter calls it at cli_discovery_adapter.go:80)
- BoundaryDetector may be nil when LLM credentials absent — guard with nil check, skip gracefully
- writeEnvelope partial writes on kill — acceptable for Phase 6
- Existing domain/agent_schema.go DTOs are tech debt (pre-storytelling) — separate sub-ticket to migrate


### Egon JSON Structure

Top-level: `{"domain": {...}, "dst": [...]}`

**Element types** (explicit mapping table per TL I1):

| Domain Type | Egon type string |
|-------------|-----------------|
| ActorTypePerson | "domainStory:actorPerson" |
| ActorTypeSystem | "domainStory:actorSystem" |
| ActorTypeGroup | "domainStory:actorGroup" |
| WorkObjectTypeDocument | "domainStory:workObjectDocument" |
| WorkObjectTypeFolder | "domainStory:workObjectFolder" |
| WorkObjectTypeCall | "domainStory:workObjectCall" |
| WorkObjectTypeEmail | "domainStory:workObjectEmail" |
| WorkObjectTypeConversation | "domainStory:workObjectConversation" |
| WorkObjectTypeInfo | "domainStory:workObjectInfo" |
| WorkObjectTypeData | "domainStory:workObjectData" |

**Shapes**: `{type, name, id: "shape_NNNN", x, y, pickedColor: "black", $type: "Element", di: {}, $descriptor: {}}`

**Activity connections**: `{type: "domainStory:activity", name: <verb>, id: "connection_NNNN", number: <step>, source: <shapeId>, target: <shapeId>, waypoints: [{x,y},{x,y}]}`

**Indirect object bridge**: When HasIndirectObject() is true, emit 2 connections:
1. Primary: number=step, name=activity, source=actor, target=object
2. Bridge: number=null, name=preposition, source=object, target=indirect-object, id="connection_NNNNb"

**domain block**: Register only used actor/work-object types with SVG icon strings (TL I2/I3).

**Metadata**: Last 2 dst entries: `{info: "..."}` and `{version: "2.0.1"}`

### ID Assignment
- Shapes: shape_0001..shape_NNNN (actors first, then work objects)
- Connections: connection_0001..connection_NNNN in step order, bridge gets "b" suffix
- Zero-padded to 4 digits

### Auto-Layout
- Actors row: y=200, x spacing=400, starting x=100
- Work objects: alternating y=50/y=350, x spacing=200
- Waypoints: 2-point segments from source center to target center
- Best-effort — users rearrange in Egon.io

### Private Structs (infrastructure only, json tags)
- egnDocument, egnDomain, egnShape, egnActivity, egnWaypoint, egnMetaInfo, egnMetaVersion
- egnActivity uses `Number *int` (not omitempty) to emit `"number": null` for bridges
- egnShape omits number field entirely

```go
    reader   StoryReader
    renderer EgnRenderer
    writer   sharedapp.FileWriter
}

```

title: [Phase 5] Context map export — ContextMapBuilder + ContextMapExportHandler
description:
## Goal / Problem

After boundary detection (Phase 3), confirmed BoundedContextSketch values carry actors, work objects, and signals but NO relationships between contexts. The current ContextMap has nil relationships (settled: order.md line 51). This ticket infers ContextRelationships from shared work objects across sketch pairs and exports .alto/context-map.yaml.

## Background / Context

- order.md line 51: "ContextMap with nil relationships (Phase 5 adds them)"
- NewContextMap: context_map.go:19 — (project, contexts, relationships)
- NewContextRelationship: context_relationship.go:20 — (upstream, downstream, relType, shared, description)
- BoundedContextSketch.WorkObjects(): bounded_context_sketch.go:116 — returns []string
- BoundedContextSketch.Name(): bounded_context_sketch.go:99
- RelationshipTypeSharedKernel: relationship_type.go:14 — "shared_kernel"
- ContextMapWriter port: ports.go:143-145 — Write(ctx, path, *ContextMap) error
- ContextMapYAMLParser: context_map_yaml_parser.go:19-22 — implements ContextMapWriter. No changes needed.
- Sample output: docs/research/samples/context-map.yaml

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | ContextMap, ContextRelationship, BoundedContextSketch, RelationshipType, BuildContextMap |
| Layer | Domain (builder function) + Application (handler) |

## Design

### BuildContextMap — Pure Domain Function (TL fix I1)

Plain function, not zero-value struct. Follows ComputeBoundaryScore/PropagateConfirmation pattern.

```go
// BuildContextMap infers ContextRelationships from shared work objects across
// sketch pairs and returns a complete ContextMap.
// stories parameter removed per TL review — sketch WorkObjects already aggregate
// from stories during Phase 3 boundary detection.
func BuildContextMap(
    projectName string,
    sketches []BoundedContextSketch,
) (*ContextMap, error)
```

### Inference Algorithm

1. For each ordered pair (i, j) where i < j (avoids self-pairs and duplicates):
   - Skip if sketches[i].Name() == sketches[j].Name() (self-relationship guard, TL fix I6)
   - Compute shared = intersection(sketches[i].WorkObjects(), sketches[j].WorkObjects()) via strings.EqualFold
   - If len(shared) == 0: skip
   - Assign upstream/downstream lexicographically for determinism (A.Name() < B.Name())
   - relType = RelationshipTypeSharedKernel (weakest claim — "contexts share a concept")
   - description = "Shared work objects (alphabetical ordering, no true directionality): X, Y, Z" (TL fix C1)
   - Call NewContextRelationship(upstream, downstream, relType, shared, description)
2. Return NewContextMap(projectName, sketches, relationships)

### ContextMapExportHandler — Application Layer

No StoryReader dependency (TL fix I3 — stories not used by builder).

```go
type ContextMapExportHandler struct {
    writer ContextMapWriter
}

func NewContextMapExportHandler(writer ContextMapWriter) *ContextMapExportHandler

func (h *ContextMapExportHandler) Export(
    ctx context.Context,
    projectName string,
    sketches []discoverydomain.BoundedContextSketch,
    outputPath string,
) error
```

Export calls BuildContextMap(projectName, sketches), then writer.Write(ctx, outputPath, cm).

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| SRP | Builder infers relationships. Handler orchestrates write. Parser serializes. |
| OCP | New inference strategies extend builder without touching handler. |
| LSP | Any ContextMapWriter substitutable. |
| ISP | Handler depends only on ContextMapWriter (1 method). No StoryReader needed. |
| DIP | Handler depends on port interface, not ContextMapYAMLParser. |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

**Domain tests** (internal/discovery/domain/context_map_builder_test.go):
```
TestBuildContextMap_SharedWorkObjects_InfersSharedKernel
  — sketch A {WorkObjects: ["Order", "Invoice"]}, sketch B {WorkObjects: ["Invoice", "Receipt"]}
  → 1 relationship: shared_kernel, shared=["Invoice"]

TestBuildContextMap_NoSharedObjects_NoRelationship
  — disjoint WorkObjects → 0 relationships

TestBuildContextMap_CaseInsensitiveMatch
  — "order" vs "Order" → treated as shared

TestBuildContextMap_LexicographicOrdering
  — "Zebra" + "Alpha" → upstream="Alpha", downstream="Zebra"

TestBuildContextMap_MultipleSketchPairs
  — A∩B={"X"}, B∩C={"Y"}, A∩C={} → 2 relationships

TestBuildContextMap_EmptyProjectName_Error
  — "" → error wrapping ErrInvariantViolation

TestBuildContextMap_ZeroSketches
  — [] → ContextMap with empty contexts and relationships

TestBuildContextMap_SingleSketch
  — [A] → 0 relationships (no pair)

TestBuildContextMap_SelfRelationshipGuard
  — Two sketches with same name → no relationship (TL fix I6)

TestBuildContextMap_BidirectionalDedup
  — A∩B shares objects. Only 1 relationship produced, not 2 (TL fix I5)

TestBuildContextMap_DescriptionIncludesAlphabeticalNote
  — Verify description contains "alphabetical ordering" (TL fix C1)
```

**Application tests** (internal/discovery/application/context_map_export_handler_test.go):
```
TestContextMapExportHandler_Export_HappyPath
  — 2 sketches with shared objects → writer called with ContextMap having 1 relationship

TestContextMapExportHandler_Export_WriteError_Propagates
  — writer error → wrapped error

TestContextMapExportHandler_Export_EmptySketches
  — [] sketches → writer called with ContextMap, 0 relationships

TestContextMapExportHandler_Export_NilSketches
  — nil sketches → writer called with ContextMap, 0 relationships
```

### GREEN Phase
1. Create context_map_builder.go — BuildContextMap function
2. Create context_map_export_handler.go — handler
3. Wire in app.go

### REFACTOR Phase
- strings.EqualFold consistently
- Error messages: lowercase, %w
- golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

1. Write 11 RED domain tests in context_map_builder_test.go
2. Implement BuildContextMap in context_map_builder.go
3. Write 4 RED application tests
4. Implement ContextMapExportHandler
5. Wire in composition/app.go — ContextMapExportHandler field + NewApp wiring
6. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] BuildContextMap as package-level function in internal/discovery/domain/ (not method on struct)
- [ ] Shared work objects across sketch pairs → SharedKernel relationship
- [ ] Case-insensitive matching via strings.EqualFold
- [ ] Lexicographic upstream/downstream ordering for determinism
- [ ] Description includes "alphabetical ordering, no true directionality" (TL fix C1)
- [ ] Self-relationship guard: same-name sketches produce no relationship (TL fix I6)
- [ ] Bidirectional dedup: A-B pair produces exactly 1 relationship (TL fix I5)
- [ ] Empty projectName → error from NewContextMap
- [ ] Zero/single sketches → 0 relationships
- [ ] No StoryReader dependency in handler (TL fix I3)
- [ ] No stories parameter in BuildContextMap (TL fix C2)
- [ ] ContextMapYAMLParser NOT modified
- [ ] App.ContextMapExportHandler wired in composition root
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass, coverage >= 80%

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty project name | "" | Error from NewContextMap |
| Zero sketches | [] | ContextMap with empty contexts/relationships |
| Single sketch | [A] | 0 relationships |
| No shared objects | All disjoint | 0 relationships |
| Case mismatch | "order" vs "Order" | Treated as shared |
| Self-relationship | Two sketches same name | Skipped |
| 3 sketches, all pairs share | A∩B, B∩C, A∩C | 3 relationships |
| Write error | Writer returns error | Wrapped and returned |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race
```

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] NewContextMap: context_map.go:19 — (project, contexts, relationships)
- [ ] NewContextRelationship: context_relationship.go:20 — (upstream, downstream, relType, shared, description)
- [ ] BoundedContextSketch.WorkObjects(): bounded_context_sketch.go:116 — returns []string
- [ ] RelationshipTypeSharedKernel: relationship_type.go:14
- [ ] ContextMapWriter.Write: ports.go:144
- [ ] ContextMapYAMLParser compile-time guard: context_map_yaml_parser.go:19-22
- [ ] No existing ContextMapExportHandler in App struct: app.go:49-109

## Risks / Dependencies

- Depends on alty-cli-1wu.22 (P5-1) for full sketch persistence in session snapshots
- SharedKernel is the weakest inference — directional relationships require user input (Phase 6)
- Sketch WorkObjects already aggregate from stories during Phase 3 — no need to re-read stories
- Future extension: LLM-based relationship inference could enhance the algorithm
notes:
**Grooming fix (2026-03-27):** Critical: must wire ContextMapYAMLParser{} in composition/app.go NewApp(). Zero-value struct. Store as named variable:
```go
contextMapParser := &discoveryinfra.ContextMapYAMLParser{}
```
Inject as ContextMapWriter into ContextMapExportHandler. Same instance reused by P5-6 as ContextMapReader.

Title says "ContextMapBuilder" but implementation is a plain function BuildContextMap() per TL fix. Title is shorthand — implementation uses function name.

title: [Phase 5] Glossary export — GlossaryExtractor domain service + GlossaryExportHandler
description:
## Goal / Problem

Domain stories contain all ubiquitous language surfaced during discovery — actor names, work object names, activity verbs. None of this vocabulary is durable until written to .alto/glossary.yaml. This ticket adds GlossaryExtractor (domain service) and GlossaryExportHandler (application handler) to extract, deduplicate, and persist the glossary. The GlossaryYAMLParser adapter already exists and must not be modified.

## Background / Context

- StoryReader port: application/ports.go:113-116 — Read(ctx, path) (*DomainStory, error)
- GlossaryWriter port: application/ports.go:131-133 — Write(ctx, path, []UbiquitousLanguageEntry) error
- GlossaryYAMLParser: infrastructure/glossary_yaml_parser.go:17-21 — implements both GlossaryReader + GlossaryWriter
- StoryYAMLParser: infrastructure/story_yaml_parser.go:20-22 — implements StoryReader + StoryWriter
- UbiquitousLanguageEntry: shared/domain/valueobjects/ubiquitous_language_entry.go:24-60 — constructor requires non-empty term, definition, context. AIResearched requires non-empty source.
- WithStories: ubiquitous_language_entry.go:128-142 — copy-on-write for merging story refs
- NOTE: WithTrust does NOT exist yet on UbiquitousLanguageEntry — must be added in this ticket
- DomainStory accessors: domain_story.go:198-235 — Title(), Actors(), WorkObjects(), Sentences()
- StoryActor: story_actor.go:113-123 — Name(), Type(), Trust(), Source()
- WorkObject: work_object.go:129-139 — Name(), Type(), Trust(), Source()
- StorySentence: story_sentence.go:112-133 — Subject(), Activity(), Object(), Trust(), Source()
- BoundedContextSketch: bounded_context_sketch.go:99-117 — Name(), Actors() []string, WorkObjects() []string
- ContextMap.Contexts(): context_map.go:47 — returns []BoundedContextSketch
- IsHigherTrust: trust_level.go:82-85 — t < other (lower int = higher trust)
- Sample output: docs/research/samples/glossary.yaml
- ArtifactGenerationHandler pattern: artifact_generation_handler.go:43-60

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | GlossaryExtractor, UbiquitousLanguageEntry, DomainStory, BoundedContextSketch |
| Layer | Domain (extractor) + Application (handler) + Shared kernel (WithTrust addition) |

## Design

### Definition Generation Strategy (TL fix C1)

| Source | Definition Template | Example |
|--------|-------------------|---------|
| StoryActor | "person in <StoryTitle>" (using ActorType) | "person in Customer Purchases Product" |
| WorkObject | "document in <StoryTitle>" (using WorkObjectType) | "document in Customer Purchases Product" |
| StorySentence.Activity() | "Activity: <subject> <activity> <object>" | "Activity: Customer submits Order" |

### WithTrust Addition (TL fix I1)

Add to internal/shared/domain/valueobjects/ubiquitous_language_entry.go:

```go
func (e UbiquitousLanguageEntry) WithTrust(trust TrustLevel) UbiquitousLanguageEntry
```

Copy-on-write, follows existing WithStories/WithAliases/WithNote pattern. Clears source when upgrading away from AIResearched (same as StoryActor.WithTrust).

### Story References (TL fix I2)

Use DomainStory.Title() for story refs in domain extractor. File paths are infrastructure-level and not available in domain.

### Method Signatures

**Domain** (internal/discovery/domain/glossary_extractor.go):

```go
type GlossaryExtractor struct{}

func (e GlossaryExtractor) Extract(
    stories []*DomainStory,
    contextMap *ContextMap,
) ([]vo.UbiquitousLanguageEntry, error)
```

- Walks actors, work objects, sentence activities across all stories
- Context assignment: match term against BoundedContextSketch.Actors()/WorkObjects() (case-insensitive via strings.EqualFold). Fallback: "General"
- Dedup by lowercased term name. Higher trust wins (IsHigherTrust). Merge story refs via WithStories.
- Sort output lexicographically by Term()
- Empty stories → empty slice, no error

**Application** (internal/discovery/application/glossary_export_handler.go):

```go
type GlossaryExportHandler struct {
    reader    StoryReader
    writer    GlossaryWriter
    extractor discoverydomain.GlossaryExtractor
}

func NewGlossaryExportHandler(reader StoryReader, writer GlossaryWriter) *GlossaryExportHandler

func (h *GlossaryExportHandler) Export(
    ctx context.Context,
    storyPaths []string,
    contextMap *discoverydomain.ContextMap,
    outputPath string,
) error
```

### Sequence

```
Export(ctx, storyPaths, contextMap, outputPath)
  → for each path: StoryReader.Read(ctx, path) → *DomainStory
  → GlossaryExtractor.Extract(stories, contextMap) → []UbiquitousLanguageEntry
  → GlossaryWriter.Write(ctx, outputPath, entries)
```

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| SRP | Extractor extracts, handler orchestrates I/O, parser serializes |
| OCP | New term sources (annotations) extend extractor without touching handler |
| LSP | Any StoryReader/GlossaryWriter substitutable |
| ISP | Narrow ports: StoryReader (1 method), GlossaryWriter (1 method) |
| DIP | Handler depends on port interfaces, not concrete adapters |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

**Domain tests** (internal/discovery/domain/glossary_extractor_test.go):
```
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_EmptyStories — empty slice, no error
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_SingleStory_ActorsAndWorkObjects — 4 entries
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_DeduplicateAcrossStories — merged story refs
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_TrustMerge_HigherTrustWins — UserStated vs AIInferred
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_ContextAssignment_FromContextMap — sketch name as context
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_ContextAssignment_FallsBackToGeneral — unmatched term
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_NilContextMap — all "General"
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_SentenceActivitiesExtracted — verb as term
TestGlossaryExtractor_Extract_SortedOutput — lexicographic
```

**Shared kernel test** (internal/shared/domain/valueobjects/ubiquitous_language_entry_test.go):
```
TestUbiquitousLanguageEntry_WithTrust_Upgrade — AIResearched → UserStated
TestUbiquitousLanguageEntry_WithTrust_NoDowngrade — UserStated → AIResearched unchanged
TestUbiquitousLanguageEntry_WithTrust_SourceCleared — upgrade clears source
```

**Application tests** (internal/discovery/application/glossary_export_handler_test.go):
```
TestGlossaryExportHandler_Export_HappyPath — reader + writer called correctly
TestGlossaryExportHandler_Export_StoryReadError — wrapped error with path
TestGlossaryExportHandler_Export_GlossaryWriteError — wrapped error
TestGlossaryExportHandler_Export_EmptyStoryPaths — empty entries written
TestGlossaryExportHandler_Export_NilContextMap — succeeds, all "General"
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Add WithTrust to UbiquitousLanguageEntry (shared kernel)
2. Create glossary_extractor.go (domain)
3. Create glossary_export_handler.go (application)
4. Wire in composition/app.go

### REFACTOR Phase

- Use strings.EqualFold consistently (not strings.ToLower comparison)
- Verify error messages: lowercase, no punctuation, %w
- golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

1. Add WithTrust to UbiquitousLanguageEntry + 3 tests
2. Create glossary_extractor_test.go with 9 RED tests
3. Create glossary_extractor.go — implement Extract
4. Create glossary_export_handler_test.go with 5 RED tests
5. Create glossary_export_handler.go — implement Export
6. Wire GlossaryExportHandler in composition/app.go
7. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] WithTrust added to UbiquitousLanguageEntry (shared kernel) — no downgrade, source cleared on upgrade
- [ ] GlossaryExtractor in internal/discovery/domain/ with zero external imports
- [ ] Extract with nil contextMap assigns "General" to all entries
- [ ] Dedup by case-insensitive term name, higher trust wins, story refs merged
- [ ] Sorted output lexicographically by Term()
- [ ] Definition generated from actor type/work object type/sentence pattern
- [ ] GlossaryExportHandler calls StoryReader.Read per path, then Extract, then GlossaryWriter.Write
- [ ] Empty storyPaths → empty entries written, no error
- [ ] StoryReader/GlossaryWriter errors wrapped with context
- [ ] GlossaryYAMLParser NOT modified
- [ ] StoryYAMLParser NOT modified
- [ ] App.GlossaryExportHandler wired in composition root
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass, coverage >= 80%

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty story list | storyPaths = [] | Empty entries written |
| Actor and work object share name | "Order" as both | Single deduplicated entry |
| AIResearched trust with empty source | Actor with AIResearched, source="" | NewUbiquitousLanguageEntry error propagated |
| Whitespace-only activity | Activity = "  " | Skipped (don't create entry) |
| Nil contextMap | nil | All entries get "General" context |
| Same actor in 2 stories, different trust | UserStated + AIInferred | Merged, UserStated wins |
| StoryReader returns error | os.ErrNotExist | Wrapped error with failing path (fail-fast) |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race
```

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] StoryReader port: ports.go:113-116
- [ ] GlossaryWriter port: ports.go:131-133
- [ ] GlossaryYAMLParser compile-time guard: glossary_yaml_parser.go:17-21
- [ ] StoryYAMLParser compile-time guard: story_yaml_parser.go:20-22
- [ ] NewUbiquitousLanguageEntry: ubiquitous_language_entry.go:24-60 (requires non-empty definition)
- [ ] WithStories: ubiquitous_language_entry.go:128-142
- [ ] No existing WithTrust on UbiquitousLanguageEntry (must be added)
- [ ] DomainStory.Title(): domain_story.go:198
- [ ] BoundedContextSketch.Actors()/WorkObjects(): bounded_context_sketch.go:108-117
- [ ] App struct has no GlossaryExportHandler field: app.go:49-109

## Risks / Dependencies

- Depends on alty-cli-1wu.22 (P5-1: full sketch persistence) for session storyRefs availability
- WithTrust addition to shared kernel UbiquitousLanguageEntry — small scope, follows existing pattern
- Activity verbs may be noisy — downstream filtering by category deferred to Phase 6
- No annotation-derived terms in this ticket — NLP/LLM extraction deferred
- contextMap may be nil when boundary detection hasn't run
notes:
**Grooming fix (2026-03-27):** Critical: must wire StoryYAMLParser{} and GlossaryYAMLParser{} in composition/app.go NewApp(). Both are zero-value structs. Store as named variables so P5-4/P5-5/P5-6 can reuse them:
```go
storyParser := &discoveryinfra.StoryYAMLParser{}
glossaryParser := &discoveryinfra.GlossaryYAMLParser{}
```
Inject storyParser as StoryReader and glossaryParser as GlossaryWriter into GlossaryExportHandler. GlossaryYAMLParser implements BOTH GlossaryReader and GlossaryWriter — P5-6 will reuse it as GlossaryReader.

DDD.md glossary update required: add GlossaryExtractor (domain service) and GlossaryExportHandler (application handler).
close_reason: P5-2 glossary export + P5-3 context map export implemented. WithTrust shared kernel addition, GlossaryExtractor domain service, GlossaryExportHandler, BuildContextMap domain function, ContextMapExportHandler. 32 tests total (17+15). All wired in composition root.

title: [Phase 5] Full BoundedContextSketch persistence in session snapshot
description:
## Goal / Problem

The v1 snapshot (ToSnapshot/FromSnapshot in discovery_session.go) persists confirmed boundary sketches as a flat list of name strings (line 607-610). On reload, every sketch is reconstructed with defaults: SubdomainGeneric, confidence=0, nil actors/workObjects/stories/signals, AIInferred trust (lines 903-919). All rich sketch data is silently discarded.

Phase 5 export handlers (glossary.yaml, context-map.yaml, PlantUML, Egon) query session.ConfirmedSketches() to drive output. If they receive stripped sketches, every export produces empty or wrong results.

This ticket upgrades ToSnapshot/FromSnapshot to persist the full BoundedContextSketch value (all 8 fields). Backward-compatible: v1 snapshots (name-only strings) continue to deserialize correctly.

**Scope note:** Export state tracking (ExportFormat VO, producedExports) is OUT OF SCOPE per TL review — export tracking is not a discovery domain concern. It belongs in a separate context when export handlers are designed.

## Background / Context

- v1 sketch serialization: discovery_session.go:606-610 — names only
- v1 sketch reconstruction: discovery_session.go:893-925 — defaults applied
- BoundedContextSketch fields: bounded_context_sketch.go:23-32 — name, classification, confidence, actors, workObjects, stories, signals, trust
- BoundarySignal: boundary_signal.go:109-112 — signalType + description
- SignalType: boundary_signal.go:25-34 — 9 enum values
- SubdomainClassification: domain_values.go:10 — string enum
- TrustLevel: trust_level.go:13 — int with ParseTrustLevel at :54
- FileSystemSessionRepository: filesystem_session_repository.go:31-74 — calls ToSnapshot/FromSnapshot. No changes needed.
- Existing v1 backward-compat pattern: discovery_session.go:871-889

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (internal/discovery/) |
| Ubiquitous Language | BoundedContextSketch, BoundarySignal, SignalType, SubdomainClassification, TrustLevel, DiscoverySession |
| Layer | Domain (internal/discovery/domain/discovery_session.go) only. No infrastructure or application changes. |

## Design

### Snapshot Schema Change

v1 (current):
```json
"confirmed_sketches": ["Ordering", "Shipping"]
```

v2 (new):
```json
"confirmed_sketches": [
  {
    "name": "Ordering",
    "classification": "core",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "actors": ["Customer", "Platform"],
    "work_objects": ["Order", "Shopping Cart"],
    "stories": ["s1.yaml"],
    "signals": [
      {"type": "different_trigger", "description": "..."}
    ],
    "trust": "user_stated"
  }
]
```

### Implementation Strategy

Use unexported helper structs for type-safe serialization (TL recommendation I1):

```go
// sketchSnapshot is an unexported intermediary for type-safe sketch serialization.
type sketchSnapshot struct {
    Name           string            `json:"-"` // not used — map key pattern
    Classification string
    Confidence     float64
    Actors         []string
    WorkObjects    []string
    Stories        []string
    Signals        []signalSnapshot
    Trust          string
}

type signalSnapshot struct {
    Type        string
    Description string
}
```

Private helpers:
- `sketchToMap(BoundedContextSketch) map[string]interface{}` — serialize
- `sketchFromMap(map[string]interface{}) (BoundedContextSketch, error)` — deserialize using NewBoundedContextSketch constructor

### Backward Compatibility Rules

1. confirmed_sketches contains string items (v1) → reconstruct with defaults (existing logic preserved)
2. confirmed_sketches contains map items (v2) → reconstruct from full fields via constructors
3. Mixed types → return error (reject ambiguous format)
4. Invalid signal type, classification, confidence, or trust on load → return error (fail-fast)

### Sequence Flow

```
ToSnapshot: DiscoverySession.confirmedSketches → []sketchSnapshot → []map[string]interface{}
FromSnapshot: []interface{} → type-switch → string (v1 path) OR map (v2 path) → BoundedContextSketch
```

No changes to FileSystemSessionRepository — it just marshals/unmarshals the map.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| SRP | Snapshot encoding is ToSnapshot/FromSnapshot's single responsibility. Helper structs exist only for serialization. |
| OCP | v2 format is additive. v1 branch preserved unchanged. New fields can be added without modifying v1 path. |
| LSP | N/A — no interfaces involved. |
| ISP | N/A — no new interfaces. |
| DIP | Domain depends on zero external packages beyond stdlib encoding. FileSystemSessionRepository depends on domain snapshot contract (unchanged direction). |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

File: internal/discovery/domain/discovery_session_test.go (additions)

```
TestDiscoverySession_Snapshot_RoundTrip_FullSketchData
  — Sketch with classification=core, confidence=0.85, actors=["Customer"],
    workObjects=["Order"], stories=["s1.yaml"],
    signals=[{one_way_flow, "desc"}], trust=user_stated:
    all 8 fields preserved after ToSnapshot → JSON → FromSnapshot

TestDiscoverySession_Snapshot_RoundTrip_MultipleSignals
  — Sketch with 3 signals of different types survives round-trip

TestDiscoverySession_FromSnapshot_V1Sketches_NameOnlyStrings
  — v1 format []string deserializes with defaults. No regression.

TestDiscoverySession_FromSnapshot_V2Sketches_InvalidSignalType
  — signals: [{type: "bad_signal"}] returns error

TestDiscoverySession_FromSnapshot_V2Sketches_InvalidClassification
  — classification: "premium" returns error

TestDiscoverySession_FromSnapshot_V2Sketches_ConfidenceOutOfRange
  — confidence: 1.5 returns error

TestDiscoverySession_FromSnapshot_V2Sketches_MixedFormat
  — array with both string and map items returns error

TestDiscoverySession_Snapshot_RoundTrip_EmptySketches
  — ConfirmBoundaries([]) round-trips to empty slice

TestDiscoverySession_Snapshot_RoundTrip_NilSlicesInSketch
  — Sketch with nil actors/workObjects/stories/signals round-trips
    as empty slices (not nil)

TestDiscoverySession_Snapshot_RoundTrip_ConfidenceLevelPreserved
  — Sketch with confidence=0.7 → after round-trip, ConfidenceLevel()
    returns HIGH (>= 0.65)
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Add unexported sketchSnapshot/signalSnapshot helper structs
2. Add sketchToMap and sketchFromMap helper functions
3. Upgrade ToSnapshot sketch block (lines 606-610)
4. Upgrade FromSnapshot sketch block (lines 892-925) with v1/v2 type-switch

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify error messages follow project pattern (lowercase, no punctuation, %w)
- Verify no json struct tags leaked into domain types
- golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

1. Write 10 failing tests in discovery_session_test.go
2. Add sketchSnapshot/signalSnapshot structs + sketchToMap/sketchFromMap helpers
3. Upgrade ToSnapshot sketch serialization (replace lines 606-610)
4. Upgrade FromSnapshot sketch deserialization (replace lines 892-925 with v1/v2 type-switch)
5. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ToSnapshot emits confirmed_sketches as []map[string]interface{} with all 8 sketch fields
- [ ] FromSnapshot with v2 maps reconstructs BoundedContextSketch with all fields matching original
- [ ] FromSnapshot with v1 strings ([]string or []interface{} of strings) produces sketches with defaults — no regression
- [ ] FromSnapshot with invalid signal type returns error
- [ ] FromSnapshot with invalid classification returns error
- [ ] FromSnapshot with confidence out of range (>1 or <0) returns error
- [ ] FromSnapshot with mixed types (string + map) returns error
- [ ] Nil/empty slice fields in sketch round-trip as empty slices
- [ ] ConfidenceLevel() computes correctly after round-trip
- [ ] internal/discovery/domain/ has zero new external imports
- [ ] FileSystemSessionRepository unchanged (no infra changes)
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass
- [ ] Existing v1 backward-compat tests still pass

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| v1 snapshot (name-only strings) | confirmed_sketches: ["Ordering"] | Sketches with defaults, no error |
| v2 sketch with nil slice fields | actors=nil | Empty slices after round-trip |
| Invalid signal type | signals: [{type: "bad"}] | Error from NewSignalType |
| Invalid classification | classification: "premium" | Error from NewBoundedContextSketch |
| Confidence out of range | confidence: 1.5 | Error from NewBoundedContextSketch |
| Mixed string + map types | ["Ordering", {name: "Shipping"}] | Error (ambiguous format) |
| JSON float64 precision | confidence: 0.85 | float64(0.85) preserved |
| Empty confirmed_sketches | [] | Empty slice, no error |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -race -count=1
go test ./... -race -count=1
```

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] BoundedContextSketch getters verified: Name():99, Classification():102, Confidence():105, Actors():108, WorkObjects():116, Stories():123, Signals():132, Trust():140 (bounded_context_sketch.go)
- [ ] NewBoundedContextSketch constructor verified: bounded_context_sketch.go:35 — 8 params
- [ ] BoundarySignal constructor verified: boundary_signal.go:115
- [ ] NewSignalType verified: boundary_signal.go:49
- [ ] vo.ParseTrustLevel verified: trust_level.go:54
- [ ] ToSnapshot sketch block: discovery_session.go:606-610
- [ ] FromSnapshot sketch block: discovery_session.go:892-925
- [ ] FromSnapshot return struct: discovery_session.go:937-955
- [ ] FileSystemSessionRepository.Save: filesystem_session_repository.go:36 — calls ToSnapshot
- [ ] FileSystemSessionRepository.Load: filesystem_session_repository.go:68 — calls FromSnapshot

## Risks / Dependencies

- JSON float64 precision: encoding/json decodes numbers as float64. confidence stored as 0.85 decodes as float64(0.85). Use type-switch in FromSnapshot.
- nil vs empty slice: NewBoundedContextSketch accepts nil slices. JSON null for slice fields must be treated as empty on load.
- This is Phase 5 Layer 1: all other Phase 5 export tickets depend on this.
- No application or infrastructure changes in this ticket.

title: [Phase 4] Partial knowledge merge — user-stated + ai-researched reconciliation
description:
## Goal / Problem

When the AI research proposes a story and the user narrates their own additions, two *DomainStory values exist: proposed (all AIResearched) and narrated (UserStated/UserConfirmed). Before saving, these must be reconciled into one canonical story. Rule: user-stated knowledge is NEVER overridden by AI-researched knowledge. Overlap detection is case-insensitive.

This ticket delivers MergeStories(narrated, proposed *DomainStory) (*DomainStory, error) — a pure domain function.

## Background / Context

- Spike: docs/research/20260323_7_ai_domain_research_quality.md Section 6 (merge strategy rules), Section 9 ("do not fabricate" rule)
- Duplicate guards: domain_story.go:68-91 — AddActor/AddWorkObject use strings.EqualFold, return ErrInvariantViolation on dup
- Trust level: trust_level.go:83 — IsHigherTrust returns t < other (lower int = higher trust)
- No RemoveActor on DomainStory — must build resolved list before calling Add*
- Pattern: boundary_scoring.go — standalone domain function, no receiver

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (internal/discovery/domain/) |
| Ubiquitous Language | MergeStories, DomainStory, StoryActor, WorkObject, TrustLevel, UserStated, AIResearched |
| Layer | Domain — zero external dependencies |

## Design

### Merge Rules

1. Narrated story metadata (title, type, time, purity, trigger) preserved
2. All narrated actors/work objects carried over at original trust
3. Proposed actor added ONLY if no narrated actor has same name (case-insensitive)
4. Same rule for work objects
5. When both have same-name element, higher trust (lower int) wins
6. Sentences, annotations, variations from narrated ONLY (proposed sentences not merged)

### Function Signature

```go
func MergeStories(narrated, proposed *DomainStory) (*DomainStory, error)
```

Returns ErrInvariantViolation if either input nil or if merged story fails Validate().

### Implementation Strategy

Build resolved actor/work object lists BEFORE calling AddActor/AddWorkObject (no RemoveActor exists). For each proposed element, check case-insensitive match against narrated set. If no match → add. If match → keep higher-trust version.

Files: internal/discovery/domain/merge_stories.go (+test)

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**RP | MergeStories does one thing: element-level reconciliation by trust |
| **O**CP | New trust levels extend via IsHigherTrust comparison |
| **I**SP | No new interface — standalone domain function |
| **D**IP | Depends only on domain types + vo.TrustLevel |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

File: internal/discovery/domain/merge_stories_test.go

```
TestMergeStories_AllNarratedPreserved — narrated + non-overlapping proposed → both present
TestMergeStories_UserActorWinsOnCollision — "Pet Owner" (UserStated) vs "pet owner" (AIResearched) → UserStated wins
TestMergeStories_UserWorkObjectWinsOnCollision — same for work objects
TestMergeStories_ProposedActorNotInNarratedIsAdded — new AI actors added
TestMergeStories_ProposedWorkObjectNotInNarratedIsAdded — new AI work objects added
TestMergeStories_SentencesFromNarratedOnly — narrated 2 sentences, proposed 3 → merged has 2
TestMergeStories_MetadataFromNarrated — title, type, trigger from narrated
TestMergeStories_EmptyProposed — merged equals narrated
TestMergeStories_NilNarratedReturnsError — ErrInvariantViolation
TestMergeStories_NilProposedReturnsError — ErrInvariantViolation
TestMergeStories_HigherTrustProposedWins — narrated AIResearched, proposed UserConfirmed → UserConfirmed wins
TestMergeStories_AnnotationsFromNarratedOnly — annotations not merged from proposed
TestMergeStories_VariationsFromNarratedOnly — variations not merged from proposed
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Create merge_stories.go — build resolved lists, construct merged story, Validate
2. All 13 tests pass

### REFACTOR Phase

- Extract narratedActorByName helper (unexported)
- golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

title: [Phase 4] TrustLevelTracker — trust propagation for AI-researched story elements
description:
## Goal / Problem

When P4-3 builds DomainStory proposals from research, all elements carry vo.AIResearched trust. As the user confirms/edits sentences via ConfirmSentence, trust must upgrade: accept unedited → UserConfirmed, accept edited → UserStated. Trust never downgrades (lower int = higher trust).

This ticket adds WithTrust copy-on-write methods to StoryActor, WorkObject, StorySentence, plus UpgradeActorTrust/UpgradeWorkObjectTrust on DomainStory, plus PropagateConfirmation orchestration function. Pure domain logic, no infrastructure.

## Background / Context

- Spike: docs/research/20260323_7_ai_domain_research_quality.md Section 8 — trust propagation rules
- TrustLevel: internal/shared/domain/valueobjects/trust_level.go — UserStated=1, UserConfirmed=2, AIResearched=3, AIInferred=4. IsHigherTrust at line 82: t < other
- StoryActor trust field: story_actor.go:82, source invariant at 101-103 (only required for AIResearched)
- WorkObject trust field: work_object.go:97, source invariant at 116-119
- StorySentence trust field: story_sentence.go:38, source invariant at 72-75
- WithPreposition pattern: story_sentence.go:88 — existing copy-on-write precedent
- ConfirmSentence: ports.go:163 — returns (StorySentence, bool, error), bool is accepted
- Settled: .notes/order.md — "TrustLevel deferred from VOs in P4-0. Added in P4-4."

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (internal/discovery/domain/) |
| Ubiquitous Language | TrustLevel, UserConfirmed, UserStated, AIResearched, WithTrust, PropagateConfirmation |
| Layer | Domain — zero external dependencies |

## Design

### Propagation Rules

| Trigger | Sentence | Actor | WorkObject |
|---------|----------|-------|------------|
| Accept unedited | UserConfirmed | UserConfirmed | UserConfirmed |
| Accept edited (any field changed) | UserStated | UserStated | UserStated |
| Rejected | No change | No change | No change |

Edit detected by comparing Subject/Activity/Object fields (case-sensitive).

### New Methods

```go
// Copy-on-write trust upgrade. Guards: only upgrades (IsHigherTrust). Source cleared for non-AIResearched.
func (s StorySentence) WithTrust(newTrust vo.TrustLevel) StorySentence
func (a StoryActor) WithTrust(newTrust vo.TrustLevel) StoryActor
func (w WorkObject) WithTrust(newTrust vo.TrustLevel) WorkObject

// Aggregate mutations — upgrade named element in-place. No-op if not found.
func (d *DomainStory) UpgradeActorTrust(name string, newTrust vo.TrustLevel) error
func (d *DomainStory) UpgradeWorkObjectTrust(name string, newTrust vo.TrustLevel) error

// Orchestration — standalone domain function
func PropagateConfirmation(proposed, confirmed StorySentence, accepted bool, story *DomainStory) (StorySentence, error)
```

Files: internal/discovery/domain/trust_propagation.go (+test), methods on existing VOs in trust_propagation.go, aggregate methods in domain_story.go.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**RP | trust_propagation.go owns all trust-upgrade logic |
| **O**CP | WithTrust extends VOs via copy-on-write without modifying constructors |
| **L**SP | WithTrust honours same invariants as constructors |
| **I**SP | No new interface. PropagateConfirmation is a free function |
| **D**IP | Domain function depends only on domain types |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

File: internal/discovery/domain/trust_propagation_test.go

```
TestStorySentence_WithTrust_UpgradesFromAIResearched — AIResearched → UserConfirmed, source cleared
TestStorySentence_WithTrust_NoDowngrade — UserConfirmed → AIResearched rejected
TestStoryActor_WithTrust_UpgradesFromAIResearched — trust upgraded, source cleared
TestWorkObject_WithTrust_UpgradesFromAIResearched — trust upgraded, source cleared
TestDomainStory_UpgradeActorTrust_Upgrades — case-insensitive name match
TestDomainStory_UpgradeActorTrust_NotFoundIsNoOp — unknown name, no error
TestDomainStory_UpgradeWorkObjectTrust_Upgrades — upgrades work object
TestPropagateConfirmation_AcceptUnedited — all → UserConfirmed
TestPropagateConfirmation_AcceptEdited_SubjectChanged — all → UserStated
TestPropagateConfirmation_AcceptEdited_ActivityChanged — all → UserStated
TestPropagateConfirmation_AcceptEdited_ObjectChanged — all → UserStated
TestPropagateConfirmation_Rejected — no changes
TestPropagateConfirmation_PreservesHigherTrust — UserStated not downgraded to UserConfirmed
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Create trust_propagation.go with WithTrust methods + PropagateConfirmation
2. Add UpgradeActorTrust/UpgradeWorkObjectTrust to domain_story.go
3. All tests pass

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify no-downgrade guard in all WithTrust methods
- golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

1. Create trust_propagation.go — WithTrust on StorySentence/StoryActor/WorkObject, PropagateConfirmation
2. Add UpgradeActorTrust/UpgradeWorkObjectTrust to domain_story.go
3. Create trust_propagation_test.go — 13 tests
4. Wire PropagateConfirmation into StorytellingHandler.RunStory after ConfirmSentence (line 176)
5. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] WithTrust on StorySentence/StoryActor/WorkObject never downgrades trust
- [ ] Source cleared when upgrading away from AIResearched
- [ ] UpgradeActorTrust/UpgradeWorkObjectTrust case-insensitive, no-op if not found
- [ ] PropagateConfirmation returns proposed unchanged when rejected
- [ ] Accept unedited → UserConfirmed on sentence + actor + work object
- [ ] Accept edited → UserStated on sentence + actor + work object
- [ ] StorySentence.WithTrust preserves indirect object (WithPreposition)
- [ ] PropagateConfirmation wired in StorytellingHandler.RunStory
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass, coverage >= 80%

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Already UserStated, upgrade to UserConfirmed | IsHigherTrust false | No change |
| Already UserConfirmed, upgrade to UserConfirmed | Same trust | No change |
| AIResearched with source URL | WithTrust(UserConfirmed) | Trust upgraded, source cleared |
| Rejected sentence | accepted false | Proposed returned unchanged |
| Actor not in story | UpgradeActorTrust("Unknown") | No-op, nil error |
| Object is actor name | UpgradeWorkObjectTrust no-op | Sentence trust still upgraded |
| Only preposition changed | Subject/Activity/Object same | Counts as unedited → UserConfirmed |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./... && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./... -race
```

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] IsHigherTrust at trust_level.go:82 returns t < other — confirmed correct
- [ ] Source not required for UserConfirmed/UserStated (story_actor.go:101 only checks AIResearched)
- [ ] DomainStory.actors is []StoryActor (values), replaceable by index
- [ ] ConfirmSentence at ports.go:163 returns (StorySentence, bool, error)
- [ ] WithPreposition at story_sentence.go:88 preserves indirect object — WithTrust must call it

## Risks / Dependencies

- Depends on P4-0 (alty-cli-1wu.16) — domain VOs must exist. However P4-4 is self-contained in domain layer and testable independently.
- Edit detection is case-sensitive string equality. If P4-3 normalizes names differently than user types, false edits detected. Acceptable for this phase.
- StorySentence.WithTrust silently swallows constructor error (fields already validated). Add comment explaining invariant.

title: [Phase 4] Research-to-story transformer (consultant-proposes pattern)
description:
## Goal / Problem

Implement ResearchToStoryTransformer — an application-layer service that takes a *DomainResearchResult (from P4-2) and produces up to 3 coarse-grained *DomainStory proposals (happy_path, failure_case, secondary). The caller (StorytellingHandler) presents each via ProposeStory for user confirmation/refinement. This is the consultant-proposes pattern from DDD.md Story 1 step 9.

## Background / Context

- Spike: docs/research/20260323_7_ai_domain_research_quality.md — Section 8 (how moderator consumes research: actors → DST sentences, entities → work objects, workflows → proposed stories)
- DomainStory aggregate: internal/discovery/domain/domain_story.go:29-65 — constructor, AddActor, AddWorkObject, AddSentence, Validate
- StoryActor source invariant: internal/discovery/domain/story_actor.go:101-103 — source must be non-empty when trust is AIResearched
- WorkObject source invariant: internal/discovery/domain/work_object.go:116-119 — same
- StorySentence source invariant: internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence.go:72-75 — same
- Case-insensitive dedup: internal/discovery/domain/domain_story.go:69-71 — AddActor duplicate guard
- ProposeStory stub: internal/discovery/application/ports.go:155-157 — already declared, needs a real caller
- StorytellingHandler constructor: internal/discovery/application/storytelling_handler.go:25-33 — currently 2 params, adding transformer is a breaking change to audit

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | ResearchToStoryTransformer, DomainResearchResult, DomainStory, StoryActor, WorkObject, StorySentence, coarse-grained, consultant-proposes |
| Layer | Application — pure VO-to-VO orchestration, zero infrastructure imports |

## Design

### Mapping Rules

| Research Type | Domain Type | Trust | Source Fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| ResearchedActor → StoryActor | ActorTypePerson (default) | vo.AIResearched | "domain research" |
| ResearchedEntity → WorkObject | WorkObjectTypeDocument (default) | vo.AIResearched | "domain research" |
| WorkflowStep → StorySentence | step/subject/activity/object | vo.AIResearched | first workflow sourceURL or "domain research" |

All stories: StoryTypeCoarseGrained, TimeTypeAsIs, PurityTypeDigitalized.

### Quality Gate

Transform checks result.Quality().MeetsFloor before any construction. If false, returns nil, nil (empty stories, no error). Caller decides fallback — matches spike "do not fabricate" rule.

### Actor/WorkObject Resolution

Per story, collect unique names from WorkflowSteps (case-insensitive). Match against result.Actors/Entities. If no match, construct minimal VO with fallback source. This ensures story.Validate() passes (all sentence subjects/objects reference known actors/work objects).

### Constructor

```go
type ResearchToStoryTransformer struct{} // stateless
func NewResearchToStoryTransformer() *ResearchToStoryTransformer
func (t *ResearchToStoryTransformer) Transform(ctx context.Context, result *discoverydomain.DomainResearchResult) ([]*discoverydomain.DomainStory, error)
```

Private helpers: buildStory, resolveActors, resolveWorkObjects, sourceFallback.

### StorytellingHandler Wiring

Add transformer *ResearchToStoryTransformer field to StorytellingHandler. Update NewStorytellingHandler (may be nil for user-narrates path). AUDIT call sites first: grep -rn "NewStorytellingHandler" to find all callers (guide.go, integration tests).

Files: internal/discovery/application/research_to_story_transformer.go (+test)

| **S**RP | Transform maps research to stories. No persistence, no prompting. |
| **O**CP | P4-4 extends constructors for trust; transformer not modified. |
| **L**SP | All returned DomainStory pass Validate(). |
| **I**SP | No new interface — concrete application service. |
| **D**IP | No infrastructure dependency to invert. |

title: [Phase 4] WebSearchDomainResearcher infrastructure adapter + composition wiring
description:
## Goal / Problem

Implement WebSearchDomainResearcher, the infrastructure adapter fulfilling the DomainResearcher port (P4-1). 3-step pipeline: (1) generate 4-5 search queries via LLM StructuredOutput, (2) execute queries against DuckDuckGo Lite via net/http, (3) extract structured DomainResearchResult from raw HTML via LLM StructuredOutput. Wire in composition root as App.DomainResearcher.

Returns (nil, nil) for graceful degradation when LLM unavailable or all queries fail (ADR-013).

## Background / Context

- Spike: docs/research/20260323_7_ai_domain_research_quality.md — Section 5 (query templates), Section 8 (schema), Section 9 (quality floor including 5th criterion: queries returning results >= 2)
- LLM adapter pattern: internal/discovery/infrastructure/llm_boundary_detector.go:34-99 — takes llm.Client, calls StructuredOutput, checks ErrLLMUnavailable, returns (nil, nil)
- Prompt+schema pattern: internal/discovery/infrastructure/llm_doc_reader_adapter.go:97-148
- llm.Client interface: internal/shared/infrastructure/llm/client.go:101-107
- Composition wiring: internal/composition/app.go — App struct lines 57-62, NewApp hybrid detector block lines 187-193
- Settled: .notes/order.md — LLM extracts from raw HTML (no golang.org/x/net/html), search-specific error sentinel, (nil, nil) degradation

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | DomainResearcher, DomainResearchResult, SearchMetadata, ResearchedActor, ResearchedEntity, ResearchedWorkflow |
| Layer | Infrastructure (implements DomainResearcher port) + Composition (wiring) |

## Design

### Adapter Structure

```go
// ErrSearchUnavailable — search-specific sentinel (not reusing ErrLLMUnavailable)
var ErrSearchUnavailable = errors.New("web search unavailable")

type webSearchDomainResearcher struct {
    client     llm.Client
    httpClient *http.Client
}

func NewWebSearchDomainResearcher(client llm.Client, httpClient *http.Client) *webSearchDomainResearcher
var _ discoveryapp.DomainResearcher = (*webSearchDomainResearcher)(nil)
```

### Pipeline

1. **generateQueries(ctx, domain)** — StructuredOutput with query templates from spike Section 5. Returns 4-5 queries. (nil, nil) on ErrLLMUnavailable.
2. **executeSearches(ctx, queries)** — GET https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/?q=<encoded> per query. Truncate response to 4096 bytes. Skip HTTP errors, collect successes. If resultsWithContent < 2, return (nil, nil) — 5th quality floor criterion.
3. **extractKnowledge(ctx, domain, rawResults)** — StructuredOutput with concatenated HTML + extraction schema. Unmarshal JSON → domain VO constructors (NewResearchedActor, etc.). (nil, nil) on ErrLLMUnavailable.

### Constants

| Constant | Value | Rationale |
|----------|-------|-----------|
| maxRawHTMLBytes | 4096 | Truncation limit per settled decision |
| minQueriesWithResults | 2 | 5th quality floor criterion from spike Section 9 |
| duckduckgoLiteURL | "https://lite.duckduckgo.com/lite/" | No API key required |

### Composition Wiring

App struct: add `DomainResearcher discoveryapp.DomainResearcher` after BoundaryDetector.
NewApp: `domainResearcher := discoveryinfra.NewWebSearchDomainResearcher(llmClient, &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second})`

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**RP | Single adapter, one port method. Pipeline stages are private functions. |
| **O**CP | New search backends are new adapters. This one is not modified. |
| **L**SP | Any DomainResearcher adapter is substitutable. NoopClient triggers degradation. |
| **I**SP | DomainResearcher has 1 method. |
| **D**IP | Depends on llm.Client interface, not AnthropicClient. |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

File: internal/discovery/infrastructure/web_search_domain_researcher_test.go

```
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_HappyPath — stub LLM + httptest server → non-nil result
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_LLMUnavailableAtQueryGen — (nil, nil)
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_LLMUnavailableAtExtraction — (nil, nil)
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_AllQueriesFail — HTTP 500 for all → (nil, nil)
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_FewerThanTwoResults — 1 of 4 succeed → (nil, nil)
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_PartialHTTPFailures — 2 of 4 succeed → non-nil result
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_RawHTMLTruncated — 10000-byte response → 4096 in prompt
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_NonAvailabilityLLMError — errors.New("timeout") → propagated error
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_EmptyDomain — error before any I/O
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_MalformedExtractionJSON — error wrapping "parsing extraction response"
TestWebSearchDomainResearcher_SearchMetadata — QueriesUsed, SearchDuration populated
```

### GREEN Phase

1. Create web_search_domain_researcher.go with adapter + private pipeline functions
2. Wire in composition/app.go
3. All tests pass

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify error wrapping uses lowercase
- Run golangci-lint → 0 issues

## Steps

1. Create internal/discovery/infrastructure/web_search_domain_researcher_test.go — 11 tests using httptest.NewServer + multi-call LLM stub
2. Create internal/discovery/infrastructure/web_search_domain_researcher.go — adapter with ErrSearchUnavailable, pipeline, compile-time check
3. Wire in internal/composition/app.go — App.DomainResearcher field + NewApp construction
4. Run all quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Compile-time check: var _ discoveryapp.DomainResearcher = (*webSearchDomainResearcher)(nil)
- [ ] Step 1: calls StructuredOutput for query generation, returns 4-5 queries
- [ ] Step 2: GET DuckDuckGo Lite per query, truncate to 4096 bytes, skip HTTP errors
- [ ] Quality floor: (nil, nil) when < 2 queries return results
- [ ] Step 3: calls StructuredOutput for extraction, unmarshals into domain VOs
- [ ] ErrSearchUnavailable sentinel defined (NOT reusing ErrLLMUnavailable)
- [ ] errors.Is(err, llm.ErrLLMUnavailable) at both LLM call sites → (nil, nil)
- [ ] Non-availability LLM errors wrapped and returned
- [ ] Empty domain returns error before any I/O
- [ ] SearchMetadata populated (QueriesUsed, SearchDuration)
- [ ] App.DomainResearcher wired in composition root
- [ ] All 11 tests pass, no real HTTP calls (httptest only)
- [ ] go build/vet/lint/test all pass, coverage >= 80%

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| LLM unavailable at query gen | ErrLLMUnavailable call 1 | (nil, nil) |
| LLM unavailable at extraction | ErrLLMUnavailable call 2 | (nil, nil) |
| All HTTP 500 | 0 of 4 queries succeed | (nil, nil) |
| Only 1 query succeeds | 1 of 4 | (nil, nil) — below floor |
| Exactly 2 succeed | 2 of 4 | Proceeds to extraction |
| 10000-byte HTML | large response | Truncated to 4096 |
| Malformed JSON from LLM | "not json" | Error wrapping parse |
| Empty domain | "" | Error before I/O |
| Non-LLM error | errors.New("timeout") | Error propagated (not nil, nil) |
| Context cancelled mid-search | cancel before HTTP response | Query treated as failed, continues if others succeed |

## Quality Gates

```bash
go build ./... && go vet ./... && golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./... -race
```

## Pre-Implementation Validation

- [ ] P4-0 (alty-cli-1wu.16) CLOSED — domain VO constructors exist
- [ ] P4-1 (alty-cli-1wu.17) CLOSED — DomainResearcher port exists in ports.go
- [ ] llm.Client.StructuredOutput signature at client.go:101 matches
- [ ] App struct has no existing DomainResearcher field
- [ ] net/http is stdlib — no new go.mod dependency

## Risks / Dependencies

- BLOCKED by P4-1 (alty-cli-1wu.17) and transitively P4-0 (alty-cli-1wu.16)
- DuckDuckGo Lite endpoint has no SLA — graceful degradation handles outages
- LLM HTML extraction quality depends on prompt engineering — quality floor gates downstream use
- Test stub needs multi-call pattern (call 1 = query gen, call 2 = extraction) — use index counter, don't modify existing stubLLMClient

| Bounded Context | Discovery (internal/discovery/) |
| Ubiquitous Language | DomainResearcher (new canonical term), DomainResearchResult (P4-0) |
| Layer | Application (internal/discovery/application/ports.go) — port interface only |

## Design

Append to internal/discovery/application/ports.go after line 227:

```go
// --- Domain Researcher Port ---

// DomainResearcher investigates a domain description using external sources
// and returns structured knowledge for the moderator's story-proposal phase.
// Research is optional infrastructure: callers treat (nil, nil) as "research
// unavailable — proceed with user-narrated mode" (ADR-013 graceful degradation).
type DomainResearcher interface {
    // Research executes domain research for the given description and returns
    // structured findings. Returns (nil, nil) when research infrastructure is
    // unavailable (no credentials, network unreachable). Returns (nil, err) for
    // unexpected failures the caller should surface.
    Research(ctx context.Context, domainDescription string) (*discoverydomain.DomainResearchResult, error)
}
```

Why pointer return: allows nil as graceful-degradation sentinel. Why ctx: web search is I/O, must respect cancellation. No new imports needed (context and discoverydomain already imported).

### Data Models

|-------|------|------|-------|
| DomainResearcher | Port interface | application/ports.go | Defined in this ticket |
| DomainResearchResult | Value Object | domain/ (P4-0) | Must exist before this compiles |

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | One interface, one method. No quality evaluation, no trust tracking, no story transformation. |
| **O**pen/Closed | New research strategies are new adapters implementing this port. |
| **L**iskov Substitution | All adapters must honor (nil, nil) = unavailable contract. |
| **I**nterface Segregation | Single-method interface per ISP. |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Consumers depend on this interface, never concrete adapters. |

