title: [Phase 2] StorytellingPrompter port interface
description:
## Goal / Problem

Define the StorytellingPrompter port interface in internal/discovery/application/ports.go, add supporting value types (Choice, SynthesisSummary), and retire the old 4-method Prompter interface. This is the boundary contract that all Phase 2 handler and adapter work depends on.

Phase: 2, Ticket 1 of the Domain Storytelling Discovery Redesign epic.
ADR reference: ADR-014 — docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:1393

## Background / Context

### What exists today

Current Prompter interface (internal/discovery/application/ports.go:71-85) has 4 methods for a fixed-question questionnaire:
- SelectPersona(ctx) (string, error)
- AskQuestion(ctx, question) (string, error)
- AskSkipReason(ctx) (string, error)
- ConfirmPlayback(ctx, summary) (bool, error)

Sole implementation: HuhPrompter (internal/discovery/infrastructure/huh_prompter.go:17). Compile-time guard at huh_prompter.go:15. Only caller: CLIDiscoveryAdapter (internal/discovery/infrastructure/cli_discovery_adapter.go:16-32), field at line 18.

### Why it must be replaced

Spike report (docs/research/20260323_4_cli_domain_storytelling_prototype.md:215-220) identifies five interaction types the old interface cannot support: per-sentence story refinement, dynamic moderator follow-ups, structured story display, lettered choices with recommendations, and business rule annotation capture.

### Method-Level Transition Map

| Old Prompter | New StorytellingPrompter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| SelectPersona | AskChoice (generic) | Persona selection becomes one of many choice interactions |
| AskQuestion | AskNarration | Gains context parameter for moderator framing |
| AskSkipReason | REMOVED | Not a concept in domain storytelling |
| ConfirmPlayback | SynthesisCheckpoint | Richer payload: stories, actors, objects, signals, glossary |
| — | SelectMode | RAPID/THOROUGH mode selection |
| — | ProposeStory | Consultant-proposes pattern (MVP stub) |
| — | ConfirmSentence | Per-sentence Y/n/edit loop |
| — | DisplayStory | Display-only story rendering |
| — | AskAnnotation | Business rule annotation capture |

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (Guided Discovery) |
| Ubiquitous Language | StorytellingPrompter, SelectMode, ProposeStory, AskNarration, ConfirmSentence, AskChoice, DisplayStory, SynthesisCheckpoint, AskAnnotation — names match docs/DDD.md:207 |
| Layer | Application (port interface) |

## Design

### Interface (8 methods)

\`\`\`go
type StorytellingPrompter interface {
    SelectMode(ctx context.Context) (discoverydomain.DiscoveryMode, error)
    ProposeStory(ctx context.Context, proposed *discoverydomain.DomainStory) (*discoverydomain.DomainStory, error)
    AskNarration(ctx context.Context, question string, context string) (string, error)
    ConfirmSentence(ctx context.Context, sentence discoverydomain.StorySentence) (discoverydomain.StorySentence, bool, error)
    AskChoice(ctx context.Context, prompt string, options []Choice, recommended string) (string, error)
    DisplayStory(ctx context.Context, story *discoverydomain.DomainStory) error
    SynthesisCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, synthesis SynthesisSummary) (bool, error)
    AskAnnotation(ctx context.Context) (string, int, error)
}

type Choice struct {
    Key         string
    Label       string
    Description string
}

type SynthesisSummary struct {
    StoriesSoFar    []*discoverydomain.DomainStory
    ActorInventory  []discoverydomain.StoryActor
    ObjectInventory []discoverydomain.WorkObject
    BoundarySignals []discoverydomain.BoundarySignal
    GlossaryTerms   []string
}
\`\`\`

### Design Decisions

1. **Replace Prompter in-place.** One caller (CLIDiscoveryAdapter), one impl (HuhPrompter). No coexistence needed.
2. **context.Context on all methods.** Blocking terminal I/O must respect cancellation. Existing Prompter already uses ctx.
3. **Choice and SynthesisSummary in application package.** Port-boundary transfer objects, not domain concepts.
4. **DomainStory passed as pointer.** Mutable aggregate; ProposeStory returns refined version.
5. **AskAnnotation returns (string, int, error).** Sentence number 0 = story-wide. Empty string = done.
6. **SelectMode returns DiscoveryMode.** Typed domain value, not raw string.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|---|---|
| S | StorytellingPrompter is the single contract for CLI interaction in storytelling |
| O | New UI modes (web, agent) implement the same port without touching it |
| L | All implementations must: return context.Canceled on abort; return valid sentence when accepted=true; return empty string from AskAnnotation when done |
| I | Segregated from SessionRepository, StoryWriter, GlossaryWriter etc. |
| D | Handlers depend on port, never on HuhPrompter directly |

## TDD Workflow

### RED
Add mockStorytellingPrompter to ports_test.go with compile-time assertion. Fails because interface doesn't exist.

### GREEN
1. Add Choice, SynthesisSummary structs to ports.go
2. Add StorytellingPrompter interface to ports.go
3. Remove old Prompter interface
4. Fix HuhPrompter: update compile-time guard, add 8 stub methods returning errors.ErrUnsupported
5. Fix CLIDiscoveryAdapter: change field type to StorytellingPrompter, stub Run body

### REFACTOR
Verify import paths, gci order, interface comments use imperative style.

## Steps

1. Write failing mock in ports_test.go
2. Define Choice and SynthesisSummary in ports.go
3. Define StorytellingPrompter interface in ports.go, remove Prompter
4. Fix huh_prompter.go compile break (guard + 8 stubs)
5. Fix cli_discovery_adapter.go compile break (field type + stub Run)
6. Run quality gates
7. Verify no file references application.Prompter

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] StorytellingPrompter with exactly 8 methods in ports.go
- [ ] Old Prompter interface removed from ports.go
- [ ] Choice and SynthesisSummary structs in ports.go
- [ ] mockStorytellingPrompter in ports_test.go with compile-time assertion
- [ ] HuhPrompter compile-time guard updated, 8 stub methods added
- [ ] CLIDiscoveryAdapter field typed as StorytellingPrompter, compiles
- [ ] No file in codebase references application.Prompter
- [ ] All quality gates pass (build, vet, lint, test -race)

## Edge Cases

| Case | Handling |
|---|---|
| AskNarration empty context | Treat as "no context", omit framing |
| ConfirmSentence user abort | Return zero StorySentence, false, context.Canceled |
| AskAnnotation done signal | Return ("", 0, nil) |
| ProposeStory nil input | Stub returns error |
| SynthesisSummary empty slices | Implementations must not panic |
| AskChoice recommended not in options | Advisory; implementation doesn't crash |

## Quality Gates

go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./... -race

## Pre-Implementation Validation (VERIFIED 2026-03-25)

- [x] Prompter at ports.go:71-85 (4 methods)
- [x] HuhPrompter at huh_prompter.go:15-17 (sole impl)
- [x] CLIDiscoveryAdapter.prompter at cli_discovery_adapter.go:18 (sole caller)
- [x] ports_test.go has no Prompter mock
- [x] All Phase 1 domain types available (DomainStory, StorySentence, StoryActor, WorkObject, BoundarySignal, DiscoveryMode)
- [x] ports.go already imports discoverydomain alias at line 7
- [x] HuhPrompter NOT wired in composition/adapters.go

## Risks / Dependencies

- Depends on: All Phase 1 (complete)
- Blocks: All Phase 2 tickets (narrator flow, HuhStorytellingPrompter, CLIDiscoveryAdapter rewrite)
- Risk: HuhPrompter stubs may trigger lint warnings — use _ parameter names
- Risk: CLIDiscoveryAdapter.Run stubs may trigger contextcheck — add nolint with rationale

title: [Phase 1] StoryType, TimeType, PurityType enums
description:
## Goal / Problem

Three small enums needed by DomainStory aggregate: StoryType (coarse_grained/fine_grained), TimeType (as_is/to_be), PurityType (pure/digitalized). These have zero dependencies on StoryActor, WorkObject, StorySentence, or Annotation — only on the TextMarshaler pattern from T1 (TrustLevel). Extracting them allows DomainStory aggregate (T6) to start sooner by removing these from its critical path.

## Background / Context

- **Extracted from:** alty-cli-t49 (DomainStory aggregate) to reduce bottleneck
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Section 3 Source Layout (internal/discovery/domain/)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Line 210 (Domain Story aggregate: type, time, purity fields)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Lines 373-394 (enum definitions with exact values)
- **YAML pattern:** Follow encoding.TextMarshaler/TextUnmarshaler from T1, adapted for string-based enums (simpler than T1's int-based pattern — see Design)
- **Sample data:** docs/research/samples/*.story.yaml (all 3 samples use these exact values)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | StoryType (coarse_grained/fine_grained), TimeType (as_is/to_be), PurityType (pure/digitalized) |
| Layer | Domain |

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | Each enum handles one classification dimension |
| **O**pen/Closed | New values (if ever needed) added to constants + validSet, no existing code changes |
| **L**iskov Substitution | N/A (value objects, not interfaces) |
| **I**nterface Segregation | No interfaces needed — pure value objects |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Domain layer, zero dependencies |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| StoryType | Enum (string VO) | Granularity: coarse_grained, fine_grained |
| TimeType | Enum (string VO) | Temporal scope: as_is, to_be |
| PurityType | Enum (string VO) | Domain purity: pure, digitalized |

### String-Based Enum Pattern (different from T1's int-based pattern)

These are \`type X string\` enums, NOT \`type X int\` like TrustLevel. The constant value IS the serialized form, so no lookup maps are needed. This is simpler:

\`\`\`go
type StoryType string

const (
    StoryTypeCoarseGrained StoryType = "coarse_grained"
    StoryTypeFineGrained   StoryType = "fine_grained"
)

// validStoryTypes is the set of valid values for validation.
var validStoryTypes = map[StoryType]struct{}{
    StoryTypeCoarseGrained: {},
    StoryTypeFineGrained:   {},
}
\`\`\`

Key differences from T1:
- No trustLevelStrings/trustLevelFromString maps needed — the string IS the value
- String() returns \`string(s)\` directly
- MarshalText returns \`[]byte(s)\` directly (after validation)
- Parse function casts string and validates

### Constant Naming Convention

Use type-prefixed constants. These live in \`discovery/domain/\` which has many types — prefix-free names like \`Pure\` or \`AsIs\` would be ambiguous:

| Type | Constants |
|------|-----------|
| StoryType | \`StoryTypeCoarseGrained\`, \`StoryTypeFineGrained\` |
| TimeType | \`TimeTypeAsIs\`, \`TimeTypeToBe\` |
| PurityType | \`PurityTypePure\`, \`PurityTypeDigitalized\` |

### Methods (same for all 3 enums)

Each enum has:
- Constructor: \`NewStoryType(s string) (StoryType, error)\` — validates input string
- \`String() string\` — returns string(s) directly
- \`Validate() error\` — checks membership in validSet
- \`MarshalText() ([]byte, error)\` — validates then returns []byte(s) (lesson from T1 review: always validate before serializing)
- \`UnmarshalText([]byte) error\` — parses and validates
- \`AllStoryTypes() []StoryType\` / \`AllTimeTypes()\` / \`AllPurityTypes()\` — returns all valid values (needed by T6 aggregate and T10 parser)

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go
// internal/discovery/domain/story_enums_test.go

// StoryType
TestNewStoryType_Valid: coarse_grained and fine_grained construct successfully
TestNewStoryType_Invalid: "medium_grained" returns error
TestNewStoryType_Empty: "" returns error
TestStoryType_String: returns correct lowercase string
TestStoryType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals original
TestStoryType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error (not silent corruption)
TestAllStoryTypes: returns exactly 2 values

// TimeType
TestNewTimeType_Valid: as_is and to_be construct successfully
TestNewTimeType_Invalid: "future" returns error
TestNewTimeType_Empty: "" returns error
TestTimeType_String: returns correct lowercase string
TestTimeType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals original
TestTimeType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error
TestAllTimeTypes: returns exactly 2 values

// PurityType
TestNewPurityType_Valid: pure and digitalized construct successfully
TestNewPurityType_Invalid: "hybrid" returns error
TestNewPurityType_Empty: "" returns error
TestPurityType_String: returns correct lowercase string
TestPurityType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals original
TestPurityType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error
TestAllPurityTypes: returns exactly 2 values
\`\`\`

Run: go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -run "StoryType|TimeType|PurityType" → should FAIL

### GREEN Phase

1. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_enums.go
2. Implement all 3 enums following the string-based pattern above

Run: go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -run "StoryType|TimeType|PurityType" → should PASS

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify naming matches docs/DDD.md glossary
- Verify values match docs/internal-formats.md lines 373-394
- Verify values match sample .story.yaml files
- Run all quality gates

## Steps

1. Write test file internal/discovery/domain/story_enums_test.go with all test cases
2. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_enums.go with all 3 enums
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] StoryType: StoryTypeCoarseGrained, StoryTypeFineGrained — constructor validates, String() returns value
- [ ] TimeType: TimeTypeAsIs, TimeTypeToBe — constructor validates, String() returns value
- [ ] PurityType: PurityTypePure, PurityTypeDigitalized — constructor validates, String() returns value
- [ ] All 3 use encoding.TextMarshaler/TextUnmarshaler (no yaml.v3 import in domain)
- [ ] MarshalText validates before serializing (returns error for invalid values, not silent corruption)
- [ ] AllStoryTypes(), AllTimeTypes(), AllPurityTypes() functions exist
- [ ] Zero external dependencies in domain layer
- [ ] All quality gates pass (go build, go vet, golangci-lint, go test -race)

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Invalid StoryType | "medium_grained" | Error |
| Invalid TimeType | "future" | Error |
| Invalid PurityType | "hybrid" | Error |
| Empty string | "" | Error for all 3 |
| MarshalText on invalid | StoryType("bad") | Error (not silent corruption) |

## Quality Gates

\`\`\`bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -race -cover -run "StoryType|TimeType|PurityType"
\`\`\`

- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] All tests pass with 100% coverage on story_enums.go
- [ ] Edge cases have test coverage
- [ ] No regressions in existing discovery domain tests

## Pre-Implementation Validation (VERIFIED 2026-03-24)

- [x] discovery/domain/ directory exists (34 .go files)
- [x] No naming conflicts — zero existing StoryType/TimeType/PurityType in the package
- [x] Values match internal-formats.md lines 375-394 exactly
- [x] Values match all 3 sample .story.yaml files (ecommerce, vetclinic, alto)
- [x] T1 TextMarshaler pattern available (trust_level.go committed, 100% coverage)
- [x] No circular dependency risk (discovery/domain → nothing outside stdlib + shared/domain)

## Risks / Dependencies

- **Depends on:** alty-cli-o7l (T1 TrustLevel — CLOSED, TextMarshaler pattern established)
- **Blocks:** alty-cli-t49 (T6 DomainStory aggregate — uses these 3 enums)

## Grooming Notes (2026-03-24)

Issues found and fixed during grooming:
1. **String vs int pattern clarified:** These are \`type X string\` enums (simpler than T1's int-based TrustLevel). No maps needed — string value IS the serialized form. Design section documents the difference.
2. **Added All*() functions:** AllStoryTypes(), AllTimeTypes(), AllPurityTypes() needed for validation and downstream use (T6, T10).
3. **Constant naming settled:** Type-prefixed (StoryTypeCoarseGrained, TimeTypeAsIs, PurityTypePure) to avoid ambiguity in the multi-type discovery/domain package.
4. **MarshalText validates:** Lesson from T1 review — always validate before serializing. Added to AC and edge cases.

| TimeType | Enum (string VO) | Temporal scope: as_is, to_be |
| PurityType | Enum (string VO) | Domain purity: pure, digitalized |

### String-Based Enum Pattern (different from T1's int-based pattern)

These are \`type X string\` enums, NOT \`type X int\` like TrustLevel. The constant value IS the serialized form — no lookup maps needed:

title: [Phase 1] glossary.yaml and context-map.yaml parser/serializer
description:
## Goal / Problem

Parse and serialize two Discovery output formats: glossary.yaml (list of UbiquitousLanguageEntry value objects) and context-map.yaml (project name, bounded context sketches, and context relationships). These parsers bridge the YAML file formats and the domain model, enabling alto to persist and reload glossary and context map artifacts generated during guided discovery.

A new lightweight ContextMap domain type is also created as part of this ticket — it holds a project name, a list of BoundedContextSketch VOs, and a list of ContextRelationship VOs.

## Background / Context

- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Section 6 (glossary.yaml schema: version, terms[].term, definition, context, trust, source, stories, aliases, note), Section 7 (context-map.yaml schema: version, project, contexts[], relationships[])
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Section 3 Source Layout (internal/discovery/infrastructure/, internal/discovery/domain/)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Section 2 (Ubiquitous Language: UbiquitousLanguageEntry, BoundedContextSketch, BoundarySignal), Section 4 (Guided Discovery Context)
- **Sample files:** docs/research/samples/glossary.yaml, docs/research/samples/context-map.yaml
- **Pattern reference:** internal/fitness/infrastructure/bounded_context_map_parser.go (existing YAML parser for the fitness context's bounded_context_map.yaml), internal/discovery/infrastructure/filesystem_session_repository.go (existing infrastructure adapter)
- **Library:** gopkg.in/yaml.v3 (MIT, no CGO) — already in go.mod

**Note on context-map.yaml vs bounded_context_map.yaml:** These are distinct files. The existing `.alto/bounded_context_map.yaml` (Section 4 of internal-formats.md) is generated by ArtifactGenerationHandler and parsed by the fitness context. The new `.alto/context-map.yaml` (Section 7) is generated from domain story boundary detection and captures boundary signals, actor/work-object ownership, confidence scores, and DDD relationship patterns. Different schemas, different generators, different consumers.

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (Guided Discovery) |
| Ubiquitous Language | UbiquitousLanguageEntry, BoundedContextSketch, BoundarySignal, ContextMap, ContextRelationship, RelationshipType, SubdomainClassification, TrustLevel |
| Layer | Infrastructure (parsers), Domain (ContextMap type, ContextRelationship VO, RelationshipType enum) |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| GlossaryYAMLParser | Infrastructure adapter | Implements GlossaryReader and GlossaryWriter ports for glossary.yaml |
| ContextMapYAMLParser | Infrastructure adapter | Implements ContextMapReader and ContextMapWriter ports for context-map.yaml |
| ContextMap | Domain type | Holds project name, []BoundedContextSketch, []ContextRelationship |
| ContextRelationship | Value Object | Upstream/downstream context names, RelationshipType, optional description |
| RelationshipType | Enum (string) | One of 8 DDD relationship types |

### Port Interfaces (application layer)

```go
// GlossaryReader reads ubiquitous language entries from a file path.
type GlossaryReader interface {
    Read(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]valueobjects.UbiquitousLanguageEntry, error)
}

// GlossaryWriter writes ubiquitous language entries to a file path.
type GlossaryWriter interface {
    Write(ctx context.Context, path string, entries []valueobjects.UbiquitousLanguageEntry) error
}

// ContextMapReader reads a ContextMap from a file path.
type ContextMapReader interface {
    Read(ctx context.Context, path string) (*domain.ContextMap, error)
}

// ContextMapWriter writes a ContextMap to a file path.
type ContextMapWriter interface {
    Write(ctx context.Context, path string, contextMap *domain.ContextMap) error
}
```

### ContextMap Domain Type (internal/discovery/domain/)

**Constructor:** NewContextMap(project string, contexts []BoundedContextSketch, relationships []ContextRelationship) (*ContextMap, error)
- Validates: project is non-empty (after trimming)
- contexts and relationships may be empty (valid for initial creation)

**Getters:** Project() string, Contexts() []BoundedContextSketch (defensive copy), Relationships() []ContextRelationship (defensive copy)

### ContextRelationship Value Object (internal/discovery/domain/)

**Constructor:** NewContextRelationship(upstream, downstream string, relType RelationshipType, description string) (ContextRelationship, error)
- Validates: upstream and downstream are non-empty, relType is valid

**Getters:** Upstream() string, Downstream() string, Type() RelationshipType, Description() string

### RelationshipType Enum (internal/discovery/domain/)

8 DDD vocabulary values:
- shared_kernel — shared code/types between contexts
- customer_supplier — downstream's needs influence upstream
- conformist — downstream conforms to upstream's model
- anticorruption_layer — downstream translates via ACL
- open_host_service — upstream provides published API/protocol
- published_language — communication via well-documented shared language
- partnership — two contexts evolve together cooperatively
- separate_ways — contexts operate independently

### GlossaryYAMLParser Methods

- **Parse(data []byte) ([]UbiquitousLanguageEntry, error)** — parse YAML bytes into glossary entries with validation
- **Serialize(entries []UbiquitousLanguageEntry) ([]byte, error)** — write entries to YAML bytes
- **Read(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]UbiquitousLanguageEntry, error)** — implements GlossaryReader
- **Write(ctx context.Context, path string, entries []UbiquitousLanguageEntry) error** — implements GlossaryWriter

**Validation on Parse:**
- term, definition, context must be non-empty
- trust must be valid TrustLevel
- source required when trust is ai_researched
- stories list should be present (may be empty)

### ContextMapYAMLParser Methods

- **Parse(data []byte) (*ContextMap, error)** — parse YAML bytes into ContextMap with validation
- **Serialize(contextMap *ContextMap) ([]byte, error)** — write ContextMap to YAML bytes
- **Read(ctx context.Context, path string) (*ContextMap, error)** — implements ContextMapReader
- **Write(ctx context.Context, path string, contextMap *ContextMap) error** — implements ContextMapWriter

**Validation on Parse:**
- project must be non-empty
- Each context: name non-empty, classification valid (core/supporting/generic), confidence 0.0-1.0
- Each relationship: upstream/downstream non-empty, type valid (one of 8 RelationshipType values)
- boundary_signals: type must be valid SignalType, description non-empty

### Sequence / Flow

```
glossary.yaml      GlossaryYAMLParser     []UbiquitousLanguageEntry
      |                    |                         |
      |-- Read(path) ----->|                         |
      |                    |-- os.ReadFile ---------->|
      |                    |-- yaml.Unmarshal ------->|
      |                    |-- validate fields ------>|
      |                    |-- build VOs ------------>|
      |<-- entries --------|                         |

context-map.yaml   ContextMapYAMLParser    ContextMap
      |                    |                    |
      |-- Read(path) ----->|                    |
      |                    |-- os.ReadFile ---->|
      |                    |-- yaml.Unmarshal ->|
      |                    |-- validate ------->|
      |                    |-- build domain --->|
      |<-- *ContextMap ----|                    |
```

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|

title: [Phase 1] DomainStory aggregate
description:
## Goal / Problem

Aggregate root for a complete domain story. DomainStory enforces referential integrity between sentences, actors, and work objects. Every sentence subject must reference a known actor, every sentence object must reference a known actor or work object, and step numbers must be sequential. Persisted as .story.yaml files via T10 infrastructure parser.

## Background / Context

- **Spike source:** alty-cli-1i3 (format validation), alty-cli-gox (CLI prototype)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Line 179 (domain_story.go), Line 108 (DomainStory = Core, Guided Discovery), Line 486 (schema)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Line 210 (DomainStory definition), Lines 469 (Guided Discovery aggregate), Line 496 (Domain Model VO — read-only copy)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Section 5 (.story.yaml full schema + validation rules)
- **YAML pattern:** NO YAML methods on the aggregate. Serialization belongs in T10 (story_yaml_parser.go).
- **Prior deliverables:** T1a enums (28e1f56), T2 StoryActor (9cad90e), T3 WorkObject (9cad90e), T4 Annotation (43eb3c4), T5 StorySentence (43eb3c4) — all types this aggregate composes

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | DomainStory, StoryType, TimeType, PurityType, trigger, StoryActor, WorkObject, StorySentence, Annotation |
| Layer | Domain |

## Design

### DomainStory Aggregate (domain_story.go)

\`\`\`go
type DomainStory struct {
    title       string
    storyType   StoryType
    timeType    TimeType
    purityType  PurityType
    trigger     string
    actors      []StoryActor
    workObjects []WorkObject
    sentences   []StorySentence
    annotations []Annotation
    variations  []string
}
\`\`\`

**This is a MUTABLE aggregate, not an immutable VO.** Add* methods mutate in place and return error. This is the correct DDD pattern — aggregates protect invariants through controlled mutation.

### Constructor

\`NewDomainStory(title string, storyType StoryType, timeType TimeType, purityType PurityType, trigger string) (*DomainStory, error)\`
- Returns pointer (mutable aggregate)
- Validates: non-empty title (trims whitespace), non-empty trigger (trims whitespace), valid enums

### Mutating Methods

- \`AddActor(actor StoryActor) error\` — rejects duplicate names (case-insensitive)
- \`AddWorkObject(wo WorkObject) error\` — rejects duplicate names (case-insensitive)
- \`AddSentence(sentence StorySentence) error\` — appends sentence (step sequence validated in Validate())
- \`AddAnnotation(annotation Annotation) error\` — appends annotation (sentence refs validated in Validate(), NOT here — sentences may be added after annotations)
- \`AddVariation(description string) error\` — validates non-empty

### Validate()

The authoritative referential integrity check. Call after all Add* operations:

1. At least 1 actor, 1 work object, 1 sentence
2. Sequential step numbers 1..N (no gaps, no duplicates)
3. Every sentence subject references an actor name (case-insensitive)
4. Every sentence object references an actor or work_object name (case-insensitive)
5. Every sentence indirect_object (if set) references an actor or work_object name (case-insensitive)
6. Annotation sentence refs are valid step numbers

### Query Methods

- \`Title()\`, \`Type()\`, \`Time()\`, \`Purity()\`, \`Trigger()\` — scalar getters
- \`Actors()\`, \`WorkObjects()\`, \`Sentences()\`, \`Annotations()\`, \`Variations()\` — defensive copy getters
- \`SentenceCount() int\`
- \`HasBranching() bool\` — true if any sentence's ContainsBranching() returns true
- \`FormatText() string\` — renders alto text format (title header, actors, work objects, numbered sentences, annotations)

### Name Conflict Note

A simple \`DomainStory\` VO already exists in \`internal/shared/domain/valueobjects/domain_values.go:25\` (v1, string-based). The new discovery domain \`DomainStory\` is a rich v2 aggregate in a different package. No compilation conflict — different packages. The v1 type serves existing code paths; the v2 aggregate serves the storytelling pipeline.

**No MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on the aggregate.** Serialization belongs in T10.

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go
// internal/discovery/domain/domain_story_test.go

// Construction
TestNewDomainStory_Valid: all valid params → success
TestNewDomainStory_EmptyTitle: error
TestNewDomainStory_WhitespaceTitle: error
TestNewDomainStory_EmptyTrigger: error
TestNewDomainStory_InvalidStoryType: error
TestNewDomainStory_InvalidTimeType: error
TestNewDomainStory_InvalidPurityType: error

// Add* methods
TestDomainStory_AddActor_Success: adds actor
TestDomainStory_AddActor_Duplicate: case-insensitive duplicate → error
TestDomainStory_AddWorkObject_Success: adds work object
TestDomainStory_AddWorkObject_Duplicate: case-insensitive duplicate → error
TestDomainStory_AddSentence_Success: adds sentence
TestDomainStory_AddAnnotation_StoryWide: nil sentenceRef → success
TestDomainStory_AddAnnotation_SentenceSpecific: appended without ref validation (Validate checks later)
TestDomainStory_AddVariation_Success: adds variation
TestDomainStory_AddVariation_Empty: error

// Validate
TestDomainStory_Validate_Valid: complete story passes
TestDomainStory_Validate_NoActors: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_NoWorkObjects: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_NoSentences: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_NonSequentialSteps: [1,3] → error
TestDomainStory_Validate_DuplicateSteps: [1,1] → error
TestDomainStory_Validate_SubjectNotInActors: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_ObjectNotInActorsOrWO: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_IndirectObjectNotInActorsOrWO: error
TestDomainStory_Validate_AnnotationBadSentenceRef: ref=99 when max step=3 → error
TestDomainStory_Validate_ActorAsObject: actor name in sentence object → valid

// Query methods
TestDomainStory_SentenceCount: correct count
TestDomainStory_HasBranching_True: sentence with "sometimes" → true
TestDomainStory_HasBranching_False: no branching → false
TestDomainStory_FormatText: renders complete story
TestDomainStory_Actors_DefensiveCopy: mutating returned slice doesn't affect aggregate
TestDomainStory_WorkObjects_DefensiveCopy: same
TestDomainStory_Sentences_DefensiveCopy: same
\`\`\`

### GREEN / REFACTOR

1. Create domain_story.go
2. Implement constructor, Add* methods, Validate, query methods
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Constructor validates non-empty title/trigger, valid StoryType/TimeType/PurityType (already delivered by T1a)
- [ ] AddActor/AddWorkObject reject case-insensitive duplicate names
- [ ] AddAnnotation does NOT validate sentence refs (sentences may be added later) — Validate() is authoritative
- [ ] AddVariation validates non-empty
- [ ] Validate() enforces all 6 referential integrity rules
- [ ] FormatText() renders full alto text format
- [ ] HasBranching() delegates to StorySentence.ContainsBranching()
- [ ] All getters return defensive copies
- [ ] Mutable aggregate pattern: Add* methods mutate in place, return error
- [ ] NO MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML (serialization is T10's job)
- [ ] Zero external dependencies (only shared kernel TrustLevel via composed VOs)
- [ ] All quality gates pass

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty title | "" | Error |
| Empty trigger | "" | Error |
| Duplicate actor (case-insensitive) | "Customer" then "customer" | AddActor error |
| Duplicate work object | "Order" then "order" | AddWorkObject error |
| Actor used as sentence object | sentence object = actor name | Valid |
| Non-sequential steps | [1, 3] | Validate error |
| Duplicate steps | [1, 1] | Validate error |
| Subject not in actors | "Unknown" | Validate error |
| Object not in actors or WO | "Unknown" | Validate error |
| IndirectObject not in actors or WO | "Unknown" | Validate error |
| Annotation ref to nonexistent step | ref=99 | Validate error |
| Annotation story-wide | ref=nil | Valid |
| Empty variation | "" | AddVariation error |
| No actors/WO/sentences | empty story | Validate error |

## Quality Gates

\`\`\`bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -race -cover -run DomainStory
go test ./internal/discovery/... -race
\`\`\`

## Pre-Implementation Validation (VERIFIED 2026-03-24)

- [x] ARCHITECTURE.md line 179 confirms domain_story.go
- [x] All composed types delivered: StoryActor (9cad90e), WorkObject (9cad90e), StorySentence (43eb3c4), Annotation (43eb3c4), StoryType/TimeType/PurityType (28e1f56)
- [x] Shared kernel DomainStory (domain_values.go:25) is a different type in a different package — no conflict
- [x] Referential integrity rules match internal-formats.md Section 5 validation rules 1-7

## Grooming Notes (2026-03-24)

1. **Removed stale enum references from AC/quality gates.** StoryType/TimeType/PurityType already delivered in T1a.
2. **AddAnnotation does NOT validate sentence refs.** Sentences may be added after annotations. Validate() is the authoritative check.
3. **Removed YAML serialization from AC.** No YAML methods on aggregate — T10's job.
4. **Documented name conflict with shared kernel DomainStory.** Different packages, no compilation issue.
5. **Explicit mutable aggregate pattern.** Add* methods mutate in place, return error. Different from VO immutability.

title: [Phase 1] .story.yaml parser and serializer
description:
## Goal / Problem

Parse .story.yaml files into DomainStory aggregates and serialize DomainStory aggregates back to .story.yaml. Round-trip safe. This is the infrastructure adapter that bridges the YAML file format (external concern) and the domain model (DomainStory aggregate). Without this, alto cannot persist or load domain stories.

## Background / Context

- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Section 5 (.story.yaml schema: top-level fields, actors[], work_objects[], sentences[], annotations[], variations[], all enums)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Section 3 Source Layout (internal/discovery/infrastructure/)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Section 2 (Ubiquitous Language: DomainStory, StorySentence, StoryActor, WorkObject, Annotation, TrustLevel), Section 4 (Guided Discovery Context)
- **Sample files:** docs/research/samples/ecommerce.story.yaml, vetclinic.story.yaml, alto.story.yaml
- **Schema source:** docs/research/20260323_6_story_format_validation.md Section 3 (finalized)
- **Pattern reference:** internal/discovery/infrastructure/filesystem_session_repository.go (existing infrastructure adapter in same bounded context), internal/fitness/infrastructure/bounded_context_map_parser.go (existing YAML parser for bounded_context_map.yaml)
- **Library:** gopkg.in/yaml.v3 (MIT, no CGO) — already in go.mod

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (Guided Discovery) |
| Ubiquitous Language | DomainStory, StorySentence, StoryActor, WorkObject, Annotation, TrustLevel, StoryType, TimeType, PurityType, ActorType, WorkObjectType, AnnotationType |
| Layer | Infrastructure |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| StoryYAMLParser | Infrastructure adapter | Implements StoryReader and StoryWriter ports for reading/writing .story.yaml files |

### Port Interfaces (application layer)

```go
// StoryReader reads a DomainStory from a file path.
type StoryReader interface {
    Read(ctx context.Context, path string) (*domain.DomainStory, error)
}

// StoryWriter writes a DomainStory to a file path.
type StoryWriter interface {
    Write(ctx context.Context, path string, story *domain.DomainStory) error
}
```

### StoryYAMLParser Methods

- **Parse(data []byte) (*DomainStory, error)** — parse YAML bytes into DomainStory with full validation
- **Serialize(story *DomainStory) ([]byte, error)** — write DomainStory to YAML bytes
- **Read(ctx context.Context, path string) (*DomainStory, error)** — read from filesystem (implements StoryReader)
- **Write(ctx context.Context, path string, story *DomainStory) error** — write to filesystem (implements StoryWriter)

### Validation on Parse

1. **Schema check:** required fields present (title, actors, work_objects, sentences, type, time, purity, trigger)
2. **Enum validation:** all enum values valid (StoryType, TimeType, PurityType, ActorType, WorkObjectType, TrustLevel, AnnotationType, Preposition)
3. **Referential integrity:**
   - Every sentence.subject references a name from actors[]
   - Every sentence.object references a name from actors[] or work_objects[]
   - Every sentence.indirect_object (when set) references a name from actors[] or work_objects[]
4. **Preposition/indirect_object pairing:** if preposition is set, indirect_object must also be set (and vice versa)
5. **Step sequencing:** step numbers must be sequential starting from 1
6. **Source required:** when trust is ai_researched, source field must be non-empty
7. **Minimums:** at least 1 actor, 1 work_object, 1 sentence
8. **Error messages cite field paths** for debugging (e.g., "sentences[2].subject: actor 'Unknown' not declared in actors list")

### Sequence / Flow

```
.story.yaml file       StoryYAMLParser         DomainStory aggregate
      |                       |                        |
      |-- Read(path) -------->|                        |
      |                       |-- os.ReadFile -------->|
      |                       |-- yaml.Unmarshal ----->|
      |                       |-- validate fields ---->|
      |                       |-- build VOs ---------->|
      |                       |-- NewDomainStory ----->|
      |                       |                        |
      |<-- *DomainStory ------|                        |
      |                       |                        |
      |                       |<-- Write(path, story) -|
      |                       |-- extract fields ----->|
      |                       |-- yaml.Marshal ------->|
      |                       |-- os.WriteFile ------->|
      |<-- nil (success) -----|                        |
```

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | StoryYAMLParser handles only YAML serialization/deserialization of domain stories |
| **O**pen/Closed | New serialization formats (JSON, TOML) can implement StoryReader/StoryWriter without modifying StoryYAMLParser |
| **L**iskov Substitution | Any StoryReader/StoryWriter implementation produces/consumes valid DomainStory aggregates |
| **I**nterface Segregation | StoryReader and StoryWriter are separate interfaces — consumers depend only on what they need |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Application layer depends on StoryReader/StoryWriter port interfaces, not on StoryYAMLParser directly |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

Write failing tests first:

```go
// internal/discovery/infrastructure/story_yaml_parser_test.go
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenEcommerceSample_ExpectValidDomainStory
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenVetClinicSample_ExpectValidDomainStory
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenAltoSample_ExpectValidDomainStory
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenMissingTitle_ExpectErrorWithFieldPath
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenInvalidStoryType_ExpectError
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenInvalidActorType_ExpectError
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenInvalidTrustLevel_ExpectError
TestStoryYAMLParser_Parse_WhenSubjectNotInActors_ExpectErrorWithSentenceIndex
```

title: [Phase 1] StorySentence value object
description:
## Goal / Problem

Immutable value object representing a single numbered sentence in a domain story. StorySentence encapsulates one step of the "[Actor] [activity] [WorkObject]" format with optional preposition/indirect_object extension, TrustLevel for provenance tracking, and an optional source citation. This is the core unit of domain knowledge capture — every DomainStory aggregate contains an ordered sequence of StorySentences.

## Background / Context

- **Spike source:** alty-cli-1i3 (format validation), alty-cli-gox (CLI domain storytelling prototype)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Line 182 (internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence.go)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Line 213 (StorySentence), Line 472 (Guided Discovery key objects)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Lines 350-361 (Sentence schema), Line 358 (prepositions: 10 allowed values)
- **YAML pattern:** Struct VOs do NOT have YAML methods — serialization belongs in infrastructure (T10).
- **Prior deliverables:** T1 TrustLevel (commit 6115fc7), T1a enums (commit 28e1f56), T2 StoryActor + T3 WorkObject (Batch 3)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | StorySentence, step, subject, activity, object, preposition, indirect_object, TrustLevel, source |
| Layer | Domain |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| StorySentence | Value Object (struct) | A single numbered step: subject performs activity on object, with optional preposition + indirect_object |

### StorySentence Struct (NO YAML methods — serialization is T10's job)

\`\`\`go
type StorySentence struct {
    step           int
    subject        string     // actor name (cross-validated at aggregate level T6)
    activity       string     // verb phrase
    object         string     // work object or actor name (cross-validated at T6)
    preposition    string     // optional, from allowed set
    indirectObject string     // optional, required when preposition is set
    trust          valueobjects.TrustLevel
    source         string     // required when trust=AIResearched
}
\`\`\`

### Allowed Prepositions (10 values, from internal-formats.md line 358)

\`for, to, via, using, from, with, in, about, based on, on\`

Case-insensitive matching — "Based On" is valid. Stored in canonical lowercase.

### Methods

- \`NewStorySentence(step int, subject, activity, object string, trust TrustLevel, source string) (StorySentence, error)\` — validates step >= 1, non-empty subject/activity/object (trims whitespace), valid trust, source required when trust=AIResearched
- \`WithPreposition(preposition, indirectObject string) (StorySentence, error)\` — returns new StorySentence with preposition set. Validates preposition from allowed set (case-insensitive), indirectObject non-empty (trims whitespace). Stores preposition in lowercase.
- \`Step() int\`, \`Subject() string\`, \`Activity() string\`, \`Object() string\`, \`Preposition() string\`, \`IndirectObject() string\`, \`Trust() TrustLevel\`, \`Source() string\` — getters
- \`HasIndirectObject() bool\` — true when preposition and indirectObject are both set
- \`FormatText() string\` — "1. Customer browses Product Listing" or "3. Receptionist checks Vet Schedule for available slots"
- \`ContainsBranching() bool\` — detects keywords in activity: sometimes, if, optionally, alternatively, when, unless (case-insensitive word boundary match)
- \`String() string\` — alias for FormatText

### Cross-Validation Note

Subject must reference a known actor name, object must reference a known actor or work object name — this cross-validation happens at the DomainStory aggregate level (T6), NOT in StorySentence. StorySentence only validates its own field integrity.

**No MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML.** Domain struct can't implement yaml.Marshaler without importing yaml.v3. Infrastructure parser (T10) handles YAML serialization.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | StorySentence handles sentence semantics, formatting, and branching detection |
| **O**pen/Closed | New branching keywords or prepositions added to internal lists |
| **L**iskov Substitution | N/A (value object, not interface) |
| **I**nterface Segregation | No interfaces needed — pure value object |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Domain layer, depends only on TrustLevel from shared kernel |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go
// internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence_test.go

// Construction
TestNewStorySentence_Valid: step=1, subject="Customer", activity="browses", object="Product Listing", trust=UserStated → success
TestNewStorySentence_StepZero: step=0 → error
TestNewStorySentence_NegativeStep: step=-1 → error
TestNewStorySentence_EmptySubject: "" → error
TestNewStorySentence_WhitespaceSubject: "   " → error
TestNewStorySentence_EmptyActivity: "" → error
TestNewStorySentence_EmptyObject: "" → error
TestNewStorySentence_AIResearchedWithoutSource: error
TestNewStorySentence_AIResearchedWithSource: success

// WithPreposition
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_Valid: "for", "available slots" → success
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_InvalidPreposition: "beside" → error
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_EmptyIndirectObject: "for", "" → error
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_AllTen: each of 10 prepositions succeeds
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_CaseInsensitive: "For", "VIA", "Based On" all valid
TestStorySentence_WithPreposition_StoredLowercase: input "For" stored as "for"

// Getters / behavior
TestStorySentence_HasIndirectObject_True: preposition set → true
TestStorySentence_HasIndirectObject_False: no preposition → false
TestStorySentence_FormatText_Simple: "1. Customer browses Product Listing"
TestStorySentence_FormatText_WithPreposition: "3. Receptionist checks Vet Schedule for available slots"

// Branching detection
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Sometimes: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_If: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Optionally: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Alternatively: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_When: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Unless: true
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Normal: "creates" → false
TestStorySentence_ContainsBranching_Embedded: "sometimes-rejects" → false (word boundary, not substring)
\`\`\`

### GREEN Phase

1. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence.go
2. Define StorySentence struct with unexported fields
3. Define allowed prepositions and branching keywords as package-level vars
4. Implement constructor, WithPreposition (returns new instance — immutable), getters
5. Implement HasIndirectObject, FormatText, ContainsBranching

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify naming matches docs/DDD.md glossary
- Verify prepositions match docs/internal-formats.md line 358
- Run all quality gates

## Steps

1. Write test file internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence_test.go
2. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_sentence.go
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Constructor validates step >= 1, non-empty subject/activity/object (trims whitespace), valid TrustLevel
- [ ] Source required when trust is AIResearched; optional otherwise (consistent with T2/T3 pattern)
- [ ] WithPreposition validates from allowed set (10 values, case-insensitive), stores lowercase, requires non-empty indirectObject
- [ ] FormatText renders "N. Subject activity Object" or "N. Subject activity Object preposition IndirectObject"
- [ ] ContainsBranching detects 6 keywords (sometimes, if, optionally, alternatively, when, unless) with word boundary matching
- [ ] HasIndirectObject returns true only when both preposition and indirectObject set
- [ ] WithPreposition returns new instance (immutable VO pattern)
- [ ] NO MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on StorySentence struct (serialization is T10's job)
- [ ] Zero external dependencies in domain layer (only shared kernel TrustLevel)
- [ ] All quality gates pass

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Step = 0 | step=0 | Error |
| Step negative | step=-1 | Error |
| Empty subject | "" | Error |
| Whitespace-only subject | "   " | Error |
| Empty activity/object | "" | Error |
| Invalid preposition | "beside" | Error |
| Preposition without indirect | "for", "" | Error |
| "based on" (two words) | preposition="based on" | Valid |
| "Based On" (case) | preposition="Based On" | Valid, stored as "based on" |
| AIResearched no source | trust=AIResearched, source="" | Error |
| Branching "sometimes" | activity="sometimes rejects" | ContainsBranching=true |
| Non-branching | activity="creates" | ContainsBranching=false |
| Embedded keyword | activity="sometimes-rejects" | ContainsBranching=false (word boundary) |

## Quality Gates

\`\`\`bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -race -cover -run StorySentence
go test ./internal/discovery/... -race
\`\`\`

## Pre-Implementation Validation (VERIFIED 2026-03-24)

- [x] discovery/domain/ exists
- [x] No existing StorySentence in the package
- [x] TrustLevel in shared kernel (commit 6115fc7)
- [x] ARCHITECTURE.md line 182 confirms story_sentence.go in planned layout
- [x] Preposition set matches internal-formats.md line 358: for, to, via, using, from, with, in, about, based on, on (10 values)
- [x] discovery/domain already imports domainerrors.ErrInvariantViolation

## Risks / Dependencies

- **Depends on:** alty-cli-o7l (T1 TrustLevel — CLOSED), alty-cli-tum (T2 StoryActor — Batch 3), alty-cli-rok (T3 WorkObject — Batch 3). Note: T5 references actors/work objects by string name only, not by type — so the code dependency is only on TrustLevel.
- **Blocks:** alty-cli-t49 (T6 DomainStory aggregate)

## Grooming Notes (2026-03-24)

1. **Removed MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML.** Serialization belongs in T10.
2. **Removed YAML round-trip tests.** Belong in T10.
3. **Added source to constructor.** Matches T2/T3 pattern. AIResearched+source validation happens at construction time.
4. **Case-insensitive preposition matching.** "Based On" → stored as "based on". Specified in design.
5. **Word boundary branching detection.** "sometimes-rejects" should NOT match — only whole-word "sometimes" in activity text. Added test case.
6. **Removed "YAML keys match schema" from AC.** Infrastructure concern (T10).

description:

Two value objects for tracking the discovery conversation. ConversationTurn captures a single exchange between the moderator (alto) and the user. ConversationNarrative aggregates an ordered sequence of turns with synthesis checkpoints.

title: [Phase 1] Annotation value object
description:
## Goal / Problem

Immutable value object representing a business rule annotation on a domain story or individual sentence. Annotation captures constraints, invariants, and assumptions that emerge during Domain Storytelling. Annotations can be story-wide (no sentence reference) or attached to a specific sentence step number.

## Background / Context

- **Spike source:** alty-cli-1i3 (format validation), alty-cli-dh8 (domain research quality)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Line 183 (internal/discovery/domain/annotation.go)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Line 214 (Annotation), Line 473 (Guided Discovery key objects)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Lines 365-371 (Annotation schema), Lines 416-422 (AnnotationType enum)
- **YAML pattern:** Enums use encoding.TextMarshaler (from T1). Struct VOs do NOT have YAML methods — serialization belongs in infrastructure (T10).
- **Prior deliverables:** T1 TrustLevel (commit 6115fc7), T1a enums (commit 28e1f56), T2/T3 StoryActor/WorkObject (Batch 3)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | Annotation, AnnotationType (constraint/invariant/assumption), TrustLevel, sentence reference |
| Layer | Domain |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| Annotation | Value Object (struct) | Business rule: text, AnnotationType, optional sentence ref, TrustLevel, optional source |
| AnnotationType | Enum (string VO) | constraint, invariant, assumption |

### AnnotationType Enum (follows T1a string-based pattern)

\`\`\`go
type AnnotationType string

const (
    AnnotationTypeConstraint  AnnotationType = "constraint"
    AnnotationTypeInvariant   AnnotationType = "invariant"
    AnnotationTypeAssumption  AnnotationType = "assumption"
)
\`\`\`

Methods: NewAnnotationType, String, Validate, MarshalText (validates first), UnmarshalText, AllAnnotationTypes.

### Annotation Struct (NO YAML methods — serialization is T10's job)

\`\`\`go
type Annotation struct {
    text           string
    annotationType AnnotationType
    sentenceRef    *int              // nil = story-wide, >= 1 = sentence-specific
    trust          valueobjects.TrustLevel
    source         string
}
\`\`\`

Methods:
- \`NewAnnotation(text string, annotationType AnnotationType, sentenceRef *int, trust TrustLevel, source string) (Annotation, error)\` — validates non-empty text (trims whitespace), valid type, valid trust, sentenceRef nil or >= 1 (reject <= 0), source required when trust=AIResearched
- \`Text() string\`, \`Type() AnnotationType\`, \`SentenceRef() *int\`, \`Trust() TrustLevel\`, \`Source() string\` — getters
- \`IsStoryWide() bool\` — true when sentenceRef is nil
- \`String() string\` — "Annotation: [constraint] Must be authenticated (story-wide, user_stated)" or "Annotation: [invariant] Payment before order (sentence 3, user_stated)"

**No MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML.** Domain struct can't implement yaml.Marshaler without importing yaml.v3. Infrastructure parser (T10) handles YAML serialization.

### Sentence Reference Semantics (SETTLED)

- nil = story-wide annotation (applies to entire story)
- \>= 1 = applies to specific sentence step
- <= 0 = constructor returns error (steps are 1-based, 0 and negative are invalid)

**No "0 = story-wide" magic.** Callers must pass nil explicitly for story-wide. The parser (T10) maps omitted YAML \`sentence\` field to nil.

### No Default Trust

Constructor requires explicit TrustLevel. The internal-formats.md says "Defaults to story-level trust if omitted" — that's a YAML parser concern (T10), not a domain VO concern. The domain VO always has an explicit trust value.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | Annotation handles business rule metadata and provenance. AnnotationType handles classification. |
| **O**pen/Closed | New AnnotationTypes added to enum constants + validSet |
| **L**iskov Substitution | N/A (value objects, not interfaces) |
| **I**nterface Segregation | No interfaces needed — pure value objects |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Domain layer, depends only on TrustLevel from shared kernel |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go
// internal/discovery/domain/annotation_test.go

// AnnotationType enum
TestNewAnnotationType_Valid: constraint, invariant, assumption construct successfully
TestNewAnnotationType_Invalid: "rule" returns error
TestNewAnnotationType_Empty: "" returns error
TestAnnotationType_String: returns correct string
TestAnnotationType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals
TestAnnotationType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error
TestAllAnnotationTypes: returns exactly 3 values

// Annotation VO
TestNewAnnotation_Constraint: text="Must be authenticated", type=constraint → success
TestNewAnnotation_Invariant: text="Payment before order", type=invariant → success
TestNewAnnotation_Assumption: text="Users prefer email", type=assumption → success
TestNewAnnotation_EmptyText: returns error
TestNewAnnotation_WhitespaceText: "   " returns error
TestNewAnnotation_InvalidType: returns error
TestNewAnnotation_StoryWide: sentenceRef=nil → IsStoryWide()=true
TestNewAnnotation_SentenceSpecific: sentenceRef=3 → IsStoryWide()=false, SentenceRef()=3
TestNewAnnotation_SentenceRefZero: sentenceRef=0 → returns error (not story-wide)
TestNewAnnotation_NegativeSentenceRef: sentenceRef=-1 → returns error
TestNewAnnotation_AIResearchedWithoutSource: returns error
TestNewAnnotation_AIResearchedWithSource: success
TestNewAnnotation_UserStatedWithoutSource: success (source optional)
TestAnnotation_String_StoryWide: correct format
TestAnnotation_String_SentenceSpecific: correct format
\`\`\`

### GREEN Phase

1. Create internal/discovery/domain/annotation.go
2. Define AnnotationType enum (3 constants) with TextMarshaler
3. Define Annotation struct with unexported fields
4. Implement constructor with validation, getters, IsStoryWide, String

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify naming matches docs/DDD.md glossary
- Verify AnnotationType values match docs/internal-formats.md lines 420-422
- Run all quality gates

## Steps

1. Write test file internal/discovery/domain/annotation_test.go
2. Create internal/discovery/domain/annotation.go with AnnotationType enum + Annotation VO
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AnnotationType enum: AnnotationTypeConstraint, AnnotationTypeInvariant, AnnotationTypeAssumption — TextMarshaler pattern
- [ ] AnnotationType MarshalText validates before serializing
- [ ] AllAnnotationTypes() returns all 3 values
- [ ] Constructor validates non-empty text (whitespace-only = empty), valid AnnotationType, valid TrustLevel
- [ ] Sentence reference: nil = story-wide, >= 1 = sentence-specific, <= 0 = error
- [ ] Source required when trust is AIResearched; optional otherwise
- [ ] No default trust magic — constructor requires explicit TrustLevel
- [ ] IsStoryWide() returns true when sentenceRef is nil
- [ ] NO MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on Annotation struct (serialization is T10's job)
- [ ] Zero external dependencies in domain layer (only shared kernel TrustLevel)
- [ ] All quality gates pass

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty text | "" | Error |
| Whitespace-only text | "  " | Error |
| Invalid type | "rule" | Error |
| Sentence ref = 0 | sentenceRef=ptr(0) | Error (not story-wide, use nil) |
| Negative sentence ref | sentenceRef=ptr(-1) | Error |
| Sentence ref = 1 | sentenceRef=ptr(1) | OK |
| Story-wide | sentenceRef=nil | OK, IsStoryWide()=true |
| AIResearched without source | trust=AIResearched, source="" | Error |
| UserStated without source | trust=UserStated, source="" | OK |
| MarshalText invalid AnnotationType | AnnotationType("bad") | Error |

## Quality Gates

\`\`\`bash
go build ./...
go vet ./...
golangci-lint run ./...
go test ./internal/discovery/domain/... -race -cover -run "Annotation|AnnotationType"
go test ./internal/discovery/... -race
\`\`\`

- [x] No existing Annotation/AnnotationType in the package
- [x] TrustLevel in shared kernel (commit 6115fc7)
- [x] AnnotationType values match internal-formats.md lines 420-422: constraint, invariant, assumption
- [x] ARCHITECTURE.md line 183 confirms annotation.go in planned layout

## Risks / Dependencies

- **Depends on:** alty-cli-o7l (T1 TrustLevel — CLOSED)

1. **Removed MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML.** Serialization belongs in T10.
2. **Removed YAML round-trip tests.** Belong in T10.
3. **Removed "0 = story-wide" magic.** nil = story-wide, <= 0 = error. Cleaner semantics.
4. **Removed default trust.** Constructor requires explicit TrustLevel. "Default to story-level" is a T10 parser concern.

title: [Phase 1] BoundarySignal and BoundedContextSketch value objects
description:
## Goal / Problem

Two value objects for boundary detection output in the Discovery bounded context. BoundarySignal captures evidence of a context boundary (what signal was detected and why). BoundedContextSketch captures a proposed bounded context with confidence scoring, actors, work objects, and boundary signals.

## Background / Context

- **Spike source:** docs/research/20260323_5_boundary_detection_heuristics_validation.md — Section 10 (thresholds, scoring, worked examples)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Lines 184-185 (boundary_signal.go, bounded_context_sketch.go)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Lines 216-217 (BoundarySignal, BoundedContextSketch), Line 475-476 (Guided Discovery key objects)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Lines 662-666 (boundary_signals schema), Lines 687-697 (BoundarySignalType: 7 values)
- **YAML pattern:** Enums use encoding.TextMarshaler (from T1). Struct VOs do NOT have YAML methods — serialization belongs in infrastructure (T11).
- **Prior deliverables:** T1 TrustLevel (6115fc7), T1a enums (28e1f56), T2/T3 (9cad90e), T4/T5 (43eb3c4)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery (Guided Discovery) |
| Ubiquitous Language | BoundarySignal, BoundedContextSketch, SignalType, ConfidenceLevel, TrustLevel, SubdomainClassification |
| Layer | Domain |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| BoundarySignal | Value Object (struct) | Evidence of a context boundary: SignalType + description |
| SignalType | Enum (string VO) | 7 boundary signal types from Hofer & Schwentner methodology |
| BoundedContextSketch | Value Object (struct) | Proposed bounded context: name, classification, confidence, actors, work objects, stories, signals, trust |
| ConfidenceLevel | Enum (string VO) | HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW — three-tier classification |

### SignalType Enum (follows T1a string-based pattern)

\`\`\`go
type SignalType string

const (
    SignalTypeDifferentTrigger  SignalType = "different_trigger"
    SignalTypeOneWayFlow        SignalType = "one_way_flow"
    SignalTypeLanguageDifference SignalType = "language_difference"
    SignalTypeDifferentLifecycle SignalType = "different_lifecycle"
    SignalTypeExternalSystem    SignalType = "external_system"
    SignalTypeDifferentActor    SignalType = "different_actor"
    SignalTypeComplexRules      SignalType = "complex_rules"
)
\`\`\`

Methods: NewSignalType, String, Validate, MarshalText (validates first), UnmarshalText, AllSignalTypes.

### ConfidenceLevel Enum

\`\`\`go
type ConfidenceLevel string

const (
    ConfidenceLevelHigh   ConfidenceLevel = "HIGH"
    ConfidenceLevelMedium ConfidenceLevel = "MEDIUM"
    ConfidenceLevelLow    ConfidenceLevel = "LOW"
)
\`\`\`

Not a user-facing enum — no constructor/TextMarshaler needed. Returned by BoundedContextSketch.ConfidenceLevel().

### BoundarySignal Struct (NO YAML methods)

\`\`\`go
type BoundarySignal struct {
    signalType  SignalType
    description string
}
\`\`\`

Methods:
- \`NewBoundarySignal(signalType SignalType, description string) (BoundarySignal, error)\` — validates signalType and non-empty description
- \`Type() SignalType\`, \`Description() string\` — getters
- \`String() string\` — "BoundarySignal: different_trigger — Contexts are triggered by different events"

**No stories field on BoundarySignal.** Per internal-formats.md, stories belong on the context (BoundedContextSketch), not on individual signals. The context-map schema (lines 738-745) shows \`stories\` at context level.

### BoundedContextSketch Struct (NO YAML methods)

\`\`\`go
type BoundedContextSketch struct {
    name           string
    classification valueobjects.SubdomainClassification
    confidence     float64
    actors         []string
    workObjects    []string
    stories        []string
    signals        []BoundarySignal
    trust          valueobjects.TrustLevel
}
\`\`\`

Methods:
- \`NewBoundedContextSketch(name string, classification SubdomainClassification, confidence float64, actors, workObjects, stories []string, signals []BoundarySignal, trust TrustLevel) (BoundedContextSketch, error)\` — validates name non-empty, confidence 0.0-1.0, valid classification, valid trust
- \`Name() string\`, \`Classification() SubdomainClassification\`, \`Confidence() float64\`, \`Trust() TrustLevel\` — scalar getters
- \`Actors() []string\`, \`WorkObjects() []string\`, \`Stories() []string\`, \`Signals() []BoundarySignal\` — slice getters (defensive copies)
- \`ConfidenceLevel() ConfidenceLevel\` — three-tier classification (see thresholds below)
- \`String() string\` — "BoundedContextSketch: Ordering (core, HIGH, 0.85)"

### ConfidenceLevel Thresholds (from spike alty-cli-uuw Section 10)

- **HIGH:** confidence >= 0.65 OR 2+ distinct signal types (regardless of score)
- **MEDIUM:** confidence 0.45-0.64 with < 2 distinct signal types
- **LOW:** confidence < 0.45 with < 2 distinct signal types

"Distinct signal types" = unique SignalType values in the signals slice.

### SubdomainClassification Validation

SubdomainClassification in shared kernel lacks a Validate() method. The BoundedContextSketch constructor should validate inline by checking against AllSubdomainClassifications(). This is acceptable — adding Validate() to SubdomainClassification is a shared kernel enhancement outside T7's scope.

**No MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on either struct.** Serialization belongs in T11 (context-map parser).

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go
// internal/discovery/domain/boundary_signal_test.go

// SignalType enum
TestNewSignalType_Valid: all 7 types construct successfully
TestNewSignalType_Invalid: "unknown_signal" returns error
TestNewSignalType_Empty: "" returns error
TestSignalType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals
TestSignalType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error
TestAllSignalTypes: returns exactly 7 values

// BoundarySignal VO
TestNewBoundarySignal_Valid: type + description → success
TestNewBoundarySignal_EmptyDescription: error
TestNewBoundarySignal_WhitespaceDescription: "   " → error
TestNewBoundarySignal_InvalidType: error
TestBoundarySignal_String: correct format

// internal/discovery/domain/bounded_context_sketch_test.go

// BoundedContextSketch VO
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_Valid: name + core + 0.8 → success
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_EmptyName: error
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_InvalidConfidence_Over1: 1.5 → error
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_InvalidConfidence_Negative: -0.1 → error
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_Confidence_Zero: 0.0 → valid
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_Confidence_One: 1.0 → valid
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_InvalidClassification: error
TestNewBoundedContextSketch_InvalidTrust: error
TestBoundedContextSketch_Actors_DefensiveCopy: mutating returned slice doesn't affect original
TestBoundedContextSketch_WorkObjects_DefensiveCopy: same
TestBoundedContextSketch_Stories_DefensiveCopy: same
TestBoundedContextSketch_Signals_DefensiveCopy: same

// ConfidenceLevel thresholds
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_High_Score: 0.70 → HIGH
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_High_Threshold: 0.65 → HIGH
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_High_MultipleSignalTypes: 0.50 with 2+ signal types → HIGH
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_Medium: 0.50 with 1 signal type → MEDIUM
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_Medium_Threshold: 0.45 with 1 signal type → MEDIUM
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_Low: 0.30 → LOW
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_Low_BelowThreshold: 0.44 → LOW
TestBoundedContextSketch_ConfidenceLevel_NoSignals: 0.50 with no signals → MEDIUM
TestBoundedContextSketch_String: correct format
\`\`\`

### GREEN / REFACTOR

1. Create boundary_signal.go with SignalType enum + BoundarySignal VO
2. Create bounded_context_sketch.go with ConfidenceLevel enum + BoundedContextSketch VO
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] SignalType enum: 7 values, TextMarshaler with validation, AllSignalTypes()
- [ ] BoundarySignal: validated signalType + non-empty description, no stories field
- [ ] BoundedContextSketch: validated name, confidence 0.0-1.0, valid classification, valid trust
- [ ] Stories field on BoundedContextSketch (not on BoundarySignal)
- [ ] ConfidenceLevel(): HIGH >= 0.65 or 2+ distinct signal types, MEDIUM 0.45-0.64, LOW < 0.45
- [ ] Defensive copies on all slice getters
- [ ] NO MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on either struct (serialization is T11's job)
- [ ] Zero external dependencies in domain layer (only shared kernel TrustLevel + SubdomainClassification)
- [ ] All quality gates pass

## Pre-Implementation Validation (VERIFIED 2026-03-24)

- [x] discovery/domain/ exists
- [x] No existing BoundarySignal/BoundedContextSketch/SignalType in the package
- [x] TrustLevel in shared kernel (commit 6115fc7)
- [x] SubdomainClassification exists in domain_values.go:10-17 with AllSubdomainClassifications() — no Validate() method
- [x] SignalType values match internal-formats.md lines 691-697: 7 values
- [x] ARCHITECTURE.md lines 184-185 confirm both files in planned layout
- [x] Stories at context level, not signal level (internal-formats.md lines 738-745)

## Grooming Notes (2026-03-24)

1. **Removed MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML from both structs.** Serialization belongs in T11.
2. **Removed YAML round-trip tests.** Belong in T11.
3. **Removed stories from BoundarySignal.** Per internal-formats.md, stories belong on context (BoundedContextSketch), not signals.
4. **Added stories to BoundedContextSketch constructor.** Was missing from original design.
5. **ConfidenceLevel as typed enum.** Not just a string return — defined as ConfidenceLevel type with constants.
6. **SignalType follows T1a pattern.** Type-prefixed constants, TextMarshaler, AllSignalTypes().
7. **SubdomainClassification validated inline.** No Validate() method exists — check against AllSubdomainClassifications() in constructor.

title: [Phase 1] WorkObject value object
description:
## Goal / Problem

Immutable value object representing a work object in a domain story. WorkObject encapsulates a thing that actors work with: a name, WorkObjectType (document/folder/call/email/conversation/info/data), TrustLevel for tracking provenance, and an optional source citation. This is a foundational building block for the .story.yaml format — every domain story sentence references work objects that actors act upon.

## Background / Context

- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Line 181 (internal/discovery/domain/work_object.go)

const (

    WorkObjectTypeEmail        WorkObjectType = "email"
    WorkObjectTypeConversation WorkObjectType = "conversation"

)

title: [Phase 1] StoryActor value object
description:
## Goal / Problem

Immutable value object representing an actor in a domain story. StoryActor encapsulates actor identity and provenance: a name, ActorType (person/system/group), TrustLevel for tracking provenance, and an optional source citation. This is a foundational building block for the .story.yaml format — every domain story references actors via this type.

## Background / Context

- **Spike source:** alty-cli-1i3 (format validation), alty-cli-dh8 (domain research quality)
- **Architecture ref:** docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — Line 180 (internal/discovery/domain/story_actor.go)
- **DDD ref:** docs/DDD.md — Line 211 (StoryActor), Line 470 (Guided Discovery key objects)
- **Format ref:** docs/internal-formats.md — Lines 334-339 (Actor schema), Lines 396-402 (ActorType enum)
- **YAML pattern:** Enums use encoding.TextMarshaler (from T1). Struct VOs do NOT have YAML methods — serialization belongs in infrastructure (T10).
- **Prior deliverables:** T1 TrustLevel (commit 6115fc7), T1a StoryType/TimeType/PurityType enums (Batch 2)

## DDD Alignment

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Bounded Context | Discovery |
| Ubiquitous Language | StoryActor, ActorType (person/system/group), TrustLevel, source |
| Layer | Domain |

## Design

### Data Models

| Model | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| StoryActor | Value Object (struct) | Actor with name, ActorType, TrustLevel, optional source |
| ActorType | Enum (string VO) | person, system, group |

### ActorType Enum (follows T1a string-based pattern)

\`\`\`go
type ActorType string

const (
    ActorTypePerson ActorType = "person"
    ActorTypeSystem ActorType = "system"
    ActorTypeGroup  ActorType = "group"
)
\`\`\`

Methods: NewActorType, String, Validate, MarshalText (validates first), UnmarshalText, AllActorTypes.

### StoryActor Struct (NO YAML methods — serialization is T10's job)

\`\`\`go
type StoryActor struct {
    name      string
    actorType ActorType
    trust     valueobjects.TrustLevel
    source    string
}
\`\`\`

Methods:
- \`NewStoryActor(name, actorType, trust, source) (StoryActor, error)\` — validates non-empty name (trims whitespace), valid type, valid trust, source required when trust=AIResearched
- \`Name() string\`, \`Type() ActorType\`, \`Trust() TrustLevel\`, \`Source() string\` — getters
- \`Equals(other StoryActor) bool\` — equality by name (case-insensitive). Justified because actors are identified by name within a story.
- \`String() string\` — "Actor: Customer (person, user_stated)"

**No MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML.** Domain structs with multiple fields can't implement yaml.Marshaler without importing gopkg.in/yaml.v3. The infrastructure parser (T10, \`story_yaml_parser.go\`) handles YAML serialization using the VO's getters and constructor.

## SOLID Mapping

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **S**ingle Responsibility | StoryActor handles actor identity and provenance. ActorType handles actor classification. |
| **O**pen/Closed | New ActorTypes added to enum constants + validSet |
| **L**iskov Substitution | N/A (value objects, not interfaces) |
| **I**nterface Segregation | No interfaces needed — pure value objects |
| **D**ependency Inversion | Domain layer, depends only on TrustLevel from shared kernel |

## TDD Workflow

### RED Phase

\`\`\`go

TestNewActorType_Invalid: "robot" returns error
TestNewActorType_Empty: "" returns error
TestActorType_String: returns correct string
TestActorType_TextRoundTrip: MarshalText -> UnmarshalText -> equals
TestActorType_MarshalText_Invalid: invalid value returns error
TestAllActorTypes: returns exactly 3 values

// StoryActor VO
TestNewStoryActor_Valid: name="Customer", type=Person, trust=UserStated → success
TestNewStoryActor_EmptyName: returns error
TestNewStoryActor_WhitespaceName: "   " returns error
TestNewStoryActor_InvalidType: returns error
TestNewStoryActor_AIResearchedWithoutSource: returns error
TestNewStoryActor_AIResearchedWithSource: success
TestNewStoryActor_UserStatedWithoutSource: success (source optional)
TestStoryActor_Equals_CaseInsensitive: "customer" == "Customer"
TestStoryActor_Equals_DifferentName: "Customer" != "Seller"
TestStoryActor_String: returns "Actor: Customer (person, user_stated)"
\`\`\`

### GREEN Phase

1. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_actor.go
2. Define ActorType enum (3 constants) with TextMarshaler
3. Define StoryActor struct with unexported fields
4. Implement constructor with validation, getters, Equals, String

### REFACTOR Phase

- Verify naming matches docs/DDD.md glossary
- Verify ActorType values match docs/internal-formats.md lines 396-402
- Run all quality gates

## Steps

1. Write test file internal/discovery/domain/story_actor_test.go
2. Create internal/discovery/domain/story_actor.go with ActorType enum + StoryActor VO
3. Run quality gates

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ActorType enum: ActorTypePerson, ActorTypeSystem, ActorTypeGroup — TextMarshaler pattern
- [ ] ActorType MarshalText validates before serializing
- [ ] AllActorTypes() returns all 3 values
- [ ] Constructor validates non-empty name (whitespace-only = empty), valid ActorType, valid TrustLevel
- [ ] Source required when trust is AIResearched; optional otherwise
- [ ] Equality by name (case-insensitive)
- [ ] String() returns "Actor: {name} ({type}, {trust})"
- [ ] NO MarshalYAML/UnmarshalYAML on StoryActor struct (serialization is T10's job)
- [ ] Zero external dependencies in domain layer (only shared kernel TrustLevel)
- [ ] All quality gates pass

## Edge Cases

| Case | Input | Expected |
|------|-------|----------|
| Empty name | "" | Error |
| Whitespace-only name | "   " | Error |
| Invalid ActorType | "robot" | Error |
| AIResearched without source | trust=AIResearched, source="" | Error |
| UserStated without source | trust=UserStated, source="" | OK |
